authority.title: Inethiwerke Yegunya
authority.subtitle: Inethiwerke esekelwe emvumeni lapho amabhizinisi afaneleko adzimana adumela khona
authority.explainer: Zibhalise begodu i-AI ikuhlanganisa namabhizinisi afaneleko, angaphaphelaniko ukuze ikuqukethwe kwakho kuzuze amalinki wemvelo, wokuhlela — begodu ulinke emuva lapho kusiza khona abafundi bakho ngokweqiniso. Uhlala ulawula ngokupheleleko bona ngubani okulinka nangangani.
authority.no_websites: Ngena iwebhusayidi kuqala ukuze ujoyine inethiwerke.
authority.join_body: Khulisa igunya lakho ngamalinki afaneleko, wokuhlela namanye amabhizinisi athenjwako. Ulawula isabelomali samalinki wakho, amakhasi abaluleke khulu namabubulo okufuze uwabalekele. Joyina, misa okwesikhatjhana namkha phuma nanini.
authority.leave_confirm: Uphuma Enethiwerkeni Yegunya? Amalinki wakho angeze asambekwa namkha atholwe.
authority.no_pages: Awekho amakhasi abalulekileko okwanjesi. Ngeza amakhasi ofuna amalinki kiwo khulu.
authority.no_matches: Awekho amametjhi okwanjesi — qeda iphrofayela yakho ubuye ubheke njengombana amanye amabhizinisi ajoyina.
authority.paused_note: Ragela phambili ubulunga bakho ukuze ubone abalingani abahlanganisiweko.
authority.no_links: Akukho malungiswano abekiweko okwanje. Amalungiswano angezwa ngokuzenzakalelako nawakha okuqukethweko.
authority.credits_note: Ama-backlinks aphilako alethiweko qathanisa nesabelo senyanga. Amalinki alindwe asatjhajwa kuyo yoke inethiweki.

guides.facebook:
1. Yiya e-akhawunding yakho ye-Meta Business / Developers.
2. Yakha i-Page Access Token enegunya le-pages_manage_posts.
3. Khophela i-Page ID yakho (e-About/Settings yeKhasi) ne-token ngezasi.
guides.x:
1. Yiya ku-developer.x.com bese uvule i-app yakho.
2. Yakha i-OAuth 2.0 user access token ene-scope ye-tweet.write.
3. Namathisela i-token ngezasi.
guides.linkedin:
1. Yiya ku-linkedin.com/developers bese uvule i-app yakho.
2. Thola i-access token ene-scope ye-w_member_social.
3. Namathisela i-author URN yakho (urn:li:person:XXXX) ne-token ngezasi.
guides.instagram:
1. I-Instagram yakho kufuze ibe yi-Business account ehlangene ne-Facebook Page.
2. Thola i-token enegunya le-instagram_content_publish.
3. Namathisela i-Instagram user ID yakho ne-token ngezasi.
guides.whatsapp:
1. Lungiselela i-WhatsApp Cloud API ku-Meta.
2. Khophela i-access token yakho engapheliko.
3. Namathisela inomboro yefowuni yomamukeli (nekhodi yenarha) ne-token ngezasi.

ext_hint.instagram: I-user ID ye-Instagram Business account yakho
ext_hint.whatsapp: Inomboro yefowuni yomamukeli enekhodi yenarha, e.g. 27821234567

Kufuze afane ngeletara ngeletara — ngaphandle komtjhado wokugcina, ngaphandle kwe-www.

report_sources.projects: Kusuka kumaphrojekthi wona — Amaphrojekthi, bese uvula elinye.
report_sources.work: Kusuka ekhasini lomSebenzi lephrojekthi nganye, lapho isakhiwo nemisebenzi yaso kwakhiwa khona.
report_sources.dependencies: Kusuka ku-Msebenzi → Xhumanisa imisebenzi, lapho umsebenzi munye wenziwa ulinde omunye.
report_sources.schedule: Kubalwa sihleli kusuka ebudeni bemisebenzi nokuxhumana kwayo. Kusebenzise ekhasini leShejuli lephrojekthi.
report_sources.baseline: Kumadanisa namhlanjesi nomugca oyisisekelo ogciniweko. Gcina omunye ekhasini leShejuli lephrojekthi.
report_sources.recurrence: Kusuka emthethweni wokuphinda-phinda ngaphakathi komsebenzi, ekhasini lomSebenzi.
report_sources.evidence: Kusuka kurejista yobufakazi — uhlelo lwesimini, abathumeli bamamojula ne-API yokungenisa.
report_sources.figures: Kususelwa kubufakazi. Qala ikhasi leZibalo lephrojekthi bona uthole imithetho engemva kwenani ngalinye.
report_sources.timesheets: Kusuka ku-Ukulethwa → Isikhathi kuphrojekthi. Ngeza abantu qangi kuthebhu yaBantu — ama-awara atloliswa ngelunga.
report_sources.assignments: Kusuka ku-Msebenzi, ngokwabela ilunga umsebenzi, ngephesenti lokwabiwa. Ngeza abantu qangi ku-Ukulethwa → Abantu.
report_sources.labour: Ama-awara avunyiweko × isilinganiso. Beka isilinganiso nawutlolisa ama-awara ku-Ukulethwa → Isikhathi; kubalwa ama-awara avunyiweko kwaphela.
report_sources.costs: Kusuka ku-Ukulethwa → Iindleko kuphrojekthi, lapho kutlolwa khona izinto, imitjhini nabaqatjhi abangaphasi. Kubalwa kwaphela okuvunyiweko nokubhadelweko.
report_sources.approvals: Kudalwa ngokuzenzakalela nakuthunyelwa ama-awara namkha iindleko. Bona ngubani oquntako kubekwa ku-Ukusetha → Indlela yokuvuma.
report_sources.links: Kusuka ekhasini lephrojekthi, ngokuxhuma irekhodi kwenye imojula — ipahla, i-oda lokuthenga, ikontraka.
report_sources.registers: Kutlolwe erhelweni lomsebenzi lobungozi, iintjhijilo netjhuguluko

registers.impact_note: Tjho lokho okwenzako ebubanzini, eendlekweni, esikhathini nekghwalithini. Tjhiya ibhoksi lingenalitho nange ungazi kwamambala — 0 ongatjho litho yehlisa itjhuguluko kwaphela nange omunye ayivuma.
registers.impact_days_hint: Inomboro engaphasi kweqanda yenza ilanga lisondele.
registers.realise_note: Ubungozi buhlala erhelweni njengalokho okwenzekileko, kukulapho umraro omutjha ukhomba emuva kibo — ukuhlangana lokho kubufakazi bokuthi bekunomuntu obekabubona buza.

registers.needs_root_cause: Isehlakalo nofana umraro oqakathekileko kufuze utlole umbangela wawo wesisekelo.

templates.start_from_sub: Lo msebenzi akukabi nehlelo, ngalokho lingabekwa ngaphezu kwawo.

meetings.subtitle: Ihlelo, imitlolo, bona ngubani obekakhona, nalokho okufuze kwenziwe ngakho.
meetings.project_hint: Izenzo zingaba misebenzi emsebenzini kwaphela, ngalokho umhlangano ongenawo ugcina izenzo zawo emitlolweni.
meetings.minutes_outstanding_title: Imihlangano engu-{count} ebeyibanjwe ngaphandle kobana imitlolo isatjalaliswe
meetings.agenda_hint: Lithunyelwa ngaphambi komhlangano; liba sakhiwo semitlolo.
meetings.minutes_note: Okuqukethweko kutlolwa nemitlolo ngehloso: “kwavunyelwana emhlanganweni wendawo yomsebenzi” kuphikisana kwaphela nange umtlolo utjho bona ngubani obekakhona ukuvumelana nakho.
meetings.actions_note: Izenzo ziba misebenzi emsebenzini — isenzo esiphila emitlolweni kwaphela sisenzo esingenamuntu osenzako.
meetings.confirm_remove_body: “{title}” nemitlolo yawo iyasuswa. Izenzo esele zenziwe ziba misebenzi.

agile.title: Ama-sprint nerhelo elilindileko
agile.subtitle: Iindaba mimisebenzi ejayelekileko, ngalokho ibhodi, ihlelo namaphepha wesikhathi koke kusasebenza.
agile.backlog_sub: Lokho okungahlelekileko kuya phasi — into engenamuntu oyibeka phambili ayiqakathekile ukudlula.
agile.epics_sub: Umsebenzi odlula ama-sprint. Ukuthuthuka ziindaba zawo, ingasi isilinganiso esihlukileko esingase singavumelani nazo.
agile.no_active_hint: Hlela enye, ngenisa iindaba kiyo, bese uyithome.
agile.no_goal: Ayikho ihloso ebekiweko — i-sprint engenayo libhoksi lesikhathi kwaphela.
agile.goal_hint: Umutjho munye. Nange ungakwazi ukuwutlola, i-sprint ayinayo ihloso.
agile.revision_hint: Ngaphandle kwakho, “bekunani kilolu hlobo” kuqagela eenyangeni eziyisithandathu ezizako.
agile.close_note: Iindaba ezingakapheli zibuyela erhelweni elilindileko, ingasi phambili kwe-sprint elandelako — ukuzidlulisela ngokwazo yindlela i-sprint elandelako ethoma ngayo sele izele ngaphambi kobana omunye ayihlele.
agile.one_at_a_time: Enye i-sprint sele iragela phambili kilo msebenzi. Ezimbili ngesikhathi sinye zenza isivinini negrafu yokuqedwa kungakhanyi.

portal.title: Imisebenzi yakho
portal.subtitle: Lokho okwenzeka emisebenzini yakho, nalokho okutlhoga wena.
portal.empty_body: Le phothali ikhombisa imisebenzi ohlotjaniswe nayo njengekhasimende nofana njengekontraka. Nange usebenza lapha, imisebenzi yakho ingaphasi kwe-Misebenzi.
portal.progress_note: Le yinomboro efanako naleyo iqembu elenzako eliyibonako — akubalwa ngokuhlukileko kuwe.
portal.time_sub: Kudlula ekuvunyweni okufanako nalelo lekhasi lesikhathi elijayelekileko.
portal.documents_sub: Woke kilo msebenzi owaziko, nalapho ungasithumela khona into
portal.rate_sub: Isilinganiso sinye ngenyanga — siya ngqo eqenjini elenzako.
portal.rate_dialog_sub: Ukwethembeka kusiza ukudlula ukuba nomusa. Akekho olinganiswa ngalokhu ayedwa.
portal.my_invoices_sub: Lungisa i-invoyisi yomsebenzi wakho bese uyithumela kumphathi weprojekthi.
portal.cinvoice_empty: Ngezelela okungenani umugca munye, namkha unamathisele i-invoyisi yakho, ngaphambi kokuyithumela.
portal.cinvoice_sent: I-invoyisi le sele ithunyelwe begodu angekhe isatjhugululwa.
portal.my_contracts_sub: Lokho osebenza ngaphasi kwakho kulo msebenzi.
portal.raise_request_sub: Kuya ngqo ebantwini abaqhuba iphrojekthi le.

assistant.title: Umsizi
assistant.subtitle: Lokho idatha ekutjhwiko bona kutlhoga ukunakwa nguwe, nesizo ngokutlola.
assistant.all_clear_hint: Woke umsebenzi osebenzako uyabika, ungaphakathi kweenkhombo zawo, begodu awunazo iinquntho ezivinjelweko.
assistant.draft_sub: Iinomboro zithathwa emsebenzini; isibonelo sitlola amagama ayirhanjeleko kwaphela.
assistant.draft_warning: Ihlelo. Lifunde ngaphambi kobana ulithumele — iinomboro zamambala, imitjho ayikabi ngeyakho.
assistant.no_provider: Akakho umniki we-AI obekiweko kilendawo yomsebenzi, ngalokho ukutlola akutholakali. Koke okungehla kubalwa kusukela edatheni yakho begodu akutlhogi muntu.
assistant.overloaded_detail: Amairi angu-{hours} ahleliweko enyangeni yamairi angu-{capacity}, emisebenzini engu-{projects}.
assistant.silent_title: Imisebenzi esebenzako engu-{count} ayibiki litho emavekini amabili
assistant.silent_detail: Umsebenzi ongabiki litho akusiwo umsebenzi okhamba kuhle — ngilowo ongenamuntu ongatjho litho ngawo.
assistant.risk_title: Ubungozi obukhulu obungu-{count} obungenakho ukulungiswa okutloliweko
assistant.risk_detail: Bunamaphuzu angu-15 nofana ngaphezulu, kukulapho kungekho okutloliweko ngalokho okwenziwako.
assistant.change_title: Iimbawo zetjhuguluko ezingu-{count} ezilinde ngaphezu kweveke
assistant.change_detail: Zithunyelwe kukulapho kungakenziwa isiqunto. Ihlelo nesiqunto kuyahluka.
assistant.issue_detail: Zivulekile, zinikelwe abantu, begodu zidlulelwe sikhathi.

alerts.deadline_title: Imisebenzi engu-{count} ephela emalangeni angu-{days} azako
alerts.overdue_title: Imisebenzi engu-{count} esele idlulelwe lilanga layo
alerts.overdue_detail: Isavulekile, kukulapho amalanga asehlelweni angasatjho litho.

equipment.title: Ukubuyekezwa kwemitjhini
equipment.sub: Ukubuyekezwa ngaphambi kokusetjenziswa — ikghwalithi luhlelo olungaphuki, ingasi okukodwa kwako
equipment.identifier_hint: Yiskene nofana uyitlole. Ikhodi engakhambisani nalitho efayeleni isafanele itlolwe.
equipment.signed_hint: Ibizo lakho, isikhathi ne-adresi yakho kuyatlolwa — njengokusayina idokhumende.

contractors.title: Ama-invoyisi wabosonkontrakthi
contractors.subtitle: Lokho abosonkontrakthi abakuthumeleko ngomsebenzi weeprojekthi zakho.
contractors.markup_hint: Akukatlhogeki, begodu ayikhe iboniswe ikhasimende namkha usonkontrakthi. Tjhiya kungenalitho nange ingekho.
contractors.reject_sub: Usonkontrakthi uboniswa ibanga lakho, ngalokho tlola into angathatha igadango ngayo.
contractors.no_email: Lo sonkontrakthi akanayo ikheli le-imeyili, ngalokho ikontrakthi ayikwazi ukuthunyelwa.
contractors.not_submitted: Yi-invoyisi ethunyelweko kwaphela engavunywa namkha yaliwe.
contractors.register_sub: Woke umuntu owenza naye ikontrakthi, nakho koke ngaye.
contractors.add_sub: Ibizo labo nokobana ungabathola njani. Banikele iprojekthi bese bathola ukufinyelela ephothalini bona bakubhadelise.
contractors.from_suppliers: Lezi ziinkhomba zakho zabaphakeli. Ukungeza omunye lapha kumfaka naku-Supplier Management.
contractors.field_email_hint: Lapho isimemo sabo sephothali siya khona.
contractors.on_projects: iiprojekthi ezingu-{count} | iprojekthi engu-{count} | iiprojekthi ezingu-{count}
contractors.our_signatory_hint: Batjelwa ku-app, begodu ikontrakthi ilinde isiginetjha yabo lapha.

contracts.title: Iinkontrakthi
contracts.subtitle: Iinkontrakthi zeprojekthi — zitlolwa, zilungiswe, zibuyekezwe begodu zisayinwe lapha.
contracts.draft_sub: Thoma kwesinye seenthombe zakho, namkha ungathomi litho.
contracts.template_hint: Iinthombe zakho zeprojekthi. Tjhiya kungenalitho bona uzitlolele imibandela.
contracts.title_hint: Tjhiya kungenalitho bona ibizwe ngokosonkontrakthi neprojekthi.
contracts.no_body_hint: Yilungise bona utlole imibandela, namkha utlole elandelako ngesithombe.
contracts.amend_sub: Susa imibandela engasebenziko, namkha utjhugulule amatemu. Lokhu kutlola uhlobo olutjha.
contracts.amend_withdraws: Le kontrakthi isaphumele ukusayinwa. Ukuyilungisa kuhoxisa amasiginetjha asele acelwe, begodu amaqembu azokucelwa bona asayine uhlobo olutjha.
contracts.change_note_hint: Kutlolwe kilolu hlobo — “kususwe umbandela 7, awukho umtjhini kilingcenye”.
contracts.submit_explainer: Lokhu kuya kunanyana ngubani ikampani yakho embekileko bona avume iinkontrakthi. Nange kungekho magadango wokuvuma abekiweko, kuphawulwa njengokuvunyiweko begodu kulungele ukusayinwa.
contracts.signature_stale: Kusayinwe kuhlobo lwangaphambili. Amagama atjhugulukile kusukela lapho.
contracts.type_your_name_hint: Ukuthayipha ibizo lakho lapha kusiginetjha yakho.
contracts.decline_reason_hint: Elinye iqembu liyakubona lokhu, begodu kufuze likwazi ukuthatha igadango.
contracts.send_explainer: {contractor} usayina qangi, bese umuntu omkhethako ngezasi asayine naye.
contracts.closed: Ikontrakthi esayiniweko namkha ekhanselweko ayisakwazi ukutjhugululwa.
contracts.not_submittable: Isakhiwo namkha ikontrakthi ealiweko kwaphela engathunyelwa bona ibuyekezwe.
contracts.not_sendable: Ikontrakthi evunyiweko namkha eyisakhiwo kwaphela engathunyelwa bona isayinwe.
contracts.no_counterparty: Le kontrakthi ayinaye usonkontrakthi, ngalokho ayikwazi ukuthunyelwa.
contracts.already_decided: Le siginetjha sele inikelwe namkha yaliwe.
contracts.no_signatory_email: Umsayini okhethiweko akanayo ikheli le-imeyili, ngalokho ikontrakthi ayikwazi ukuthunyelwa.
contracts.mail_signature_line: Ukhethiwe bona usayine ikontrakthi {number} no-{contractor} ku-{project}.
contracts.member_hint: Bona ikontrakthi ingubani. Kuyatlhogeka ngaphambi kobana ithunyelwe bona isayinwe.
contracts.no_contractors_on_project: Abekho abosonkontrakthi kile projekthi — ngeza omunye qangi esikrinini sabosonkontrakthi abancani.
contracts.name_alongside_drawing: Your name in text as well, so the record stays legible.
contracts.reopen_reason_hint: Every party who signed is told this.
contracts.reopen_warning: This contract is signed. Reopening tells everybody who signed, returns it to draft, and it must be signed again.
contracts.not_reopenable: Only a signed contract can be reopened.
contracts.reopen_reason_required: Say why the contract is being reopened.
contracts.not_yours_to_amend: This contract is not yours to change.
contracts.bad_signature_image: That signature could not be read.
contracts.signature_too_large: That signature image is too large.
contracts.mail_reopened_line: Contract {number} on {project} has been reopened for amendment.
contracts.mail_reopened_resign: The wording will change, so it will come back to you to sign again.
contracts.inapp_reopened: Contract {number} has been reopened for amendment.
contracts.need_drawing: Draw your signature above, or switch to Type.
contracts.no_document: Akukho idokhumende ekhiqiziweko kusivumelwano lesi okwanjesi.
contracts.bad_signed_pdf: Idokhumende esayinweko leyo akhange ifundeke njenge-PDF.
contracts.amendment_would_drop_tables: Itjhugululo leli lizosusa amatafula angu-{n} esivumelwaneni — umhleli angekhe awagcine. Hlela amagama kwenye indawo, namkha ubawe bona itafula litjhugululwe esibonelweni.
contracts.sign_steps: Khetha namkha dweba isayino, cindezela lapho kufuze sibe ekhasini, bese usayina.
contracts.need_a_signature: Khetha isayino esigcinweko, namkha dweba esinye.
contracts.place_it_on_the_page: Cindezela ekhasini lapho isayino sakho kufuze sibe.
contracts.signing_failed: Isivumelwano akhange sisayinwe. Sibawa ulinge godu.
contracts.counterparty_has_no_login: Umkontraka lo akanakho ukungena okwanjesi, ngalokho bekangekhe akwazi ukusayina. Mmemele eportaleni kuthoma.
contracts.signatory_cannot_sign: Isiqhema lesi asinakho ukungena, ngalokho angekhe sikwazi ukusayina. Simemele eportaleni, bese uthumela isivumelwano godu.

contract_templates.title: Iinthombe zeenkontrakthi
contract_templates.subtitle: Amagama le kampani eyenza ngawo iinkontrakthi ezincani. Abulungwa lapha, ku-Project Management.
contract_templates.form_sub: Tlola imibandela ejayelekileko kanye, bese uyilungisa ngokosonkontrakthi ngamunye nawutlolako.
contract_templates.none_hint: Tlola sinye, namkha ufake isethi yokuthoma nge-pm:contract-templates:install.
contract_templates.import_is_a_copy: Ukungenisa kuthatha ikhophi. Ukuyihlela lapha akukhe kutjhugulule yokuthoma, begodu ihlala ingeyakho nange i-Contract Management isusiwe.

steps.title: Amakholomu webhodi
steps.subtitle: Nikela amagama eenyathelo umsebenzi wenu odlula kizo. Isinyathelo ngasinye siphethe incazelo efundwa yimodyuli yoke — ikuthuthuka, ukuqedwa neembawo koke kulandela incazelo, ingasi ibizo.
steps.needs_done: Isinyathelo esisodwa kufuze sibalwe njengePheliileko, ngaphandle kwalokho akukho okungapheliswa ebhodeni.
steps.will_move: Imisebenzi engu-{count} isesinyathelweni osisusileko. Izokuyiswa ekholomini yokuthoma.
steps.unknown_step: U-“{step}” akusilo ikholomu kiwo umsebenzi lo.
steps.too_many: Ibhodi likhawulelwe emakholomini angu-{max}; ngaphezu kwalokho akekho ongalifunda.
steps.bad_category: U-“{label}” kufuze abalwe njengesinye seemo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi.

reminders.mail_subject: Imisebenzi yakho: {due} ipheliileko namhlanjesi, {overdue} esele idlulile

billing.no_accounting: I-Accounting ayifakwanga, ngalokho akunanto engathunyelwa ku-ledger.
billing.no_party: Alikho ikhasimende lezibalo elifana no-"{client}" — yenza elinye, namkha uhlanganise okuphindwe kabili.

data_sources.title: Imithombo yedatha
data_sources.subtitle: Imithombo le nkampani eqinisekisa ngayo abarhwebi, lokho umthombo ngamunye ongakuphendula, nokuhlolwa okungakaphendulwa mumuntu.
data_sources.ledger_broken: Iketani lobufakazi alivumelani etlolweni {at} ({reason}). Thatha ubufakazi obuthinteka njengobungakaqinisekiswa bekukhe kuphenywe.
data_sources.coverage_help: Koke ukuhlolwa imojula le eyaziko ukukwenza, nokobana ngubani okuphendulako namhlanjesi. Ukuhlolwa okunganamthombo akweqiwa — kutlolwa njengokungafumaneki bekube khona umuntu okwenzako atlole akufumeneko.
data_sources.manual_notice: Ukuhlolwa okungu-{count} akunamthombo olungisiweko, ngalokho umuntu kufuze akwenze atlole akufumeneko.
data_sources.enable_help: Nangabe lokhu kuvaliwe, ukuhlolwa ebekuzokuphendulwa ngikho kutlolwa njengokungafumaneki kunokobana kuphumelele.
data_sources.credentials_help: Kubethelwe lapha kugcinwe khona begodu akukhange kubuyiselwe esikrinini lesi. Faka ikhiye bona uyitjhugulule; amakhiye ongawatloli godu ayagcinwa.
data_sources.default_for_help: Lapha imithombo engaphezu kwomunye ingaphendula ukuhlolwa, lo ubuzwa kokuthoma.
data_sources.monthly_quota_help: Imithombo ebhadelwako ibiza imali ngombizo ngamunye. Nangabe isabelo sesiphelile, ukuhlolwa kutlolwa njengokungafumaneki kunokobana kukubhadelise.
data_sources.endpoints_help: Ikheli i-akhawundi yakho egunyaziweko elinikela ukuhlolwa ngakunye. Iindawo zokuzalisa zizaliswa kusukela kumrhwebi.
data_sources.endpoint_hint: Iindawo zokuzalisa: registration_number, company_name, vat_number, tax_reference_number, account_number, reference
data_sources.manual_provider_note: Kuhlala kufumaneka. Umuntu wenza ukuhlolwa emthonjeni atlole akufumeneko — kungena erhelweni lokuqala elifanako, nobufakazi obufanako, kutlolwe ebizweni lakhe.
data_sources.profiled: Ukuhlola okungu-{count} sekwazi bona kutjhayela kuphi. Faka imininingwana yakho begodu kuzokusebenza — iinsimu ezingaphasi ngezekhontraka ehlukileko kwaphela.

verifications.title: Ukuphenya okudephileko
verifications.outstanding: Ukuhlolwa okungu-{count} kusatlhoga ukutjhejwa ngaphambi kobana umrhwebi lo athathwe njengoqinisekisiweko.
verifications.record_help: Kokuhlolwa okwenze wena emthonjeni. Kugcinwa nobufakazi obufanako nalokho okwenziwe ngumtjhini, kutlolwe ebizweni lakho — bona kungabi khona ozokuthatha njengependulo eqinisekiswe ngumtjhini.
verifications.observed_help: Tlola lokho umthombo okuveze ngambala. Kumadaniswa nalokho umrhwebi asitjele khona, ibala nebala, bona umahluko ufumaneke kunokobana wamukelwe ngokuthemba.
verifications.pin_held: I-PIN ibanjelwe umrhwebi lo, ngalokho ubujamo babo bokulandela umthelo bungaqinisekiswa.
verifications.pin_missing: Ayikho i-PIN okwanje. I-PIN ye-TCS yomrhwebi yimvumo yabo yokobana uqinisekise ubujamo babo bokulandela umthelo.
verifications.pin_help: Igcinwe ibethelwe, isetjenziselwa kwaphela ukuqinisekisa ubujamo bokulandela umthelo. Ukuqinisekisa kutlola lokho i-SARS ekutjhwileko ngesikhathi kubuzwa — kungakho lokhu kungasi kulayitjha isitifikedi.

errors.no_source: Awukho umthombo olungiselelwe u-{check}, ngalokho angekhe kusebenze ngokuzenzakalelako. Tlola ukuhlolwa wena, namkha ulungise umthombo ku-Lungisa → Imithombo yedatha.

ownership.title: Ubunikazi
ownership.no_ubos: Akakho umuntu wemvelo ofumanekileko. Bekube iketani lifika ebantwini, akakho ongahlolwa — ikampani ayikwazi ukujeziswa begodu ayikwazi ukuba yi-PEP.
ownership.diagram_alt: Umdwebo wobunikazi. Ilwazi elifanako lisetafuleni engaphasi kwawo.
ownership.table_caption: Woke amasabelo wobunikazi atlolweko. Itafula le sithombe esizeleko — umdwebo ongehla utjengisa ubudlelwano obufanako.
ownership.as_at_help: Ilanga lapha isabelo lesi besiliqiniso ngalo. Itlolo lobunikazi elinganalanga lisibawo esinganamalungana nesikhathi esithileko.
ownership.unallocated: {entity}: u-{missing}% wamasheya awukahlathululwa. Ukhona owubambileko ongakabizwa ngebizo.
ownership.unstated_stakes: {entity}: amasabelo angu-{n} atlolwe ngaphandle kobukhulu, ngalokho amasheya angekhe ahlathululwe.
ownership.over_allocated: {entity}: amasabelo amenyezelweko afika ku-{declared}%, okungaphezu kwekampani yoke.
ownership.related_help: Abarhwebi abanomuntu namkha ikampani ebambileko efanako nalo. Kanengi akunacala — begodu kuyindlela iqembu linye elifaka ngayo ithenda ngamabizo amathathu.
ownership.owns_what_help: Umrhwebi ngokwakhe, namkha ikampani ephezulu eketanini.
ownership.compare_help: Faka abanikazi abazuzako njengombana irejista ibatlola. Bamadaniswa nabantu iketani lomrhwebi lo elifika kibo — umsanka hlangana namarhelo la amabili ngilo okufumanekileko.

risk.title: Ukuhlolwa kobungozi
risk.never_assessed: Umrhwebi lo akakahlolwa. Bekube kwenziwe lokho, akukho lapha okutjho bona kuphephile na ukurhweba nabo.
risk.trend_alt: Ukukhamba kwamaphuzu wobungozi ekuhlolweni okungu-{n} kokugcina.
risk.gates_pass: Woke amasango wokugunyaza ayaphumelela. Umrhwebi lo angagunyazwa ngaphandle kokubuyekezwa okungezelelweko.
risk.tier_unset: Alikabekwa — ubudlelwano ngibo obuqunta bona kutlhogeka ukuphenya okungangani.
risk.tier_help: Phendula ngobudlelwano lobu, ingasi ngekampani ngokujayelekileko. Umrhwebi ofanako angaba izinga 1 ezintweni zokutlola bese aba izinga 4 ekuhlanganiseni kweholo.
risk.record_hit_help: Kokuvumelana okufumene erhelweni elirhatjhiweko. Kubalwa ngokujamelana nomrhwebi begodu kutjhejwe njengalokho okulandwe ngumtjhini.
risk.subject: Kuhloliwe
risk.reason_help: Kuyatlhogeka nawususa okuvumelanako. Ngomnyaka ozako, ukulahlwa okungahlathululwako angekhe kwehlukaniswe nokugandelela ngephoso.

reputation.title: Idumela nokutjheja amaplatifomu
reputation.no_source_notice: Awukho umthombo weendaba namkha wamaplatifomu olungisiweko, ngalokho akukho okungasesiwa ngokuzenzakalelako. Umrhwebi ebekangekhe asesiwe mumuntu akukafuzi athathwe njengalowo okungafumanekanga litho ngaye.
reputation.no_coverage: Akukho okusesiweko ngomrhwebi lo okwanje. Lokho akusi litlolo elihlwengileko — kukungabi khona kwalo.
reputation.needs_review_notice: Ukubizwa okungu-{n} akukhange kukwazi ukuhlanganiswa nomrhwebi lo ngokuqiniseka. Akubalwa bekube khona oqinisekisa bona yikampani efaneleko.
reputation.attributed: Siqiniseka ngo-{n}% bona lokhu kumalungana nomrhwebi lo
reputation.attribution_warning: Siqiniseka ngo-{n}% kwaphela bona ukubizwa lokhu kumalungana nomrhwebi lo. Qinisekisa bona yikampani efaneleko ngaphambi kokukuthatha njengokufumanekileko.
reputation.reason_help: Kuyatlhogeka nawususa okufumanekileko. Ngomnyaka ozako, ukulahlwa okungahlathululwako angekhe kwehlukaniswe nokugandelela ngephoso.
reputation.watching_help: Umrhwebi akajayelekile ukubizwa ngebizo elise-invoyisini yakhe. Amabhrendi, amabizo wokurhweba, amawebhusayidi nama-akhawundi wamaplatifomu koke kuyasesiwa, kanye nabaqondisi banje nabanikazi abazuzako.
reputation.nothing_watched: Ibizo elitlolisiweko kwaphela, ibizo lokurhweba nabantu banje.
reputation.watch_help: Ngezelela ibhrendi, iwebhusayidi namkha i-akhawundi yeplatifomu. Ama-akhawundi ahlukene ngeplatifomu, ngombana ibizo elifanako emaplatifomini amabili ngama-akhawundi amabili ahlukeneko.

passport.health_help: Bona bukhamba njani ubudlelwano lobu — ukulethwa, amaphepha, ukusabela.
passport.health_unknown: Kusesikhathi ukutjho. Akukho okubawiweko kibo begodu akukho okulethiweko okwanje.

incident.context_explainer: Kutlolwe nakubikwa isenzakalo kwabe kwamiswa — ngilokho ebekuliqiniso ngaleso sikhathi.

no_company.body_self_hosted: Akunankampani ebekwe kuhlanganisela lesi okwanje. Amarekhodi we-SHEQ ngewenkampani, ngalokho yenza kunye ngaphasi kweenlungiselelo ngaphambi kokusebenzisa imoduli le.

competency.expiry_hint: Okungagcwaliswa kutjho bona isikhathi sokusebenza sekghono liyaqunta.
competency.evidence_hint: Isetifiketi likwalo. Libulungwa nerekhodi begodu lingadawunilodwa kilo.

suppliers.subtitle: Ukuhlolwa kwe-SHEQ ngaphambi kobana umphakeli asebenze endaweni.
suppliers.invite_note: Isimemo sitjho amadokhumente okufuze akhutjhwe lizinga lengozeli, bona athunyelwe kanye kunokobana atholakale ngokwaliwa ngakunye.

ppe.title: PPE
ppe.subtitle: Okukhitjhiweko, kubani, nokobana kufanele kutjhugululwe nini.
ppe.empty_catalogue: Akunalitho ekhathalogu okwanje, ngalokho akunalitho elingakhutjhwa. Sebenzisa u-“Phatha ikhathalogu nesitoko” ukungezelela izinto inkampani le ezikhuphako — iinkhwehlela, iingwani zokuvikela, amagilavu — begodu ubeke bona kungaki okusesheluvu.
ppe.issue_note: Okukhutjhiweko, kukhutjhelwe bani. Ilanga lokutjhugulula liphuma esikhathini sokuphila kwento.
ppe.serial_hint: Ezintweni ezihlolwa namkha ezibuyiselwa ngayinye, njengebhande lokuzivikela.

medical.title: Ukuhlolwa kwezamaphilo
medical.subtitle: Ukufanelana nomsebenzi, nokuhlolwa okuzako.
medical.clinical_hint: Ilwazi lamaphilo. Libhalwe ngekhodi, begodu libonakala kwaphela ngemvumo yedatha yezamaphilo.
medical.clinical_failed: Imininingwana yezokwelapha ayikghonanga ukulayitjhwa. Akunalitho elitjengiswako esikhundleni serekhodi elinganalitho, elingafundeka njengokungabi khona kwalokho okufunyenweko.
medical.clinical_warning: Imininingwana yamaphilo ngaphasi kwe-POPIA s26. Ukuyifunda kutlolwa ku-akhawunti yakho.
medical.record_note: Ukuhlolwa okwenziweko. Imininingwana yezamaphilo igcinwa ngokwehlukileko begodu ifundwa kwaphela ngilabo abanelungelo.
medical.expires_hint: Itjhiye ingenalitho ukuthi kusetjenziswe isikhathi sokusebenza esibekelwe lokhu kuhlolwa.
medical.restrictions_hint: Kuyatlhogeka. Umkhawulo ongatlolwanga utjhiya umphathi aqagela.
medical.clinical_encrypted: Kubhalwe ngemakhodu lapho kugcinwe khona begodu kufundwa kwaphela ngilabo abanelungelo lemininingwana yezamaphilo.

environmental.title: Imvelo
environmental.subtitle: Amanzi, amandla, uphetroli, imfucuza nekhabhoni.
environmental.no_factor: La mamitha awanaso isilinganiso sokukhupha, ngalokho awangezi litho enanini lekhabhoni:
environmental.record_note: Ukufundwa kwemitha, kunelanga. Inani eliphelele lekharbhoni libalwa kabutjha kusukela kilo kusetjenziswa isilinganiso sokukhupha semitha.

equipment.title: Amathulusi wokuphepha
equipment.subtitle: Iimcima-mlilo, amabhanda, amathulusi wokuphakamisa nesizo lokuthoma.

visitors.title: Iimvakatjhi
visitors.subtitle: Imvumo, isingeniso, nokobana ngubani okhona nje.
visitors.roll_call: Lokhu luhlu lokubiza amabizo. Ngemva kwe-alamu, ngilo kwaphela uhlu eliqakathekileko.
visitors.no_workflow_detail: Akunamkhuba wokuvuma iinvakatjhi, ngalokho akekho onelungelo lokungenisa umuntu. Hlela umkhuba kuqala.
visitors.request_note: Ukuvakatjha kufuze kuvunywe ngaphambi kobana kungene umuntu, ngalokho lokhu kusicelo ingasi ukufika.
visitors.expected_to_hint: Ngemva kwesikhathesi isivakatjhi sitlolwa njengesihlala isikhathi eside.

emergency.title: Ubujamo obuphuthumako
emergency.subtitle: Amaqhinga, iindawo zokuhlangana nokusebenza kokuzijayeza.
emergency.uncovered: Akunahlelo lobujamo oburhabako elitlolelweko: {types}. Akunamuntu onenqubo angayilandela kilokhu.
emergency.record_drill_note: Ukuzilolonga okwenziweko. Inani labangatholakaliko ngilo elinquma bona kuphumelele na.

training.title: Ukubandulwa kokuphepha
training.subtitle: Kufundwa ku-Learning Management. Iimrekhodi azibuyelelwa lapha.
training.unavailable: I-Learning Management ayifakwanga, ngalokho ayikho idatha yokubandulwa engatjengiswa.

integrations.title: Ukuhlanganiswa kwesango
integrations.subtitle: Hlanganisa uhlelo lwakho lokulawula ukungena namkha lokuklokha. Faka iimfakazelo, hlola, bese ugandelela.
integrations.none: Akunakuhlangana okwanje. Ngezelela kunye bona uthome ukuhlola abantu esangweni.
integrations.label: Ibizo
integrations.monitor_first: Ukuhlangana okutjha kuthoma ngemodi yokuqala: ukwala kuyatlolwa kodwana akunamuntu ovinjwako. Kuqale iveke, ususe okuseleko, bese ugandelela.
integrations.enforce_warning: Kusukela nje, abantu abehlulekako ekuhlolweni bazokuvinjwa esangweni. Ngokusekelwe emalangeni angu-30 adluleko, okungena okungu-{refused} bekuzokwaliwa. Qinisekisa bona okuseleko kususiwe qangi.

inductions.title: Ukwethulwa
inductions.subtitle: Okutjelwa abantu ngaphambi kobana banyathele endaweni.
inductions.author: Tlola ukwethulwa
inductions.bulk_how: Dawuniloda isifanekiso, sigcwalise, usilayitjhe. Hlola qangi — akunalitho elibulungwako bekube ucindezela u-Ngenisa.

talks.title: Iinkulumo zokuphepha
talks.subtitle: Okutjelwe isiqhema, bobani ebebakhona, nalokho abakuphakamiseko.
talks.attendees_hint: Kuyatlhogeka. Inkulumo enganabantu ebebakhona ifakazela bona sihlele okhunye, ingasi bona kukhona otjelweko.
talks.concerns_hint: Nanyana yini ephakanyiswe lapha iba isenzo, ngalokho ayilahleki nange inkulumo iphela.
talks.record_note: Ikulumo enganalo uhlu lwababekhona itjengisa bona kulungiswe okuthileko, ingasi bona ukhona owaziswako.

ppe_config.title: Ikhathalogi nesitoko se-PPE
ppe_config.subtitle: Lokho ikampani ekukhuphako, nokuthi kungakanani okusesheluvini.
ppe_config.empty_help: Ayikho into ekhathalogi okwanje. Ngezelela izinto ikampani ezikhuphako — iinyathelo, iinkhwama zokuvikela, amagilavu — bese ubeka bona zingaki esheluvini. Irejista yokukhupha ifunda lapha.
ppe_config.low_warning: Imigqa yesitoko engu-{n} isezingeni lokuyala namkha ngaphasi kwalo.
ppe_config.sized_hint: Maka lokhu nangabe into ikhutjhwa ngamasayizi, ukuze isitoko sibalwe ngesayizi ngasinye.
ppe_config.reorder_hint: Yelelisa nangabe inani lehla lifika lapha
ppe_config.site_hint: Tjhiya kunganalitho nangabe isitoko singagcinwa ngendawo
ppe_config.stock_hint: Umgqa munye ngento nganye, isayizi nendawo. I-PPE enesayizi ibalwa ngesayizi, ngombana ukuphelelwa sisayizi sinye akufani nokuphelelwa yinto.

import.title: Ngenisa izinto ze-PPE
import.subtitle: Layitjha ikhathalogu kusukela kusipredishidi kunokobana uyithayiphe.
import.matched_on_code: Izinto zifaniswa ngekhowudi — ikhowudi ekhona iyabuyekezwa, ayiphindwa.

reports.title: Imibiko
reports.subtitle: Woke amarejista emojulini, njengombiko ongawuhlunga bese uwuthumela.
reports.not_periodic: Lo mbiko uhlathulula isimo njenganje, ngalokho isikhathi asisebenzi.

help.incidents_by_type: Mangaki walolu hlobo ngalunye, mangaki okufuze abikwe, namalanga alahlekileko.
help.incidents_detail: Zoke iimehlakalo esikhathini, umugqa munye ngasinye.
help.actions_overdue: Sekudlule ilanga lawo begodu awukaqedwa — uhlu okufuze lusetjenzwe.
help.ppe_issued: Okwakhutjhwa, kukhutjhelwa bani, nokuthi kufuze kutjhugululwe nini.
help.ppe_usage_by_item: Ukusetjenziswa ngento — okufuze kubhajethwe begodu ku-odwe godu.
help.ppe_replacements_due: I-PPE ekhutjhiweko efika ekupheleni kwepilo yayo.
help.ppe_stock: Okusesheluvini, nokuthi yini esewele ezingeni lokuyala.
help.inductions_completed: Ngubani owethulwako, amaphuzu wakhe, nokuthi kuphela nini.
help.visitors: Ngubani owafika endaweni esikhathini, nokuthi wakhamba nini.
help.visitors_on_site: Woke umuntu ongenileko ongaphumanga — uhlu lokubalwa kwabantu.
help.permits: Iimvumo ezikhutjhwe esikhathini nesimo sazo sanje.
help.emergency_drills: Ukuzilolonga okwenziweko, ukuthatha ingcenye nesikhathi sokuphuma.
help.environmental_readings: Ukufundwa kwemitha nokuthi kutjhugululwa kube yi-CO₂e engangani.
help.contractors_access: Ukuthi umqatjhi ngamunye angaba na endaweni njenganje.

approvals_setup.read_only: Ungabona amakhambiso la kodwana angekhe uwatjhugulule.
approvals_setup.edit_hint: Ukubulunga kwakha ihlelo {n}. Iimbawo eziragelako zigcina amagadango ezithome ngawo.
approvals_setup.retire_confirm: Thathisa u-“{name}” umhlalaphasi? Iyekela ukusetjenziswa kokutjha. Iimbawo eziragelako ziyayigcina begodu zingaqedwa.

hints.permit: Ngubani otlikitla imvumo ngaphambi kobana kuthonywe umsebenzi
hints.risk_assessment: Ngubani ovumela ukuhlolwa ngaphambi kobana kusebenze

sites.add_sub: Indawo lapha kwenziwa khona umsebenzi engekho esakhiweni sekampani — indawo yokugcina eqatjhiweko, indawo yekhasimende, isiqephu sendlela.
sites.structure_warning: Ibizo nokobana iyasebenza na kubekwa sisakhiwo sekampani begodu kuzobuyiselwa ekuvumelaniseni okulandelako. Koke okunye kuhlala.
sites.hint_timezone: Imikhawulo yesikhathi yomthetho ibalwa kilesi sikhathi
sites.hint_reference: Inomboro yekhontraka namkha yomsebenzi, nangabe isiza
sites.requirements_hint: Indawo yokuhlwengisa ioyili nehhovisi akufuzi kufune amaphepha afanako. Hlela uhlu lwendawo le, namkha uyitjhiye ilandele ikampani.
sites.requirements_inherit_hint: Ukulandela kutjho bona indawo le iyatjhuguluka nakutjhuguluka uhlu lwekampani. Ukuyicima akuvimbi litho — indawo ikhuluma eyayo.
sites.requirements_none_warning: Nakungakamakwa litho, nanyana ngimuphi umkontraka endaweni le uyalandela msinyana nje nakatloliswe.

triage.title: Ulayini wokuhlunga
triage.subtitle: Izehlakalo ezilindele bona umuntu azithathe, ilanga eliseduze kuqala.
triage.dialog_help: Qinisekisa bona bekungaba kumbi kangangani begodu ubize ozokuqeda. Ukutjhugulula izinga kutjhugulula ilanga.

alert.title: Iziyeleliso zokuphepha
alert.subtitle: Ukusa okufunyenweko ebantwini abaqalene nengozi efanako.
alert.needs_why: Tjho bona kubangelwa yini namkha khuyini okutjhugululiweko ngaphambi kokukhupha.

injury.title: Amacala wokulimala
injury.subtitle: Ngubani ongekho emsebenzini, ngubani osemsebenzini olula, nangubani osebuyileko.
injury.still_running: Umuntu lo unesikhathi esivulekileko ngaphandle kwelanga lokugcina, ngalokho amalanga asabalwa.
injury.event_hint: Ukuphumula nomsebenzi olula kubala amalanga. Okunye mlando wokutlhogonyelwa.

permit.no_approvals: Akunamakhambo wokugunyaza alungiselelweko uhlobo lwemvumo lesi.
permit.suspend_hint: Isiqhema sibona isizathu lesi, ngalokho tjho bona kufuze kulungiswe ini ngaphambi kobana umsebenzi uragele phambili.
permit.override_warning: Uyamukela, ebizweni lakho, bona umuntu angenza umsebenzi anganathikithi yawo kwanjesi. Lokhu kutlolwa emvumweni nemkhondweni wokuhlola.
permit.no_closure_checks: Uhlobo lwemvumo lesi alukhulumi ngokuhlolwa kokuvala.

board.title: Ibhodo Yeemvumo Ebukhoma
board.subtitle: Umsebenzi ongaphasi kwelilungelo elitlolweko kwanjesi
board.uncovered: Iimvumo ezibukhoma ezingu-{count} azinakuhlolwa kwengozi okugunyaziweko okumbomba indawo. Ilungelo imvumo elime kilo alikho.
board.empty: Akunamvumo ezibukhoma. Akunalitho elisetjenzwa ngelilungelo elitlolweko kwanjesi.

ra.needs_lines: Ngezelela okungenani umugwalo munye wengozi ngaphambi kobana lokhu kugunyazwe.
ra.needs_participants: Tlola bona bobani abahlanganyeleko ngaphambi kobana kugunyazwe — iMithetho yokwaKha ne-MHSA bobabili bakutlhoga.
ra.weak_control_line: Umugwalo {sequence}: {hazard} iyingozi ephezulu namkha ebucayi elawulwa kwaphela ngamakhambo wokuphatha namkha izivikelo zomuntu.
ra.approved_locked: Ukuhlolwa okugunyaziweko angekhe kuhlelwe. Kunalokho yenza ukubuyekezwa; ihlelo leli lihlala erekhodini ngombana iingameko zahlulelwa ngalo.
ra.no_lines: Akunamigwalo yengozi okwanje. Ukuhlolwa okunganamigwalo kuvimba yoke imvumo ekukhombako.
ra.participants_hint: Abantu abenza umsebenzi kufuze bahlanganyele ekuhloleni ingozi yawo.
ra.controls_hint: Esinamandla qangi. Ingozi ephezulu ebanjwe kwaphela ngamakhambo wokuphatha namkha izivikelo zomuntu iyatshwaywa.

contractor.subtitle: Bona abantu laba bangaba endaweni namkha akhe, nokuthi khuyini okubavimbako
contractor.blocked_title: Abantu laba angekhe beze endaweni okwanje
contractor.compliant: Umkontraga lo uhlangabezana nalokho okufunwako ngendawo le.
contractor.no_access_events: Akunamuntu osele askenwe angena namkha aphuma.
contractor.title: Isihloko
contractor.expiry_hint: Tjhiya ilanga lokuphela kungagcwaliswa kudokhumende elingapheliko. Idokhumende elidlule ilanga lalo lokuphela livimba ukungena.
contractor.induction_hint: Ukwethulwa okuphelelwe sikhathi kubalwa njengokungekho, begodu kusizathu esivamileko khulu sokuthi isisebenzi sibuyiselwe esangweni.
contractor.override_warning: Uyamukela, ebizweni lakho, bona abantu laba bangaba endaweni ngaphandle kwamadokhumende afunwako ngendawo le. Nikela ilanga — ukudlulisela okunganasiphetho kuba okungapheliko ngeliphoso.
contractor.drop_hint: Amanengi ngesikhathi sinye, namkha i-zip yinye ephethe ifayela lokuphepha loke — ivulwa ibe idokhumende linye ngefayela ngalinye.
contractor.photo_hint: Indlela indlu yesango yazi ngayo bona umuntu osesangweni nguye umuntu osererhelweni.
contractor.not_linked: Akuhlanganiswa nerekhodi lokuPhatha abaNikeli, ngalokho ifayela labo lokuphepha nerekhodi labo lezokurhweba angekhe afundwe ngokumadanisa.
contractor.set_aside_note: Idokhumende lihlala efayeleni njengobufakazi begodu liyalisa ukubalwa ekuhambisaneni. Sebenzisa lokhu ukulungisa ilanga lokuphela elingakalungi: ukunamathisela isetifiketi esifaneleko akwaneli ngokwaso, ngombana ukuhlola kugcina nanyana ngiliphi idokhumende eliphela ekugcineni.
contractor.set_aside_hint: Kutlolwe ebizweni lakho. Umbuyekezi obuza bona kubayini isetifiketi salisa ukubalwa ufunda lokhu.
contractor.pass_hint: Isango liskena lokhu bese lifumana ipendulo ebukhoma. Ikhowudi ayiphethe litho ngaphandle kwesikhombisi — akunanomboro yesazisi, akunamniningwana yezamaphilo, akunasetifiketi — ngalokho kuhlala kuphephile ukuphrinta, ukuthwebula nokudlulisela.
contractor.worker_site_hint: Itjhiye ingenalitho ukuthi ilandele indawo yomsebenzi yomkontraki.
contractor.pass_rotate_warning: Ikarada eliphrintiweko liyalisa ukusebenza khonokho begodu kufuze kukhutjhwe elitjha. Sebenzisa lokhu lokha ikarada lilahlekile namkha umuntu asele akhambile.
contractor.sites_hint: Ukuvunywa endaweni yinye akusiko ukuvunywa kwenye. Indawo evimba lo mkontraki iyamnqabela lapho nanyana ifayilakhe ithini kezinye iindawo.
contractor.sites_none: Azikho iindawo ezisebenzako okufuze kunqunywe ngazo okwanje.
contractor.site_conditions_hint: Iprintwa esiquntweni sesango nangabe ikarada labo liskenwa lapha. Isibonelo: akhatjhwe sikhathi soke, emini kwaphela.
contractor.site_block_warning: Lokhu kubanqabela kule ndawo kwaphela, begodu kubanqabela nanyana ubujamo babo bekampani yoke buthini.

files.drop_hint: namkha cindezela ukukhetha. I-zip ivulwa ibe irekhodi linye ngefayela ngalinye elingaphakathi.

library.title: Ilayibhrari yamadokhumende
library.subtitle: Iinqubo ezisebenzako, njengombana zisebenza kuwe
library.owing: Amadokhumende angu-{count} alindele bona uqinisekise bona uwafundile.
library.watermark_note: Ikhophi nganye iphethe ihlelo lalo, ilanga lokugadangisa nesitshwayo sekhophi enganalawulwa. Ikhophi ephrintiweko isebenza kwaphela ngelanga ephrintwe ngalo.

exposure.title: Amahora Asetjenziweko
exposure.subtitle: Ukubekwa phambi kokungenisa okuhlukaniswa ngakho woke amazinga wokulimala
exposure.site_hint: Tjhiya kungagcwaliswa kwinkampani yoke. Thwebula ngendawo kwaphela nange ubika ngendawo.
exposure.basis_hint: Lapho inani livela khona. Nanyana yini ngaphandle kwenani elifakwe ngesandla yenza amazinga wenyanga akwazi ukuhlolwa.
exposure.estimated_note: Iinyanga ezingu-{count} zitjhwejelwa enanini elifakwe ngesandla, ngalokho amazinga wazo maqeqe.
exposure.missing: Iinyanga ezingu-{count} azinamahora, ngalokho i-LTIFR, i-TRIR, i-DIFR nezinga lobukhulu angekhe kubalwe kizo.
exposure.footnote: Amazinga ngamahora angu-200 000 asetjenziweko. Inyanga enganamahora iyatjhiywa ezingeni lomnyaka kunokobana ibalwe njengo-0.

mine.title: Lapha Ngijame Khona
mine.subtitle: Amathikithi wami, ukuhlolwa kwamaphilo nokufunda, njengombana uhlelo kunakho
mine.no_record: Awunarekhodi lesisebenzi okwanje, ngalokho akunalitho elisefayeleni ongalitjengisa. Bawa loyo owabeka i-akhawunti yakho bona akufake erherhweni labasebenzi — bekube kulapho, uhlelo angekhe likutjele lapha ujame khona, begodu angekhe liqagele.
mine.nothing_on_file: Akunalitho elitlolwe ngawe okwanje, begodu akunalitho elifunwe kuwe. Lokhu akufani nokuhambisana — kutjho bona akunalitho elitlhogeka ukuhlolwa.
mine.blocking: {count} wamathikithi wakho aphelelwe sikhathi begodu akuvimba ukusebenza. Angekhe ukhutjhelwe imvumo namkha usayinwe emsebenzini bekube kuvuselelwa.
mine.gaps_hint: Lokhu kufunwe kuwe begodu akunarekhodi ngakho. Ithikithi eliphelelwe sikhathi litlhoga ukuvuselelwa; lokhu kufuze kuhlelwe.
mine.induction_not_current: Ukwethulwa kwakho kwendawo akusesikhathini. Ungabuyiselwa esangweni.
mine.unacknowledged: Iinqubo ezingu-{count} zilindele bona uqinisekise bona uzifundile
mine.footnote: Leli lirekhodi elifanako elifundwa ziincwadi zokutlolisa nesango. Nange okhunye lapha kungakalungi, akukalungi ndawo zoke — tjela isikhulu sakho sokuphepha kunokobana usebenze ngendlela ezombelezako.

matrix.title: Imethrikisi Yamakghono
matrix.subtitle: Ngubani ofanelekele ini, nalapha sitlhayela khona
matrix.no_gaps: Woke ikghono elitlhogekako liphethwe ngibo boke elitlhogeka kibo.
matrix.capped: Kutjengisa abantu abangu-{shown} kwabangu-{total}. Igridi ibanzi ngokwemvelo, ngalokho incunyelwe.
matrix.nothing_required: Akunakghono elisele litlhogwe kunanyana ngubani. Lokhu akufani nokuthi woke umuntu uyahambisana — kutjho bona akunalitho elingahlolwa ngalo.
matrix.footnote: Iintlhogo ezinamathiselwe endimeni, emnyangweni namkha endaweni zilungiswa lapho umongo loyo waziwa; igridi le itjengisa lezo ezinamathiselwe ebantwini ngokunqophileko. Ithikithi eliphelelwa sikhathi lisabalwa njengeliphethweko — lisebenza namhlanjesi.

safety_file.title: Ifayela Lokuphepha
safety_file.subtitle: Soke isigaba esifunwako ngumnikazi wendawo, nokukhona kuso ngasinye.
safety_file.nothing_required: Akunasigaba esifunwako okwanje, ngalokho ifayela angekhe libe lipheleleko namkha lingapheleliko. Khetha iphrofayili yomkhakha wakho bese uyilungisa — ngilokho okutjho bona ngiziphi iingaba eziqakathekileko lapha.
safety_file.complete: Soke isigaba esifunwako sigculisiwe. Ifayela leli alitlhogi ikhophi yephepha.
safety_file.history_count: {count} arekhodiweko. Isigaba lesi simlando kunokuba bube bufakazi, ngalokho akutlhogeki bona sigcwaliswe.
safety_file.drop_hint: Yehlisa amasetifiketi lapha. Ifolda ye-zip ivulwa ibe idokhumende linye ngefayela ngalinye.
safety_file.reason_hint: Kutlolwe ebizweni lakho, begodu umkontraga uyatjelwa bona kutjho ini.
safety_file.valid_until_hint: Tjhiya kungagcwaliswa ukufumana iinyanga ezingu-{months} kusukela namhlanjesi. Liphuma ekugunyazweni ngelanga leli nanyana kukhona ovula isikrini namkha akunamuntu.
safety_file.reject_hint: Umkontraga kufuze atjelwe bona alungise ini. Ukwala ngaphandle kwesizathu kuthoma ucingo kunokuba kuthome idokhumende elilungisiweko.
safety_file.warning_days_hint: Tjhiya kungagcwaliswa ukusebenzisa okubekiweko. Kubeke ngesikhathi esitlhogekako ngempela ukutjhugulula idokhumende leli.
safety_file.site_hint: Tjhiya kungagcwaliswa lapho kusebenza kizo zoke iindawo. Idokhumende lendawo ethileko akufuze livimbe umkontraga kezinye iindawo.
safety_file.activities_hint: Tjhiya kungagcwaliswa lapho kusebenza kiwo woke umsebenzi. Ithikithi lokuphakamisa liqakathekile ekuphakamiseni, ingasi ekupendeni.
safety_file.filed_as_hint: Kulethwe kutjho bona lifikile begodu kusafuze lihlolwe mumuntu. Aligculisi litho bekube liyamukelwa.

state_hint.DRAFT: Akunamuntu osele abawelwe ukuqala ifayela leli.
state_hint.APPROVED: Umuntu onekghono wamukele ifayela leli. Liyalisa ukusebenza ngelanga elingaphasi.
state_hint.SUSPENDED: Alialwa, kodwana alisebenzi nje godu. Abantu babo bayalelwa esangweni.
state_hint.EXPIRED: Ukugunyazwa kuphelelwe sikhathi. Kufuze kuthunyelwe ifayela elitjha.

move_hint.submit: Linikela ifayela kunanyana ngubani obuyekeza amafayela wabakontraga lapha. Angekhe lithunyelwe ngesikhathi isigaba esifunwako singakagculiswa.
move_hint.request_changes: Libuyisa nerhelo lalokho okufuze kutjhugululwe. Okulandelako okuthunyelwa ngumkontraga kulihlelo elitjha, begodu leli ligcina isizathu sakho.
move_hint.approve: Lamukela ifayela njengalokhu limi namhlanjesi. Ukugunyazwa kusitatimende malungana namadokhumende akulo ngelanga leli, ngalokho kuphatha ilanga lokuphela.
move_hint.suspend: Kumisa ukugunyazwa ukusebenza ngaphandle kokwala ifayela. Abantu babo bayalelwa esangweni bekube kubuyiselwe.

safety_file.rules_hint: Isiqunto sakho, ingasi sehlelo. Yoke imibandela engaphasi iyahlolwa begodu ibikwe nanyana kunjani; amaswitjhi la aqunta bona ngiziphi kuzo ezala ngempela umkontraga esangweni. Zisebenza kuwo woke umkontraga, ngombana ukuzisebenzisa ngokungalingani ngikho okwenza umtjhijilo esangweni uphumelele.

status_hint.COMPLIANT: Koke okufunwako kusefayeleni, kusesikhathini begodu kwamukelwe.
status_hint.EXPIRING: Akunalitho elitlhayelako, kodwana okhunye kuphelelwa sikhathi msinyana.
status_hint.NON_COMPLIANT: Okhunye okufunwako akukalungi. Ukhethe ukungakwali ukungena ngenca yakho.
status_hint.PENDING_APPROVAL: Ifayela likumbuyekezi. Akunalitho elitlhayelako — akunamuntu osele alamukele.
status_hint.SUSPENDED: Umuntu umise ifayela leli isikhatjhana. Lokho kudlula koke okubalweko.

rule.MISSING_MEDICAL: Umsebenzi utlhoga isetifiketi sokuphila kuhle begodu akukho esikhona
rule.MISSING_METHOD_STATEMENT: Umsebenzi utlhoga isitatimende sendlela begodu akukho esifayilweko
rule.MISSING_PERMIT: Umsebenzi utlhoga imvumo yokusebenza begodu akukho evuliweko
rule.MISSING_EQUIPMENT_CERTIFICATE: Umsebenzi utlhoga isetifiketi sezinsiza begodu akukho esifayilweko

safety_file.always_blocks: kuhlala kunqabela, begodu akucinywa lapha. Indawo yomsebenzi inquma isango layo.

activities.title: Imisebenzi
activities.subtitle: Umsebenzi owenziwa endaweni yomsebenzi, nokuthi uhlobo ngalunye lutlhoga ini ukuze luvunyelwe.
activities.name: Ibizo
activities.code_hint: Lokho okuthunyelwa sifundi sekarada, imvumo namkha i-API. Iinhlamvukulu, kungabi nemikhathi.
activities.requires_hint: Ubufakazi okufuze umuntu abe nabo. Isisebenzi esinganabo obunye balobu siyanqatjhelwa umsebenzi lo ngebizo.
activities.high_risk_hint: Kuwumaka bona ubukwe kabili. Isango lisebenza ngalokho umsebenzi okutlhogako, ingasi ngalokhu.
activities.permit_hint: Imvumo kufuze ivulwe ngaphambi kobana umsebenzi lo uthome.
activities.retire_body: Angekhe usanikelwa. Iimvumo neenhlakalo zokungena esezitloliweko ngawo zihlala zifundeka, begodu ikhodu ingasetjenziswa godu ngemva kwesikhathi.
activities.empty_body: Bekube umsebenzi utjho okutlhogako, isango elibuzwako bona “kghani umuntu lo angasebenza phezulu” alinalitho elingakuhlola begodu lidlulisa woke umuntu. Thoma erhelweni leSewula Afrika elizako bese utjhugulula lokho ngamunye akutlhogako.
activities.unstaffed: Imisebenzi engu-{n} okunganamuntu endaweni ofanelekako kiyo njenganje. Namkha iincwadi zokufundela kufuze zilandelwe, namkha isitlhogeko asilungi.
activities.advisory_body: Umuntu onganabo ubufakazi obutlhogekako uyadluliswa begodu igebe litlolwa phasi. Vula u-“Ikghono elingekho lomsebenzi” emithethweni yokuvimba abakontraki ukuze kunqatjhwe esikhundleni salokho.

attendance.title: Endaweni yomsebenzi
attendance.subtitle: Ngubani olapha nje, ngubani ongeneko waphuma, nongakhange aphume ngokusemthethweni.
attendance.long_stays_hint: Abantu abangu-{n} sebalapha isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora angu-{hours}. Itjhifi yebusuku nayo ikhanga njalo — kodwana nendawo lapho kunganamuntu ophumako ngokusemthethweni.
attendance.when_hint: Itjhiye ingenalitho ukuze kube nje. Isikhathi esidlulileko siyamukelwa, ukutlola irhelo lephepha; esizako asamukelwa.
attendance.manual_note: Kutlolwa njengokufakwe ngesandla, ukuze ukuhlolwa kukwazi ukukuhlukanisa nokuskena. Isifundi esingasebenziko akusiso isizathu sokutjhiya umuntu erhelweni.

overrides.title: Ukungena kwesikhatjhana
overrides.subtitle: Ngubani odluliselwe esangweni ekungakafuzi adlule kilo, nangegunya labani.
overrides.explainer: Ukweqa kuvumela umuntu ofayilakhe lingekho kuhlelo. Kwenzelwe bona kube lula ukukunikela — umkontraki onomsebenzi onganandlela yokungena kuyindlela abantu abangena ngayo ngebizo lomunye — begodu kuphephile ngombana koke kutloliwe lapha nebanga lakho, umvumeli wakho nokuphela kwakho. Akunalitho elingasebenza isikhathi esidlula amalanga angu-{days}.
overrides.grant_warning: Lokhu kungenisa endaweni yomsebenzi umuntu ebekazokunqatjhelwa. Kutlolwa ngebizo lakho, nangebizo lomvumeli omqambako.
overrides.ending_soon_hint: Ukweqa okungu-{n} kuphela emalangeni amabili. Kuvuseleleni namkha nikuyekele kuphelelwe — kodwana nqumani, kunokobana nikuthole esangweni.
overrides.reason_hint: Lokho umuntu okubuyekeza eenyangeni eziyisithandathu azokusebenzisa. Okungenani iinhlamvu ezilitjhumi.
overrides.conditions_hint: Lokho okufuze bakwenze ngesikhathi kusebenza. Kuprintwa esiquntweni sesango nangabe ikarada labo liskenwa.
overrides.starts_hint: Itjhiye ingenalitho ukuze kuthome nje. Ukweqa kokuvalwa kwemisebenzi kungahlelwa ilanga ngaphambili.
overrides.ends_hint: Kuyatlhogeka, begodu okungenani amalanga angu-{days} azako. Kuzivalela kona.
overrides.site_hint: Itjhiye ingenalitho kizo zoke iindawo. Ukukunciphisa kuyindlela ephephileko.
overrides.approver_hint: Umuntu okugunyazileko, nangabe kungasiwe wena. Itjhiye ingenalitho begodu kutlolwe ngebizo lakho.
overrides.revoke_body: Isango libuyela lapho belikhona, msinyana. Nanyana ngubani othembele kilokhu ukuze angene endaweni kusasa uzokunqatjhelwa.

portal.title: Ukuhambisana kwakho kwezokuphepha
portal.subtitle: Lokho u-{host} akutlhogako kuwe ngaphambi kobana abantu bakho basebenze eendaweni zabo.
portal.not_a_contractor_body: Awukho erhelweni labakontraki balikhasimende leli, ngalokho azikho iintlhogeko zokuphepha nge-akhawundi yakho. Nangabe abantu bakho basebenza eendaweni zabo, bacele bona bakufake.
portal.score_explained: Iphuzu linye ngedokhumende ngalinye, ifayili yakho yokuphepha, nokwethulwa komuntu ngamunye.
portal.nothing_required: Ikhasimende leli alikaceli litho kuwe okwanje.
portal.nothing_outstanding: Akunalitho elisaseleko. Usemumva nazo zoke iintlhogeko.
portal.no_workers: Akunamuntu wakho oserhelweni lekhasimende leli okwanje.
portal.review_note: Nanyana yini oyithumelako iyabuyekezwa ngaphambi kobana ibalwe. Izokubonakala ilindele ukubuyekezwa bekube bayamukela, ungathembeli kiyo esangweni ngaphambi kwalokho.
portal.file_hint: I-PDF, isithombe namkha idokhumende ye-Word, bekube ku-20 MB.
portal.upload_done: Kuthunyelwe. Bazokubuyekeza begodu kuzokubalwa nangabe sekwamukelwe.

notices.title: Iimbiko zabakontraki
notices.subtitle: Lokho isistimu le ekutjela abakontraki bakho, lapho kuya khona, nalokho okuhambe ngambala.
notices.channels_hint: I-imeyili etloliweko yekampani encani ivamise ukuba yomhloli-maakhawundi, ehlolwa kanye ngeveke. Inomboro kirekhodi elifanako ivamise ukuba yomphathi wendawo.
notices.what_we_send_hint: Woke umbiko isistimu le ewuthumela umkontraki, nalokho okuwubangelako.
notices.unreachable_body: Abananalo ikheli eendleleni ozikhethileko, ngalokho akunamunye kiyimibiko le ebafikelelako. Akunalitho eliphambanako — abatjelwa nje, bekube kube khona onqatjhelwako esangweni.

when.worker_blocked: Nangabe umuntu anqatjhelwa ngambala, ingasi emmodeni wokuqalelela
when.induction_required: Qobe veke, njengerhelo linye kunomlayezo ngamunye
when.competency_expiring: Kusukela emalangeni angu-30 ngaphambili, nakanye ngemva kokuphela

schemes.title: Amahlelo wokuthobela namasango wemisebenzi
schemes.subtitle: Amahlelo ihlangano yakho esebenza ngaphasi kwawo (GLOBALG.A.P., SIZA, okwemvelo, ikhowudi yekhasimende), amukelwe ngendawo erejisteni yezomthetho — nokuhlolwa okufanele kuphumelele ngaphambi kokuthoma uhlobo lomsebenzi.
schemes.name: Ibizo
schemes.gates_hint: Umsebenzi angekhe uthome bekube ukuhlolwa, okwenzelwe umsebenzi loyo, kuphumelele.

no_company.title: Ayikho ikampani esebenzako
no_company.body: Idatha yokulawula ukuthenga ngeyenkampani. Khetha inkampani ofuna ukusebenza kiyo.
no_company.body_self_hosted: Akunakampani ehlelweko kukufaka lokhu okwanjesi. Amarekhodi lapha ngewekampani, ngalokho yenza yinye ngaphasi kweemhlelo ngaphambi kokusebenzisa immoduli.

common.title: Isihloko
common.name: Ibizo
common.comment_optional: Akukabophi, kodwana kuyamsiza loyo ozokufunda ngemva kwesikhathi.
common.form_errors: Sibawa ulungise iinkinga ezingu-{n} ngaphambi kokuragela phambili:

new_review.title: Ukubuyekezwa okutjha kwethenda
new_review.subtitle: Thoma ukuhlola kusukela ehlelweni namkha kwakho kwaphela

documents.title: Amatlhogomiso
documents.subtitle: Uhlu linye, elinamathiselwe nanyana kukuphi lapha lisebenza khona

analytics.title: Ukuhlaziya kokuthenga
analytics.subtitle: Bona imojula yoke isebenza njani, ingasi nje bona isebenzise malini

dashboard.title: Ukubusa kokuthenga
dashboard.subtitle: Ukuhlela, amathenda, ukuphambuka nokulandela endaweni yinye

planning.title: Amahlelo wokuthenga
planning.subtitle: Iintlhogo zokuthenga zomnyaka zehlangano
planning.new_plan_hint: Ihlelo lihlanganisa iintlhogo zomnyaka wezimali zomnyango munye namkha iphrojekthi yinye.
planning.create_plan_hint: Ihlelo lithoma njengelokwakhiwa. Ngeza iintlhogo ngaphambi kokulithumela ukuze libuyekezwe.
planning.cancel_hint: Ukukhansela kutjhaphulula nanyana ngisiphi isabelomali esibanjelwe imigca yalehlelo.
planning.no_budget_module: Ukuphathwa kweSabelomali akufakwanga, ngalokho akukho sabelomali esingahlanganiswa. Ihlelo liyasebenza ngaphandle kwaso.
planning.no_budget_position: Akukho sabelomali esihlanganisiweko, namkha uKuphathwa kweSabelomali akufakwanga, ngalokho ubujamo bezimali abukwazi ukutjengiswa.
planning.over_budget: Ihlelo leli lidlula isabelomali esikhona nga-{amount}.
planning.delayed_subtitle: Sekudlulile ilanga lethenda namkha lokunikela begodu akukanikelwa
planning.upcoming_empty: Akukho lutho olutlhogekako emalangeni angu-60 azako.

tenders.title: Ukubuyekezwa kwamathenda
tenders.subtitle: Ukuthoma, ukuhlola, ukulungisa nesincomo sokunikela
tenders.initiate_hint: Ukubuyekezwa kwethenda kunekomidi lakho, iinkambisolawulo, iimbawo nesincomo.
tenders.create_review_hint: Iinkambisolawulo nekomidi kulungiswa ngemva kwalokho, ngaphambi kobana ukuhlola kuvulwe.
tenders.plan_line_hint: Ukukhetha umgca wehlelo kuthatha imininingwana yawo.

methodologies.WEIGHTED_hint: Yoke inkambisolawulo ilinganiswa ibe liphuzu linye
methodologies.TWO_ENVELOPE_hint: Isango lobungcweti kokuthoma, inani livulwe kwaphela kilabo abaphumeleleko

tenders.weights_must_total: Isisindo senani nesokukhetha kufanele sibe ngu-100; singu-{total}.
tenders.no_committees: Akukho makomidi asebenzako okwanje — yenza elinye ngaphambi kobana ukuhlola kuvulwe.
tenders.approval_level_hint: Umtlolo okhululekileko: izinga lamandla elitlhogwa lokhu kunikela.
tenders.frozen_explainer: Iinkambisolawulo zavalwa nga-{at}, lokha ukuhlola kuvulwa. Itjhuguluko nje litlhoga isibawo sokutjhugulula iinkambisolawulo esivunyiweko.
tenders.no_evaluators: Akukho bahloli abakhethiweko. Khetha ikomidi kokuthoma.
tenders.coi_outstanding_body: Ukuhlola akukwazi ukuvulwa bekube kulapho loke ilunga elivotako limemezele begodu nanyana ngikuphi ukungqubuzana okumemezelweko kurarululwe.
tenders.no_recommendation: Akukho sincomo esenziweko. Vuma amaphuzu ekulungiseni kokuthoma.
tenders.recommended_supplier_hint: Ngokuzenzakalelako ngesibawo esiphezulu; tjhugulula nangabe ikomidi lincoma ngenye indlela.
tenders.submitted_at_hint: Isibawo esamukelwe ngemva kokuvalwa siphawulwa njengesiphuzileko.
tenders.preference_framework_hint: Lizalisa ukwahlukaniswa kwenani nokukhetha okubekwe mthetho.
tenders.no_framework_for_jurisdiction: Alikho ihlaka elilungiselelwe lesi sifunda okwanje.
tenders.framework_unverified_warning: I-{name} ayikaqinisekiswa ngomthethokambiso wakho wokuthenga owamukelweko. Hlola amaphuzu ngaphambi kokunikela ngawo.
tenders.unconvertible_body: Alikho izinga lokutjhugulula elifakiweko le-{currencies} kumadaniswa ne-{target}. Faka izinga ku-Finance, ngaphandle kwalokho ukunikela amaphuzu angeze kwakwazi ukuhlela lezi iimbawo.

evaluations.title: Ukuhlola kwami
evaluations.subtitle: Amathenda okhethelwe ukuwanikela amaphuzu
evaluations.none_hint: Uzokubona amathenda lapha nawukhethelwe ikomidi lokuhlola.
evaluations.declare_first: Qedelela ummemezelo wakho wokungqubuzana kweenkarohlo ngaphambi kokunikela amaphuzu.
evaluations.conflict_blocked: Umemezele ukungqubuzana. Ukunikela amaphuzu kujanyisiwe bekube kulapho umlawuli akurarulula.
evaluations.declaration_intro: Ngaphambi kokunikela amaphuzu, memezela nangabe unayo ikarohlo kilowo ofake isibawo kilethenda.
evaluations.conflict_pending: Ukungqubuzana okumemezeleko kusemlawulini. Awukwazi ukunikela amaphuzu bekube kulapho kurarululwa.
evaluations.price_hidden: Lokhu kukuhlola kweemvulophu ezimbili, ngalokho amanani weembawo ahlala avaliwe bekube kulapho isigaba sobungcweti siphela.
evaluations.locked_body: Kuthunyelwe nga-{date}. Lokhu kubuyekezo {revision}. Ukulungisa kutlhoga ukuvulwa okugunyaziweko, okubulunga amaphuzu wokuthoma.
evaluations.submit_hint: Nawusuthumele amaphuzu wakho ayatlhajwa begodu abalwa ephuzwini lekomidi.
evaluations.confirm_submit_body: Iphuzu lakho elilinganisiweko ngu-{score}. Ngemva kokuthumela, itjhuguluko litlhoga ukuvulwa okugunyaziweko.

moderation.title: Ukulungisa
moderation.subtitle: Madanisa abahloli, rarulula umahluko, uvume amaphuzu wokugcina
moderation.scores_approved: Amaphuzu wokugcina wekomidi avunyiwe. Isincomo nje singenziwa.
moderation.open_items: Izinto ezingu-{n} zisavuliwe. Zirarulule ngaphambi kokuvuma amaphuzu wokugcina.
moderation.variance_hint: Iinkambisolawulo lapha abahloli bahlukana khona ngaphezu kwe-{pct}% yenani eliphakemeko ziphawulwa ngokuzenzakalelako.
moderation.reevaluate_warning: Lokhu kuvula godu amaphuzu athunyelwe mhloli. Amaphuzu wokuthoma ayabulungwa.

committees.title: Amakomidi wokuhlola
committees.subtitle: Amakomidi ajameko, amalunga wawo nokukhethwa
committees.type_hint: Isibonelo ukuhlola isibawo namkha ukwahlulela isibawo.
committees.external_hint: Umuntu onganayo i-akhawundi kilenkundla, okhethwe ngaphandle kwehlangano.
committees.needs_quorum: Linamalunga avotako angu-{have} begodu ikhoramu yalo ngu-{need}.

deviations.title: Ukuphambuka
deviations.subtitle: Iimbawo zokuphambuka endleleni ejayelekileko yokuthenga
deviations.new_hint: Tlola okungakho nje — ukuhlolwa kokulandela kuthoma nawuthumela, ingasi nawubulunga.
deviations.motivation_hint: Ngilokhu okufundwa kokuthoma mhloli-weencwadi. Hlathulula okwenzekileko nokobana kubayini indlela ejayelekileko ingasetjenziswanga.
deviations.draft_notice: Ukubulunga kubulunga lokhu njengokwakhiwako. Imithetho yokulandela isebenza nawukuthumela ukuze kuvunywe.
deviations.no_rules: Ihlangano yakho ayikalungisi mithetho yokulandela yokuphambuka.
deviations.submit_body: Imithetho yokulandela isebenza nje, begodu iketani lokuvuma likhethwa enanini, emnyangweni, ehlotjeni nasengozini yalokhu kuphambuka.
deviations.accept_warnings: Ngiyazamukela iinyeleliso lezi begodu ngifuna ukuragela phambili
deviations.acceptance_reason_hint: Kutlolwa ekuhloleni begodu kubonwa nguye woke ovumako.

fields.reason_hint: Ngomutjho munye namkha emibili, kuyini okwenza lokhu kutlhogeke.
fields.business_justification_hint: Kubayini lokhu kulungile bona ihlangano ikwenze.
fields.risk_assessment_hint: Kuyini okungakhamba kumbi, nokobana kuyini okukwehlisako.
fields.proposed_alternative_hint: Kuyini ebekucatjangwa esikhundleni salokho, nokobana kubayini ingasetjenziswanga.

records.title: Amarekhodi wokuthenga
records.subtitle: Koke ukuthenga, kusukela ekuthomeni kuya ekugcineni, kurekhodi linye
records.no_procurement: Akukho lutho olusukela esigabeni sesibawo namkha sokuhlela oluhlanganisiweko.
records.no_tender: Akukho kubuyekezwa kwethenda okuphakanyisiweko kilokhu kuthenga.

audit.title: Umkhondo wokuhlola
audit.subtitle: Soke isenzo, ngubani osenzileko, nini, nokobana kuyini okutjhugulukileko
audit.immutable_notice: Umkhondo lo wongezwa kwaphela begodu uhlanganiswe nge-hash. Iingeniso azikwazi ukuhlelwa namkha zisuswe, begodu ukuphazamisa kuyabonakala.

documents.title: Amatlhogomiso
documents.subtitle: Uhlu linye, elinamathiselwe nanyana kukuphi lapha lisebenza khona — alikhe lilayishwe kabili
documents.expiring_soon: Amatlhogomiso angu-{n} aphelelwa sikhathi emalangeni angu-30
documents.acknowledgement_required: Itlhogomiso leli kufanele livunywe ngaphambi kokobana lithenjwe.

approvals.title: Ukuvunyelwa
approvals.subtitle: Koke okulinde isiqunto, kiyo yoke imojula le
approvals.overdue_notice: Ukuvunyelwa okungu-{n} elayinini lakho sekudlulile izinga lomsebenzi.
approvals.cannot_decide: Isinyathelo lesi asikakhethelwa wena, namkha nguwe owaphakamisa isibawo. Ukwahlukaniswa kwemisebenzi kutlhoga omunye ovumako.

compliance.title: Ideshibhodi yokulandela
compliance.subtitle: Lapha ihlangano ijame khona kumadaniswa nemithetho yayo yokuthenga

reports.title: Imibiko yokuthenga
reports.subtitle: Ukusetjenziswa kwemali, abarhwebi nokusebenza, kubalwa nje
reports.no_supplier_module: Ukuphathwa kwaBarhwebi akufakwanga, ngalokho amanani wabarhwebi akakwazi ukwenziwa.
reports.concentration_hint: Isabelo senani elinikelweko elibanjwe barhwebi abathathu abakhulu
reports.stage_durations_hint: Amalanga aphakathi achithwe ngaphambi kokutjhugulula ngakunye, ukuze iimbambezelo zibonakale.
reports.saved_runs_hint: Yavalwa ngesikhathi yenziwa ngaso, ukuze amanani angatjhuguluki ngaphasi kwephepha lebhodo.
reports.frozen_notice: Umbiko lo sithombe esivalekileko. Amanani wawo anjengombana bekanjalo ngesikhathi wenziwa.

workload.title: Umthwalo womsebenzi namandla
workload.subtitle: Ngubani ophethe ini, nokobana umsebenzi ubambekile kuphi
workload.thresholds: Umthwalo ophezulu kusukela ku-{high}, bathwele khulu kusukela ku-{overloaded}.
workload.no_officers: Akukho iinkhulu eziphethe umsebenzi wokuthenga okwanje.
workload.trend_hint: Isikhombo somthwalo esiphakathi emalangeni angu-90 adluleko.
workload.summary: Iinkhulu ezingu-{officers}, ukuthenga okusebenzako okungu-{active}, izenzo ezidlulwe sikhathi ezingu-{overdue}.

settings.title: Iimlungiselelo zokubusa kokuthenga
settings.subtitle: Amandla, imikhawulo, imithetho namaketani wokuvuma
settings.capabilities_hint: Ukucima amandla kufihla amakhasi wawo, amakhadi neenkhumbuzo. Koke okhunye kuragela phambili kusebenza.

capability.workload_hint: Umthwalo weenkhulu, iinyeleliso zamandla neenkhathi zokuqeda
capability.governance_hint: Injini yemithetho, amarekhodi angu-360°, amatlhogomiso nomkhondo wokuhlola

settings.fy_start_hint: Ubeka bona ukuthenga kubikwa kumuphi umnyaka.
settings.budget_warning_hint: Yelelisa nangabe ihlelo lifika kilesi sabelo sesabelomali esikhona.
settings.variance_hint: Phawula inkambisolawulo nangabe abahloli bahlukana ngaphezu kwalesi sabelo senani eliphakemeko.
settings.workload_order: Kufanele ibe ngaphezulu komkhawulo womthwalo ophezulu.
settings.escalation_days_hint: Isikhathi ukuvunywa okungahlala ngaso ngaphambi kokobana abaphathi batjelwe.
settings.require_coi_hint: Ukuhlola akukwazi ukuvulwa bekube kulapho loke ilunga elivotako limemezele.
settings.allow_reopen_hint: Ukuvulwa godu kutlola ibanga lakho begodu kubulunga amaphuzu wokuthoma.
settings.block_over_budget_hint: Kucinyiwe ngokuzenzakalelako: ezinye iinhlangano zihlela ngamabomu ngaphezulu.
settings.rules_explainer: Akukho lutho lapha olubotjhelwe kinanyana ngimuphi umthetho. Amatlhogomiso atlhogekako, amazinga wokuvuma, imikhawulo, iindawo ezibophako, iimmemezelo, imikhawulo yesikhathi nokukhutjhulwa koke kulungiswa njengemithetho, ukuze isistimu yinye isebenzele iinhlaka ezihlukeneko.
settings.no_rule_sets: Akukho masethi wemithetho alungisiweko. Ukuthumela kuzokuphumelela kungekho mithetho ehloliweko.
settings.severity_hint: Ukutlhileka kuvimbela ukuthumela; isiyeleliso siyaphawula kwaphela.
settings.framework_hint: Ngamarekhodi wakho kwaphela — akukho lutho oluthatha isiqunto kilokhu.
settings.message_hint: Amezwi wakho athatha indawo yalawo wesistimu.

rule_types.REQUIRED_DOCUMENT: Amatlhogomiso abaliweko kufanele anamathiselwe begodu abe khona

settings.chains_explainer: Iketani lihlathulula bona lisebenza nini. Ukufana okuqondileko kuyaphumelela, ukuze isibawo esifanako sikhambe ngendlela efanako qobe.
settings.is_default: Sebenzisa nangabe kungekho elinye iketani elivumelanako
settings.is_default_hint: Linye elisisekelo ngesihloko ngasinye lenza soke isibawo sibe nendlela.
settings.retire_chain_body: Iketani liyekela ukuthumela iimbawo ezitjha. Iinqunto esezithethiwe ngalo zibulunga irekhodi lazo, begodu akukho okusevunyiweko okutjhugulukako.
settings.code_locked_hint: Ikhowudi ikhomba leketani begodu ayikwazi ukutjhugululwa.
settings.steps_hint: Ukuvunywa kwenzeka ngalendlela. Tjhugulula ihlelo ngemisebe.
settings.single_approver_hint: Umuntu munye obaliweko usayina lesi sinyathelo.
settings.preference_explainer: Iinhlaka zokukhetha zinquma bona umnikeli uthola malini ngaphandle kwenani. Ifomula yenani ibekwe mthetho; amaphuzu abekwa mthethokambiso wakho, ngalokho itafula elifakiweko lisithomo bekube kulapha uliqinisekisa.
settings.fx_basis_hint: Ngiliphi ilanga izinga lokutjhugulula elimadanisa iimbawo ngemali ehlukeneko.
settings.fx_basis_submission_warning: Ukutjhugulula isibawo ngasinye ngelanga laso lokuthumela kutjho bona iimbawo ezimbili ezifanako zingaba neenkhundla ezihlukeneko ngebanga lokufika ngamalanga ahlukeneko.
settings.fx_rate_type_hint: Kuvumelana nohlobo olubulungwe ku-Finance, kanengi yi-spot.
settings.framework_no_bands: Akukho mabhentji abekiweko. Akukho okuzokunikelwa ngaphasi kwalehlaka bekube kulapha abekwa.
settings.retire_framework_body: Ihlaka liyekela ukunikelwa emathendeni amatjha. Amathenda asele anikelwe amaphuzu ngalo abulunga irekhodi lawo.
settings.basis_hint: Amaphuzu anikela umklomelo; umkhawulo unikela inzuzo yenani esikhundleni salokho.
settings.framework_notes_hint: Lokhu kusekelwe kuphi, nananyana yini esatlhoga ukuqinisekiswa.
settings.bands_hint: Kuhlolwa ngokulandelana; ibhentji lokuthoma umnikeli avumelana nalo ngilo elisebenzako.
settings.confirm_verified: Ngiyaqinisekisa bona iinombolo lezi zivumelana nomthethokambiso wethu wokuthenga owamukelweko
settings.confirm_verified_hint: Kutlolwa ngaphasi kwebizo lakho. Ukulungisa iinombolo ngemva kususa lokhu bekube kulapha kunikelwa godu.
settings.confirm_verified_note: Ihlaka leli lizokuphawulwa njengeliqinisekisiweko, ngebizo lakho, nawubulungako.

portal.local_content: Isibawo lesi sihlangabezana nesitlhogo sokuqukethwe kwendawo
portal.confirm: Ngiyaqinisekisa bona isibawo lesi silungile begodu singeniswe ebizweni lekampani ebalwe ngehla
portal.confirm_hint: Nasingenisiwe, isibawo sakho siyavalwa begodu asikwazi ukutjhugululwa. Thintana nesikhulu sokuthenga nangabe utlhoga ukusitjhugulula.
portal.closed_warning: Ithenda le sele ivaliwe. Usengathumela, kodwana isibawo sakho sizokutlolwa njengesiphuzileko begodu kusekomidini bona sicatjangelwe na.
portal.received_body: Sihlala sivaliwe bekube kulapha ithenda ivalwa, bese sivulwa kunye nazo zoke ezinye iimbawo ziinkhulu ezimbili.
portal.received_late: Isibawo sakho samukelwa ngemva kwesikhathi sokuvala
portal.received_late_body: Sitlolwe njengesiphuzileko. Bona isibawo esiphuzileko singacatjangelwa na kunqunywa likomidi ngokwemithetho yalo.
portal.receipt_hint: Sibulunge. Sikhomba isibawo sakho ngaphandle kokusembula.
portal.footer: Kuthunyelwe nge-Mkhaya Hub. Ikhonkco leli ngelakho wedwa — ungalabelani nabanye.

intake.explainer: Abanikeli abamenyiweko bathumela ngesixhumanisi sabo. Iimbawo zihlala zivaliwe bekube kulapha ithenda ivalwa, bese zoke zivulwa ndawonye ziinkhulu ezimbili.
intake.invite_hint: Kwenza isixhumanisi sangasese salo mnikeli. Msithumele — kuphela indlela yakhe yokungena.
intake.link_once: Kutjengiswa kanye. Sikopishe nje — angeze sitjengiswe godu.
intake.withdraw_body: Isibawo esivaliweko siyasuswa ukuze lo mnikeli akwazi ukuthumela godu. Kokubili ukuhoxiswa nesibawo esitjha kuhlala emkhondweni wokuhlola.
intake.opening_explainer: Zoke iimbawo ezivaliweko zivulwa kunye, nguwe nofakazi. Ukuvula kwenzeka kanye begodu angeze kubuyiselwe emva.
intake.open_warning: Soke isibawo esivaliweko siyafundeka kilomzuzu, begodu angeze kubuyiselwe emva. Ragela phambili kwaphela nangabe ufakazi wakho akhona.
intake.witness_hint: Umuntu wesibili, okhona ekuvulweni, otlolwe ethendeni.

analytics.title: Ukuhlaziya kokuthenga
analytics.subtitle: Bona imojula yoke isebenza njani, ingasi nje bona isebenzise malini
analytics.median_hint: Esiphakathi, ukuze icala linye elimileko lingaphazamisi
analytics.pipeline_hint: Lapha umsebenzi uwela khona hlangana nokuhlela nokuvala.
analytics.competition_hint: Iphethini yamathenda anesibawo sinye siphawu esikhanyako kilokhu.
analytics.bottlenecks_hint: Ngesinyathelo, ngombana iketani liyariyada nangabe isihlalo sinye siriyada.
analytics.awards_hint: Ngubani owawina ukunikelwa okungu-{n}, nangaphasi kwemiphi imithetho.
analytics.trend_hint: Isamba sitjho bona ukuphi; uhlelo lutjho bona uya kuphi.

budgets_approvals.title: Ukuvunywa kwamabhajedi
budgets_approvals.subtitle: Iinqunto ezikulindeleko, nalokho okulindeleko wena.
budgets_approvals.reject_reason_hint: Umuntu okuthumele uyakubona lokhu, ngakho sho bona yini okumele ishintshe.
budgets_approvals.confirm_approve_body: Ukuvuma “{label}” kuhambisa imali yangempela. Lokhu kuqoshwa egameni lakho.
budgets_approvals.covering_notice: Okunye kwalokhu kulapha ngoba umela ukuvuma kuka-{names}.
budgets_approvals.given_sub: Ubani ophethe ukuvuma kwakho kwezabelomali ngesikhathi ungekho. Bengezwa njengomgunyazi — usengaquma nanyana yini wena.
budgets_approvals.received_sub: Ukuvuma kukabani ongakunquma, kuze kube nini.
budgets_approvals.delegate_sub: Omunye umuntu angaquma ukuvuma kwakho kwezabelomali isikhathi esithile.
budgets_approvals.delegate_notice: Ukumela kungeza umvumi kunokudlulisa ilungelo, ngakho usengaquma nanyana yini wena. Ukwehlukanisa imisebenzi kusasebenza: akekho ongagunyaza lokho okuthunyelwe nguwe.
budgets_approvals.no_cover: Akekho okucele ukuba umele ukuvuma kwakhe.
budgets_approvals.confirm_end_delegation_body: {to} akasakwazi ukunquma ukuvuma kwakho. Iinqunto asezenzile azishintshi.
budgets_approvals.hint_from_user: Shiya kunguwe ngaphandle uma uhlelela omunye umuntu.
budgets_approvals.hint_ends_on: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kungabi nasiphelo, isb. isikhundla esingenamuntu.

budgets_approval_setup.title: Ukudluliselwa kokuvunywa kwamabhajedi
budgets_approval_setup.subtitle: Ubani osayina ini, kule nkampani.
budgets_approval_setup.default_notice: Ngaphandle kokudluliswa okuhleliwe, zoke iinqunto zesabelomali zisema emgqeni — futhi nanyana ubani ongagunyaza amabhajedi angakunquma. Hlela indlela lapha uma ufuna ileli elithile, umthetho wamasiginesha amabili, nanyana umkhawulo lapho ngezansi kwawo kungadluliswa lutho.
budgets_approval_setup.no_hr_notice: Ayikho imojula ye-HR efakiwe, ngakho isinyathelo esibekwe ku-“imenenja yothumelayo” asikwazi ukwaneliswa muntu. Sebenzisa indima nanyana umuntu oqanjiwe kunalokho.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_adjustment: Ukunyusa, ukwehlisa nanyana ukudlulisa kwesabelo esikhona.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_reservation: Izimali ezibanjelwe ibhajedi ngaphambi kokuba kube ne-oda lokuthenga.
budgets_approval_setup.confirm_delete_body: “{name}” ngeke isadlulisa lutho. Akukho okuvele kunqunyiwe okushintshayo.
budgets_approval_setup.confirm_delete_pending: “{name}” isenezinqumo ezingu-{count} emgqeni. Lezo zigcina ileli lazo nomlando wazo; akukho okusha okuzodluliswa ngayo.
budgets_approval_setup.steps_hint: Likhwelwa ngokulandelana. Qamba abantu ngomthetho lapho ungakwazi — indima iyaphila nanyana umuntu ehamba.
budgets_approval_setup.allow_self: Vumela umuntu othumele bona agunyaze lesi sinyathelo

budgets_tracking.title: Ukulandelela amabhajedi
budgets_tracking.subtitle: Bona zimi kanjani zoke amabhajedi, yini esiyikhathaza, nokuthi yini emisiwe.
budgets_tracking.position_hint: Okuboshiwe kufaka lokho okubekelwe nokukhiyiwe, hhayi kuphela lokho osekukhokhelwe nge-invoyisi.
budgets_tracking.rules_subtitle: Bona le nkampani ifuna ukwaziswa nini, nokuthi ifuna ukumiswa nini.
budgets_tracking.block_notice: Umthetho oVimbayo kuphela owenqabayo. Uphoqelelwa lapho izimali zibekelwa nanyana ziboshwa khona, hhayi kuleli khasi kuphela.
budgets_tracking.no_rules: Ayikho imithetho okwanje. Amabhajedi ezidlulayo zisabikwa.
budgets_tracking.confirm_delete_rule_body: “{name}” uyeka ukubuka. Iinyeleliso esezivele ziphakanyisiwe zixazululwa ekuhloleni okulandelayo.
budgets_tracking.ack_hint: Okwenziwayo ngakho. Isiyeleliso sihlala sisebenza kuze kuphele isimo.

budgets_insights.analytics_sub: Bona imali ibekwe kanjani, iyaphi, nokuthi yini elindele isiqunto.
budgets_insights.truncated: Kubonisa imigqa engu-500 yokuqala. Ukuthunyelwa kwe-CSV kunayo yoke.

report_sources.budgets: Kuqoshwa lapho ibhajedi sidalwa, ku-Amabhajedi › Ibhajedi Elitjha.
report_sources.ledger: Kususelwa encwadini yamabhuku yokubekelwa, ukubopha nokusetshenziswa kwemali.
report_sources.reservations: Kubhalwa lapho isicelo sokuthenga sigunyazwa, nanyana kufakwe ngesandla esabelweni.
report_sources.commitments: Kubhalwa lapho i-oda lokuthenga likhishwa, nanyana kufakwe ngesandla esabelweni.
report_sources.consumptions: Kubhalwa lapho i-invoyisi nanyana i-GRN ipositwa, nanyana kufakwe ngesandla esabelweni.
report_sources.adjustments: Kuphakanyiswa esabelweni njengokunyusa, ukwehlisa nanyana ukudlulisa.
report_sources.overrides: Kuphakanyiswa esabelweni lapho umuntu ecela ukusebenzisa imali ngaphesheya kwesabelo.
report_sources.approvals: Zoke iinqunto ezidluliselwe, zisuka emgqeni wokugunyaza.
report_sources.alerts: Kuphakanyiswa ukuhlolwa kwasebusuku ngokwemithetho yezexwayiso yale nkampani.
report_sources.phasing: Kutholakala kuthebhu yokuHlukaniswa kwesabelomali ngasinye: iinkhathi ezivaliweko ezidlula umkhawulo womehluko womnyaka, nesizathu sokobana ngasinye senzeke ngaphandle kwehlelo laso.

chart.spend_empty: Ayikho imali eqoshiwe okwanje. Ifika lapho i-invoyisi ipositwa, nanyana lapho umuntu eyiqopha esabelweni.
chart.cycle_sub: Amahora amaphakathi kusukela ekuthunyelweni kuya esinqumweni, ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezedlule.

budgets_planning.title: Ukulungiselela amabhajedi
budgets_planning.subtitle: Dlulisela unyaka, ngenisa owodwa usuka kwispredishithi, uvale lowo osuphelile.
budgets_planning.years_sub: Ukwabiwa ngezikhathi kudinga izikhathi; unyaka ongenazo awunalo uhlelo lokuqhathanisa nokusetshenziswa kwemali.
budgets_planning.no_periods_hint: Azikho izikhathi ezichaziwe. Zakhe Kumasethingi ukuze amabhajedi zabiwe ngezikhathi.
budgets_planning.confirm_close_body: Amabhajedi ku-{name} zivalwa kanye nawo. Ukubopha osekwenziwe kusadinga ukukhokhelwa nge-invoyisi.
budgets_planning.mode_allocation_hint: Unyaka olandelayo uqala ngenani lalo nyaka — indawo evamile yokuqala umjikelezo omusha.
budgets_planning.mode_unspent_hint: Unyaka olandelayo uqala ngalokho obekusatholakala. Amabhajedi ezingenalutho ziyeqiwa.
budgets_planning.carry_notice: Konke kufika njengoluhlaka. Akukho okusebenzayo kuze kube khona ogunyazayo.
budgets_planning.import_sub: I-CSV, isuka ngqo kwispredishithi umjikelezo oqale kuso.
budgets_planning.import_notice: Imigqa ihlolwa ngamunye. Umugqa ombi ubikwa ngenombolo yomugqa; emihle isangeniswa, njengezinhlaka.
budgets_planning.template_sub: Yona kanye ifayela elifundwa umngenisi, nemigqa emibili yesibonelo egcwalisiwe.
budgets_planning.hint_target_year: Woke amabhajedi kufayela zidalwa kulo nyaka.
budgets_planning.hint_file: I-CSV kuphela, kufika ku-5 MB. Londoloza njenge-“CSV UTF-8” ku-Excel.
budgets_planning.how_1: Umugqa wokuqala kumele ube ngowesihloko. Amagama afaniswa ngaphandle kokunaka onobumba abakhulu futhi izikhala ziba ngama-underscore, ngakho “Allocated Amount” no-“allocated_amount” kuyikholomu efanayo.
budgets_planning.how_2: Ukulandelana kwamakholomu akunandaba, futhi amakholomu ongawadingi angashiywa ngokuphelele efayeleni.
budgets_planning.how_3: Umugqa ngamunye uhlolwa wodwa. Umugqa ohlulekayo ubikwa ngenombolo yawo yomugqa efayeleni futhi weqiwe — eminye isangeniswa.
budgets_planning.how_4: Konke kufika njengoluhlaka. Akukho okusebenzayo, futhi akukho okungena emgqeni wokugunyaza kuze kube khona okuthumelayo.
budgets_planning.how_5: Inani umngenisi angalazi — isigaba esibhalwe ngokungeyikho nanyana uhlobo lokusetshenziswa kwemali — alenzi umugqa uhluleke. Libuyela kokuzenzakalelayo bese libhalwa njengesexwayiso ngemuva.
budgets_planning.how_6: Akukho okuhlungwayo kabili. Ukulayisha ifayela elifanayo kabili kudala amabhajedi kabili, ngakho ngenisa ifayela elilungisiwe onyakeni omusha nanyana qala ususe izinhlaka.
budgets_planning.col_help_name: Igama lesabelomali, isb. “Izinsiza zeHhovisi Eliyinhloko”. Igama elingenalutho lenza umugqa uhluleke.
budgets_planning.col_help_allocated_amount: Inombolo. Izimpawu zemali, izikhala nabahlukanisi bezinkulungwane bayasuswa, ngakho “R 1 850 000,00” no-“1850000” kokubili kuyasebenza. Nanyana yini engeyona inombolo yenza umugqa uhluleke.
budgets_planning.col_help_expenditure_type: Ibuyela ku-opex uma kungenalutho nanyana kungaziwa.
budgets_planning.col_help_category: Kumele kufane nelinye lamagama ezigaba angezansi. Igama elingafani lishiya ibhajedi singenasigaba futhi liphakamise isiyeleliso.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_type: Ibuyela kokujwayelekile uma kungenalutho nanyana kungaziwa.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_label: Umbhalo okhululekile oqamba umnyango, iphrojekthi nanyana indawo yezindleko, isb. “Ihhovisi Eliyinhloko”.
budgets_planning.col_help_currency: Ikhodi yezinhlamvu ezintathu njenge-ZAR. Nanyana yini enye iyaziwa futhi kusebenza okuzenzakalelayo kwenkampani.
budgets_planning.categories_hint: Upelo lufaniswa ngaphandle kokunaka onobumba abakhulu, kodwana igama kumele libe yilona kanye ngaphandle kwalokho.
budgets_planning.categories_none: Azikho izigaba okwanje. Zengeze ngaphansi kwe-Lungiselela › Amasethingi, nanyana ushiye ikholomu yesigaba ingenalutho.

supplier_registration.documents_after: Ungawalayisha esangweni lakho lomhlinzeki uma leli fomu selithunyelwe.
