rules.delete_body: Umthetho weenyanga ezingu-{months} uyeka ukuveza izaziso ezitjha. Lezo eseziveziwe ziyagcinwa.

document_management.title: Documents
document_management.subtitle: Indawo yinye yamadokhumende wehlangano, nazo zoke iinhlelo zibulungiwe.
document_management.dropzone_label: Yehlisa amafayela lapha namkha cindezela ukukhetha amafayela
document_management.drop_here: Yehlisa amafayela lapha, namkha cindezela ukukhetha
document_management.drop_hint: Bekufike kumafayela angu-{count} ngesikhathi, {max} MB linye
document_management.rejected_count: Kungalayitjhwa amafayela angu-{max} kwaphela ngesikhathi sinye.
document_management.notes_hint: Amanothi wangaphakathi. Akatjengiswa nanyana ngubani ngaphandle kwemoduli le.

document_management.search: Seka — zama “i-inshorense yomnikeli ephela hlangana kwamalanga angu-30”
document_management.held_cannot_delete: Kungaphasi kokubanjwa ngokomthetho — angekhe kususwe bekube kususwe ukubanjwa.
document_management.versions_help: Ukutjhugulula ifayela kubulunga idokhumende leli nakho koke okukilo. Iinhlelo zangaphambili zihlala zifundeka.
document_management.change_note_hint: Umugwalo malungana nokhunye okuhlukileko kuhlelo lesi.
document_management.history_help: Koke okwenzekileko kudokhumende leli, kufaka hlangana bona ngubani olivulileko.
document_management.sensitivity_help: Ukutjhugulula nanyana ngikuphi kwalokhu kutlolwa nebizo lakho.
document_management.sensitivity_note_hint: Kubayini kutjhwayilwe — kusiza nange umuntu abuza kade.
document_management.remove_help: Ukubulunga kuyabuyiselwa. Ukususa kungahlehliswa bekube idokhumende libhujiswe kokuphela.
document_management.hold_explainer: Idokhumende leli lingaphasi kokubanjwa ngokomthetho. Angekhe lisuswe nange lokho kusendaweni.
document_management.archived_explainer: Idokhumende leli libulungiwe. Lisafundeka begodu lingabuyiselwa.

settings_page.title: Iinlungiselelo zamadokhumende
settings_page.subtitle: Okungalayitjhwa lapha, ubukhulu obungakanani, nokuthi amadokhumende abizwa njani.
settings_page.max_size_hint: Kusebenza kufayela ngalinye, ingasi kukoke ukulayitjha.
settings_page.types_help: Irherho lokuvumela. Nanyana yini enganakho kilo iyaliwa.
settings_page.blocked_hint: Zisuswa erherhweni elivumelekileko nanyana zikhona kilo.
settings_page.never_help: Lezi ziyaliwa nanyana ngabe kulungiselelwe njani. Isiphequluli namkha iseva ingazisebenzisa, begodu ilayibhrari yamadokhumende ayinasizathu sokwamukela okhunye.
settings_page.categories_hint: Bona idokhumende liyini, ngokuhlukileko kokuthi lifayilwe kuphi. Iingaba ezakhiweko zingabizwa godu namkha zivalwe kodwana azisuswa — imibiko nemithetho yokubulunga ikhombisa kizo.
settings_page.category_protected: Iingaba ezakhiweko angekhe zisuswe. Kunalokho zivale.
settings_page.expiry_hint: Yelelisa abantu ngaphambi kobana idokhumende liphele. Ukutjhanela kusebenza qobe ekuseni begodu kuthumela isikhumbuzo ngasinye kanye.
settings_page.expiry_days_hint: Cindezela u-enter ngemva kwenani ngalinye. U-0 utjho ngelanga lokuphela ngokwalo.
settings_page.expiry_roles_hint: Umnikazi wedokhumende uyaziswa qobe. Iindima, ingasi amabizo, ukwenzela isikhumbuzo silandele nanyana ngubani ophethe umsebenzi.
settings_page.retention_hint: How long documents in this category are kept. Leave the period empty for no schedule — nothing is ever destroyed automatically.
settings_page.retention_note_hint: Shown beside the disposal queue, so a reviewer can see what the rule is for.
settings_page.sharing_warning: With this on, anybody holding a share link can open that document without signing in. Each link still expires, can be revoked, and is recorded.
settings_page.sharing_enabled: Allow documents to be shared outside the organisation
settings_page.share_max_days_hint: The ceiling for any link. Somebody asking for longer gets this.
settings_page.ai_warning: With this on, the contents of a document are sent to the AI provider this platform is configured with, and count against the company’s monthly allowance.
settings_page.ai_enabled: Allow summaries and questions about documents
settings_page.ai_include_confidential: Include confidential and legally held documents
settings_page.ai_include_confidential_hint: Off by default. These are the documents an organisation is least willing to hand to an outside service.
settings_page.watermark_default_hint: Each share can still be changed individually. A watermark makes a leaked copy traceable; it does not prevent one.
settings_page.auto_delete_warning: With this on, documents a reviewer has approved for disposal are deleted without further confirmation. Deletion here is recoverable — permanent destruction always stays with a person.
settings_page.disposal_grace_days_hint: How long an approval waits before it is acted on, so a mistake can be caught.
settings_page.automation_hint: What this category does on its own once the dates above have passed.
settings_page.archive_after_years_hint: Counted from the same date as the retention period
settings_page.auto_delete: Delete automatically once a disposal is approved
settings_page.auto_delete_hint: Needs the company-wide setting as well. Documents under legal hold are never touched.
settings_page.categories_delete_consequence: Only possible while nothing is filed under it.
settings_page.category_fields_hint: Lokho lolu hlobo lomtlolo olukuthwele ngaphandle kwalokho okujayelekileko. Isivumelwano sitlhoga omunye osivumelene naye; irisidi ayitlhogi litho.
settings_page.category_workflow_hint: Bona "imithethokambiso iya kwabomthetho" kube yinto yemithethokambiso kunokukhunjulwa ekulayitjheni ngakunye.
settings_page.numbering_next_hint: Kubeke bona uragele phambili usukela kuspredishithi kunokuthoma godu ku-1.
settings_page.numbering_pattern_hint: Iindawo: {YYYY} {YY} {MM} ne-#### yokulandelana. Kutjhiye kunganalitho ukusebenzisa iinomboro zekampani.
settings_page.watermark_confidential: Soke isikhathi faka uphawu emitlolweni eyifihlo
settings_page.watermark_previews_hint: Ukufunda kwaphela kuvimbela ukulayitjha kodwana akwenzi litho ngesithombe seskrini. Uphawu olutjho bona ngubani obekaqala ngikho kwaphela okwenzako.
settings_page.downloads_days_hint: Isikhathi umuntu agcina ngaso ikhophi ayivunyelweko.
settings_page.lock_hours_hint: Ngemva kwalokhu umtlolo uyazivula, ukuze kungabikho ovinjelweko mumuntu osekhefini.

document_management.folder_confidential_hint: Koke okufayilweko lapha kuphathwa njengokuyimfihlo, kufaka hlangana amafolda angaphasi.
document_management.folder_copy_hint: Amafolda angaphasi, amalungelo namadokhumende angaphakathi koke kukopiswa. Ikhophi nganye ifumana ifayela layo.
document_management.folder_delete_confirm: Susa "{name}"? Ifolda namafolda wayo angaphasi anganalitho ayasuswa.
document_management.folder_delete_blocked: Ifolda le iphethe amadokhumende angu-{count}. Awathuthele namkha uwabulunge qangi.
document_management.expiry_before_effective: Ilanga lokuphela lingaphambi kwelanga lokuthoma ukusebenza.
document_management.drag_hint: Drag a folder onto another to move it, or use the ⋮ menu.
document_management.expiry_blocking: Bamba umsebenzi ohlobeneko nange lokhu kuphela
document_management.expiry_blocking_hint: Kuvalwe ngaphandle nange uvula. Nange kubekiwe, iinqubo ezithembele kudokhumende leli — umnikeli othatha amabhuko amatjha, isibonelo — ziyabanjwa bekube kuvuselelwa.
document_management.expiry_banner_soon: Amadokhumende angu-{n} aphela hlangana kwamalanga angu-30.
document_management.restore_version_explain: Lokhu kungezelela ihlelo elitjha eliphethe ifayela le-{version}. Akunalitho elisuswako — ihlelo lanjesi lihlala emlandweni.
document_management.comment_required: Tjho bona kubayini, ukwenzela umtloli azi okufuze akutjhugulule.
document_management.approval_workflow_hint: Tjhiya njengombana kunjalo ukusebenzisa lelo elibekelwe isigaba lesi.
document_management.delegate_explain: Ukugunyazwa kudlulela kibo. Angekhe usakghona ukukuphendula.
document_management.templates_subtitle: Amadokhumende anemininingwana egcwaliswe kusuka kumarekhodi uhlelo osele unawo.
document_management.template_fields_hint: Cindezela kunye ukukubeka lapho isikhombisi sikhona.
document_management.template_unknown_list: Amakhambu la akakho begodu azokuphrintwa njengokutlolweko: {fields}
document_management.signatories_order_hint: Basayina ngehlelo lesi. Thuthela umugwalo ukutjhugulula lokho.
document_management.signature_fields_hint: Ngekhasi nangomuntu. Ukubeka ngqo ekhasini akukafumaneki.
document_management.holds_subtitle: What is being preserved, and for which matter
document_management.holds_pick_matter: Choose a matter to see what is held under it.
document_management.holds_release_warning: Once the last hold is lifted, this document can be deleted and destroyed again. The record that it was held is kept.
document_management.holds_close_matter_warning: This lifts every hold placed under {reference} — {n} document(s) at once.
document_management.disposal_subtitle: Documents whose retention period has run out
document_management.disposal_nothing_automatic: Nothing here is destroyed automatically. Each document waits for somebody to decide, and approving a disposal is not the same as carrying it out.
document_management.disposal_keep_explained: It stays, and comes up for review again at the end of its next retention period.
document_management.disposal_approve_explained: This records that it may be destroyed. Somebody with the destroy permission still has to carry it out.
document_management.disposal_note_hint: Why this was decided. It is kept with the document’s history.
document_management.disposal_queue_empty: Nothing has come due for review.
document_management.sharing_off: External sharing is switched off for this company.
document_management.share_none: This document has not been shared outside.
document_management.share_link_once: Copy this link now — it is not shown again.
document_management.share_warning: Anyone holding this link can open the document without signing in.
document_management.share_recipient_hint: Not a restriction — it records who it was meant for.
document_management.share_password_hint: Optional. Send it separately from the link.
document_management.share_allow_download_hint: Off means the document can be read but not saved.
document_management.shared_locked_hint: Enter the password you were given to open it.
document_management.ai_summary_caveat: Written by a model from the document’s text. Check anything you intend to act on against the document itself.
document_management.ai_question_hint: Answered only from this document’s text.
document_management.ai_unavailable: The assistant is not available for this document.
document_management.ai_disabled: The assistant is switched off for this company.
document_management.ai_confidential_excluded: This document is confidential or under legal hold, and this company has not allowed those to be sent to the assistant.
document_management.ai_no_text: There is no readable text in this document — it may be a scan that needs OCR.
document_management.ai_quota: This company’s monthly AI allowance is used up.
document_management.ai_failed: The assistant could not be reached. Try again shortly.
document_management.share_internal_none: Not shared with anybody beyond the usual folder access.
document_management.share_internal_hint: This opens the document to somebody who cannot otherwise see it. It does not change who can see anything else.
document_management.share_internal_expiry_hint: Leave empty to keep it open
document_management.activity_subtitle: Every recorded action on documents you can see
document_management.activity_recent: The last {days} days. Use the dates to look further back.
document_management.activity_document_gone: a document that has since been removed
document_management.extraction_no_text_layer: This looks like a scan. Its contents cannot be searched or summarised until it is put through OCR.
document_management.extraction_ocr_unavailable: This document needs OCR to be readable, and no OCR engine is installed on this server.
document_management.extraction_failed: The contents of this document could not be read. Searching will not find anything inside it.
document_management.ai_extract_fields: Read the details off this document
document_management.ai_fields_hint: Read by a model from the document text. Tick what is right — nothing is saved until you do.
document_management.ai_no_fields: Nothing could be read off this document.
document_management.ai_nothing_accepted: Tick at least one detail first.
document_management.ai_no_document: That document is no longer available.
document_management.share_watermark_hint: Stamps the recipient and date across each page. Not a security control — it makes a leaked copy traceable.
document_management.record_upload_hint: It is filed in the document library and linked to this record, so it can be found either way.
document_management.record_title_hint: Leave empty to use the file name
document_management.record_expiry_hint: Set this and the system will chase the renewal
document_management.record_none: Nothing filed against this record yet.
document_management.dashboard_subtitle: What needs attention, and what the repository holds
document_management.dashboard_nothing_expiring: Nothing is expiring in the next 30 days.
document_management.storage_subtitle: What is using space, and which files to look at first
document_management.dashboard_empty_hint: Once documents are uploaded, this page shows what is expiring, what is waiting on you, and what the repository holds.
document_management.view_shared-with-me_hint: Documents somebody gave you access to
document_management.view_archived_hint: Out of the way but still searchable, and restorable at any time
document_management.view_confidential_hint: Documents marked confidential, or filed in a confidential folder
document_management.view_legal-hold_hint: Being preserved for a matter. None of these can be deleted
document_management.view_expiring_hint: Due for renewal within the next 90 days
document_management.view_expired_hint: Past their expiry date and still on file
document_management.view_awaiting-approval_hint: Submitted and waiting for somebody to decide
document_management.view_awaiting-signature_hint: Sent out and not yet signed by everyone
document_management.view_unreadable_hint: Scans and files whose contents could not be read
document_management.access_title: You do not have access to this document
document_management.access_hint: Somebody sent you this link, but it has not been shared with you. You can ask for access.
document_management.access_reason_hint: Optional, but it is what the person deciding will read.
document_management.access_already: Your request has been sent. You will be able to open the document once somebody approves it.
document_management.access_requests_subtitle: People asking to be let in to a document or folder
document_management.access_folder_note: This grants the documents filed in that folder now. Anything added later is a new decision.
document_management.recycle_subtitle: Deleted documents stay here for {days} days and can be put back at any time
document_management.recycle_purge_warning: This destroys the document and every version of it. The record that it existed and was destroyed is kept, but the file cannot be recovered.
document_management.recycle_empty_warning: Everything removed here is destroyed permanently.
document_management.recycle_empty_counts: {purgeable} document(s) are past their window. {held} under legal hold will not be touched.
document_management.recycle_empty_everything: Include documents still within their window
document_management.recycle_empty_everything_hint: Off by default. Emptying normally means everything past its recovery window, not what somebody deleted this morning.
document_management.groups_subtitle: Give access to a set of people rather than to a list of names
document_management.groups_expires_hint: Optional. When it ends, every access it gave ends with it.
document_management.groups_member_expires_hint: Optional — for a secondee or somebody covering leave.
document_management.groups_no_folders: No folders given to this group yet.
document_management.groups_folders_hint: One set of permissions across all the folders you choose. That is what makes this one decision rather than several.
document_management.groups_access_expires_hint: Optional. Access with a date on it does not have to be remembered and revoked.
document_management.downloads_read_only_hint: Umtlolo lo ungafundwa lapha kodwana angeze ulayitjhwe.
document_management.downloads_read_only_folder: Ifayili le ngeyokufunda kwaphela, ngalokho amakhophi walokho okubulungwe kiyo akaphumi.
document_management.access_map_subtitle: Ngubani ongafinyelela kuni, kubayini, nalokuphelako ngokwakho.
document_management.access_map_ending_hint: Umnqopho wokufinyelela kwesikhathi esifitjhani kukuthi akekho okufuze akukhumbule. Kodwana kusafuze kube khona ongakubona.
document_management.access_map_look_up: Kubayini umuntu lo abona lokho akubonako?
document_management.access_map_checked_out_hint: Kunomuntu osebenza kiyo. Akakho omunye ongalayitjha ihlelo elitjha bekaqede.
document_management.requests_what_hint: Tjho into, ingasi ifayili — "Ikhophi ye-ID eqinisekisiweko" kunokuthi "iskena".
document_management.checklists_no_templates: Azikho iinhlobo zeemphuthulwana ezibekiweko. Uhlobo lwesiphuthulwana luhlu njengomthetho — "isiphuthulwana somsebenzi omutjha ngimitlolo elikhomba".
document_management.checklists_no_folder: Alikho ifayili elikhethiweko, ngalokho akunalitho elizozimaka.
document_management.checklists_expects_anything: Akunalitho elibekiweko ukufana — lokhu kumakwa ngesandla
document_management.checklists_chase_hint: Yoke into esesele iba sisibawo, ngesenzo sinye. Ukubawa nganye kulapho eyokugcina ikhohlwakala khona.
document_management.checklists_subject_hint: Umuntu, umnikeli, ithenda — nanyana ngiyiphi into lesi siphuthulwana esimayelana nayo.
document_management.checklists_folder_hint: Lapha imitlolo ihlala khona. Izinto ziyazimaka njengombana imitlolo efanako ibulungwa lapha.
document_management.checklists_template_hint: Bitha isiphuthulwana, ingasi umlandu — "Isiphuthulwana somsebenzi omutjha", ingasi "uThandi".
document_management.checklists_category_hint: Into enesigaba iyazimaka nangabe umtlolo waleso sigaba ubulungwa efayilini. Enganaso ingamakwa ngesandla kwaphela.
document_management.superseded_banner: Lo akusiwo umtlolo osebenzako. Utjhentjwe nge-{date}.
document_management.share_require_code_hint: Iphasiwedi ikhamba nge-imeyili efanako nesixhumanisi. Ikhodi ethunyelwe kilelo ikheli itjengisa bona ovulako unebhoksi lemeyili.
document_management.share_require_code_needs_email: Ngeza ikheli le-imeyili lomamukeli bona usebenzise lokhu.
document_management.shared_code_hint: Singathumela ikhodi ku-{email} ukuqinisekisa bona nguwe.
document_management.shared_code_sent_hint: Ikhodi ithunyelwe ku-{email}. Ihlala imizuzu elitjhumi nahlanu.
document_management.quotas_subtitle: Ngaphasi kwaleyo yekampani. Umnyango munye ozalisa yoke imvume umisa woke umuntu, yoke indawo.
document_management.quotas_none: Ayikho imikhawulo ebekiweko. Kusebenza kwaphela imvume yekampani.
document_management.quotas_warn_hint: Ukwaliwa ngaphandle kwesiyeleliso kufana nesistimu ephukileko.
document_management.access_map_refusals_hint: Ukwaliwa kunye sisixhumanisi esidala. Okulithoba ngeveke yingcoco.
document_management.access_map_downloads_hint: Ukulayitjha sikhathi lapho umtlolo ungasalawulwa yile sistimu.
document_management.access_map_heavily_granted_hint: Namtjhana bayakutlhoga, namtjhana kubuthelene ngasinye ngesikhathi. Inomboro kuphela kwendlela yokwazi.
document_management.shortcuts_hint: Indawo yesibili yokufumana umtlolo lo — ingasi ikhophi yesibili.
document_management.shortcuts_dialog_hint: Uhlala umtlolo munye. Ihlelo elitjha livela yoke indawo lapho ubulungwe khona, begodu iimvumo zawo azitjhentjhi.
document_management.access_ask_hint: Khetha koke okutlhogako ngasikhathi sinye. Ukubawa nganye kulapho okokugcina kukhohlwakala khona.
document_management.access_ask_reason_hint: Ophendulako kufuze anqophe okuthileko, begodu "akunasizathu esinikelweko" kutjhinga ekwaleni.
document_management.checklists_people_hint: Khetha oyedwa namtjhana abanengi — kuthonywa isiphuthulwana emuntwini ngamunye.
document_management.perm_manage_explainer: Somebody who administers a folder decides who else may use it. They cannot move it, delete it, or reach any other folder.
document_management.folder_permissions_subtitle: A group survives somebody joining or leaving. A list of names has to be revisited every time either happens.
document_management.folder_permissions_none: Nobody has been given this folder. Whether it is open depends on the folder's own kind.
document_management.folder_permissions_save_body: This replaces every rule on {name} with what is on screen.
document_management.folder_permissions_save_consequence: Anybody whose row you removed loses access as soon as this is saved.
document_management.groups_delete_consequence: Everyone in it loses every folder the group opened. The folders and their documents are untouched.
document_management.groups_remove_member_title: Take this person out of the group?
document_management.groups_remove_member_consequence: They lose every folder this group opens, unless something else gives it to them.
document_management.groups_revoke_folder_title: Take this folder off the group?
document_management.groups_revoke_folder_consequence: Everyone in the group loses it, unless something else gives it to them.
document_management.documents_delete_consequence: It goes to the recycle bin and can be restored until the bin is emptied.
document_management.templates_delete_consequence: Documents already generated from it are not affected.
document_management.quotas_remove_consequence: Storage there becomes unlimited again, up to the company's own allowance.
document_management.share_revoke_internal_body: {who} would no longer see this document.
document_management.share_revoke_internal_consequence: Unless they can reach it another way — through a folder, a role or a group.
document_management.share_revoke_link_consequence: It stops working immediately, including for anybody it was forwarded to.
document_management.access_map_revoke_body: {who} would lose it now rather than when it was due to end.
document_management.access_map_revoke_consequence: It cannot be undone from here — it would have to be granted again.
document_management.archive_contents_help: Vula ifayili yinye ngaphandle kokulanda yoke i-arkhayivu.
document_management.archive_unreadable: Le-arkhayivu ayikghonanga ukuvulwa. Kungenzeka yonakele namkha ivikelwe ngephasiwedi.
document_management.preview_failed: Ifayili le ayikghonanga ukutjengiswa lapha. Yilande esikhundleni salokho.

employee_reputation_dashboard.title: Ukuqalwa Kwedumela Nengozi Yomsebenzi
employee_reputation_dashboard.subtitle: Ukuqalwa okuvunyelweko kwelwazi LOMPHAKATHI eendabeni, ekhotho, kumlawuli, eenjezisweni, ebuhlalisaneni nemithonjeni yobukghwari — kubuyekezwa mumuntu.
employee_reputation_dashboard.disclaimer_body: Imojuli le iveza ilwazi LOMPHAKATHI elingaba qakathekile kanye nomongo, ukuzithemba nomthombo bona umuntu alibuyekeze. Ayenzi begodu ayikhuthazi imiphumela yokuqatjha, ukurhoxisa namtjhana yesiyalo. Ukufana kwebizo akusibo ubufakazi bobunikazi. Sebenzisa kwaphela ngemvume nangokuhambisana nomthetho wefihlo newabasebenzi.
employee_reputation_dashboard.by_domain_hint: Iimphawu zomphakathi zihlanganiswe ngendawo. Iindawo eziqalene nengozi ngezokubuyekezwa kwaphela, ingasi iziqunto.

employee_reputation_settings.title: Iimlungiselelo zokuqalwa kwedumela nengozi
employee_reputation_settings.subtitle: Hlela ukuqalwa okuvunyelweko okusebenzisa ilwazi lomphakathi kwaphela. Koke okufunyenweko kuvezwa bona kubuyekezwe mumuntu.
employee_reputation_settings.compliance_body: Vula ukuqalwa kwaphela lapha uvunyelweko begodu kuhambisana nomthetho wefihlo newabasebenzi. Kuqalwa ilwazi LOMPHAKATHI kwaphela — ingasi ama-akhawundi wangasese. Okufunyenweko kuyahlathululeka, kunamaphuzu wokuzithemba nomthombo, kuhlonipha isikhathi sokubulunga esingaphasi, kulawulwa ngokufinyelela begodu kuhlolwa ngokupheleleko, begodu akhenge kusetjenziselwe iziqunto zomsebenzi ezizenzakalelako.
employee_reputation_settings.consent_required: Tlhoga imvume / ivumo lomsebenzi ngaphambi kokuqalwa
employee_reputation_settings.consent_hint: Kuqalwa ilwazi lomphakathi kwaphela — ingasi ama-akhawundi wangasese. Ukubuyekezwa mumuntu kuyatlhogeka ngaphambi kwananyana ngisiphi isenzo.
employee_reputation_settings.negative_spike: Xwayisa ngomuzwa omumbi ku- namtjhana ngaphasi kwa-

factories.concepts: Ifektri, indawo yokugcina, umgca wokukhiqiza nesikhungo somsebenzi zizinto ezihlukeneko. Ifektri inekhalenda nemali; indawo yokugcina igcina isitoko; umgca yindlela edlula efektri; isikhungo somsebenzi sinamandla neendleko ngehora.
factories.none_hint: Yenza indawo yakho yokuthoma bona uthome ukuhlela iinkhungo zomsebenzi neemphande.
factories.warehouse_hint: Lapho isitoko sefektri le siya khona. Iindawo zokugcina zilawulwa ku-Finance.
factories.assign_hint: Umuntu onikelwe efektri uvalelwa kiyo. Angekhe abone ukuhlelwa, iinkhungo zomsebenzi namkha iimphande zenye ifektri ngaphandle kobana anikelwe nalapho.
factories.whole_factory_hint: Tjhiya kungenalitho bona unikele ifektri yoke, namkha ukhethe umnyango munye bona umvalele eenkhungweni zawo zomsebenzi.
factories.unrestricted: Akekho onikelwe lapha, ngalokho woke umuntu ofikelela kimojula le angayibona ifektri le. Nikela abantu bona ubavalele emafektrini abawaphethe.
factories.all_factories_note: Indima yakho ingabona woke amafektri, ngalokho ukunikela lokhu akutjhugululi lokho okubonako.

setup.remove_factory_deactivates: U-{name} uneenkhungo zomsebenzi ezinomlando wokukhiqiza, ngalokho uzokwenziwa angasebenzi kunokobana asulwe.

workcentres.title: Iinkhungo zomsebenzi
workcentres.subtitle: Amandla, amazinga weendleko, iindawo zokusebenzela nemitjhini
workcentres.none_hint: Yenza ifektri kuqala, bese ungezelela iindawo lapho imisebenzi yenzeka khona.
workcentres.unrated: Iinkhungo zomsebenzi ezi-{n} azinamandla namkha izinga leendleko, ngalokho angekhe zihlelelwe namkha zibalelwe iindleko.
workcentres.machine_hint: Imitjhini ivela erejisteni yeempahla, ngalokho iinomboro zesiriyali nomlando wokulungiswa kuhlala endaweni yinye.

shifts.title: Iimphande nokuvalwa
shifts.subtitle: Iindlela zokusebenza, imithetho yesikhathi esengeziweko nokuma okuhlelweko
shifts.overnight_hint: Isiphande lesi siphela ngaphambi kokuthoma. Nangabe sisebenza ebusuku boke, vula "Kuphela ngelanga elilandelako".
shifts.line_hint: Tjhiya kungenalitho nangabe ifektri yoke iyama
shifts.calendar_hint: Lokho ifektri engakusebenza qobe langa: iimphande, ngaphandle kwamalanga wokuphumula womphakathi, ngaphandle kokuvalwa.
shifts.calendar_none: Yenza ifektri nesiphande bona ubone ikhalenda yayo yokusebenza.

units.title: Amayunithi wokulinganisa
units.subtitle: Amayunithi, ubukhulu nokutjhugululwa okusebenzako
units.rule: Amayunithi atjhugululeka ngokukhululeka ngaphakathi kobukhulu bunye (kg kuya ku-g). Phakathi kobukhulu obuhlukeneko akwenzeki — iikhilogremu kuya kumalitha kuya ngento yokwenza, nepakethe iya ngento — ngalokho lokho kurekhodwa ngento ngayinye ngezansi.
units.conversions_hint: Ubudlelwano obungatjhuguluki bento yinye — ipakethe yeli-12, idramu yeelitha ezima-210
units.container_hint: Iinsitja azinabo ubukhulu bazo. Bona mangaki amayunithi asepakethe kuya ngento, ngalokho kurekhodwa ngento ngayinye ngezansi.

numbering.title: Ukunomboroliswa kwamadokhumende
numbering.subtitle: Ukulandelana kweenomboro zama-oda wokukhiqiza, imisebenzi namadokhumende
numbering.scope_hint: Tjhiya kungenalitho bona kube kulandelana kwekampani yoke
numbering.none_hint: Faka amayunithi nokulandelana okujayelekileko kusukela ekhasini lamaYunithi.

policies.title: Imigomo nokuvunywa
policies.subtitle: Imikhawulo yokwamukela, imithetho yokukhiqiza nemikhawulo yokuvuma
policies.blank_hint: Tjhiya umkhawulo wokwamukela ungenalitho bona kube "akukho okuhleliweko". Lokho kwehlukile ku-0%, okutjho bona woke umehluko kufanele uhlathululwe.
policies.require_bom_approval: Amabhili wezinto zokwenza atlhoga ukuvunywa ngomunye umuntu ongasi nguye owatlolako
policies.allow_negative: Vumela isitoko bona sibe ngaphasi kwequnu
policies.allow_over_issue: Vumela ukukhupha ngaphezu kwalokho i-oda elikutlhogako
policies.limits_hint: Ama-oda wokukhiqiza angaphezu kwenani elithile atlhoga ovumako ophezulu. Ibhendi ngayinye ihlanganisa ibanga lamanani wama-oda; zoke ndawonye kufanele zihlanganise woke amanani.
policies.blank_ceiling: Tjhiya kungenalitho bona kube "nakho koke okungaphezulu"
policies.limits_applies: Kuhlolwa nange i-oda lokukhiqiza livunywa, kusetjenziswa inani elilinganiselweko le-oda.
policies.approver_hint: Ngabantu abanemvumo le kwaphela abangavuma ama-oda asebhendini
policies.holders: Umuntu ongu-{n} unayo | Abantu abali-{n} banayo
policies.no_holders: Akekho onayo okwanje — ama-oda asebhendini le angekhe avunywe
policies.factory_hint: Amabhendi wefektri asetjenziswa ngaphambi kwalawo wekampani yoke
policies.escalate_hint: Khumbuza umphathi wovumako nangabe kulinda isikhathi esingaka
policies.summary: Ama-oda wokukhiqiza anenani elingu-{from} {to} {where} atlhoga ukuvunywa ngumuntu ongakghona “{who}”.

categories.title: Iingaba zemikhiqizo
categories.hint: Irhelo lapho kukhethwa khona iingaba. Isigaba esisetjenziswako siyalisiwa kunokobana sisulwe, ngalokho imikhiqizo efakwe ngaphasi kwaso iyasigcina.
categories.name: Isigaba esitjha
categories.none_yet: Akukabi neengaba. Ngezelela esinye bona uthome.

routings.title: Iindlela zokwenza
routings.subtitle: Indlela umkhiqizo ngamunye odlula ngayo efektri: imisebenzi, iinkhungo zomsebenzi, iinkhathi namasango
routings.none_hint: Tlola indlela yokwenza yomkhiqizo bona uthome.

routing.operations_hint: Ngokulandelana. Umsebenzi angekhe uqedwe bekube leyo ebophako ngaphambi kwawo, namasango wayo, idlulile.
routing.alt_run_hint: Tjhiya kungenalitho bona usebenzise isikhathi somsebenzi ngokwawo
routing.machine_type_hint: Esikhundleni sesikhungo somsebenzi: nanyana ngisiphi isikhungo esinomtjhini wohlobo lolu
routing.parallel_hint: Imisebenzi eneqembu elifanako isebenza ngesikhathi sinye
routing.locked_approved: Indlela yokwenza le ivunyiwe begodu angekhe ihlelwe. Yibuyekeze bona utjhugulule indlela umkhiqizo owenziwa ngayo — ama-oda asele akhutjhiwe ayaraga asebenzisa inguqulo le.
routing.discard_body: Indlela yokwenza yedrafti le nemisebenzi yayo izokususwa. Iinguqulo ezivunyiweko azithintwa nanini.
routing.estimate_hint: Lokho ukwenza ubunengi obuthile okutlhogako, kubalwe ngekhalenda yefektri.

orders.title: Ama-oda wokukhiqiza
orders.subtitle: Woke ama-oda, kusukela edraftini bekube kuvalwa
orders.new_hint: Libotjhelelwe ku-BOM nendlela yokwenza esebenzako ngelanga lalo lokuthoma
orders.none_hint: Yenza linye kusukela emkhiqizweni onebhili yezinto zokwenza evunyiweko.
orders.start_hint: Kuqunta bona ngiziphi iinguqulo ze-BOM nendlela yokwenza i-oda elizisebenzisako
orders.material_warehouse_hint: Lapho izinto zokwenza zikhutjhwa khona; indawo yokugcina okukhiqiziweko nangabe kungenalitho
orders.allow_below_min_batch: Vumela ubunengi obungaphasi kweqhemu elincani khulu lendlela yokwenza
orders.locked_closed: I-oda leli livaliwe. Amarekhodi walo akhiyiwe; ukulungiswa kwenziwa njengokulungiselela.
orders.checks_hint: Lokho ukuvuma okuqinisekisako, njengombana kunjalo khona nje
orders.checks_clear: Izinto zokwenza, i-BOM, indlela yokwenza namandla koke kulungile.
orders.no_operations: I-oda leli alinayo imisebenzi yendlela yokwenza.
orders.receive_output_hint: Esitokweni ngeendleko ezijayelekileko zezinto zokwenza; ekuhlukaniselweni nangabe ifektri ihlola ngaphambi kokubekwa
orders.output_hint: Okukhiqiziweko nokulahlekelwa kurekhodwa yifloro yomsebenzi ngesikhathi i-oda lisaqhubeka.
orders.approve_override_hint: Izinto zokwenza azaneli namkha amandla adlulisiwe. Ukuvuma ngaphandle kwalokho kurekhodwa njengokungajayelekileko nesizathu sakho.
orders.rescale_hint: Ubunengi obutjha butjhugulula izinto zokwenza, imisebenzi nokulinganiselwa
orders.lot_hint: Tjhiya kungenalitho bona kukhethwe okuphelelwa sikhathi kuqala
orders.over_issue: Lokhu kungaphezu kwalokho i-oda elisakutlhogako. Ukukhupha ngokudlulisileko kutlhoga ukweqa okugunyaziweko nesizathu ngaphandle kobana ifektri iyakuvumela.
orders.lot_number_hint: Ngokujayelekileko yinomboro ye-oda ({n}) yomkhiqizo olandelwa ngeqhemu
orders.quality_hold: Ukukhiqiza kumisiwe bekube ikhwalithi iqunta ngo-{list}.

quality.inspections_subtitle: Koke ukuhlolwa okusazokurekhodwa namkha kuqunywe, nalokho osele kuvaliwe
quality.search: Sesa inomboro, iqhemu namkha into yokwenza
quality.hold_hint: Kuthatha isitoko esisetjenziswako kusibambe; akukho okungasikhupha namkha kusithumele bekube kuqunyiwe
quality.supplier_hint: Kuyazikhethela: ihlelo lezinto zokwenza zomphakeli lo kwaphela

disposition_hint.CONDITIONAL_ACCEPT: Kusisebenzisa nanyana kunokutholakeleko. Kurekhodwa njengokuvumelana nesizathu sakho.
disposition_hint.REJECT: Kuthatha isitoko esibanjiweko kusise kokwaliweko; angekhe sakhutjhwa namkha sathunyelwa.
disposition_hint.RETURN_TO_SUPPLIER: Kwala isitoko ngokuqhathaniswa nomphakeli ne-oda lakhe lokuthenga.
disposition_hint.REWORK: Kubuyisela umsebenzi emuva; uyahlolwa godu ngemva kwalokho.

quality.held_alert: {qty} kubanjwe ku-{status} bekube ukuhlola lokhu kuqunyiwe.
quality.blocking_alert: Ukuhlola lokhu okwehlulekileko kumisa ukukhiqiza ku-oda lakho bekube umuntu ogunyaziweko uqunta okuzokwenzeka emsebenzini.
quality.record_hint_plan: Ukuhlola ngakunye kwahlulelwa ngemikhawulo yakho ngokuzenzakalela. Iimbonelo ezi-{n} ngokuhlola.
quality.record_hint_adhoc: Alikho ihlelo elisebenzako, ngalokho thiya ukuhlola ngakunye bewukwahlulele.
quality.decide_hint: Sisiqunto kwaphela esihambisa isitoko namkha esivumela ukukhiqiza bona kuqhubeke.
quality.certificate_required: Ihlelo leli litlhoga isetifiketi esifayilwe ngezansi ngaphambi kokobana isitoko sikhululwe.
quality.plans_subtitle: Okuhlolwako, ngamiphi imikhawulo, nalokho ukwehluleka okukumisako
quality.checks_hint: Isilinganiso esinemikhawulo, namkha uphawu lokudlula/lokwehluleka. Ukuhlolwa kugcina ikhophi yemikhawulo okurekhodwe ngayo.
quality.operation_hint: Kungenalitho: nanyana ngiyiphi indawo yokuhlola yomkhiqizo lo
quality.critical_hint: Kuqakatheke khulu: ukwehluleka lapha kuveza okungavumelaniko okukhulu
quality.ncrs_subtitle: Okungakahambi kuhle, kubayini, nalokho okukuvimbela bona kungenzeki godu
quality.search_ncrs: Sesa inomboro, ikhowudi yephutha namkha umtlolo
quality.repeat_defects_hint: Iinkhowudi zamaphutha ezivezwe kanengi emnyakeni odlulileko
quality.due_hint: Kungenalitho: amalanga ama-3, ali-7 namkha ama-21 ngobukhulu bephutha
quality.not_effective: Ukuqinisekisa kokugcina kufumene bona isenzo asikasebenzi. {notes}
quality.investigation_hint: Kuvimbele, fumana imbangela yakhona, bese wenza okuthile ngayo
quality.actions_hint: Ukuvimbela, ukulungisa nokuvikela, ngamunye unomnikazi nelanga lokugcina
quality.repeats_hint: Ikhowudi yephutha efanako entweni le namkha evela kumphakeli lo emnyakeni odlulileko
quality.no_code: Nikela i-NCR ikhowudi yephutha bona ukuphinda kubaleke.
quality.verify_hint: I-NCR ekhulu namkha eqakatheke khulu iqinisekiswa ngumuntu ongakenzi nesisodwa isenzo sayo.

floor.title: Ifloro yomsebenzi
floor.scan: Skena ikarada yomsebenzi, i-oda namkha iqhemu
floor.offline: Ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: okuthintiweko kuyagcinwa kuthunyelwe ngemva
floor.pause_hint: Nikela isizathu nangabe umsebenzi umile ngombana kukhona okungakahambi kuhle; kurekhodwa njengesikhathi sokuma.
floor.time_measured: Isikhathi somtjhini nesabasebenzi sithathwa esikhathini umsebenzi lo owenziwe ngaso.
floor.queued: Akukho ukuxhumana: kubulungiwe, kuzokuthunyelwa nange inethiwekhi ibuyile.
floor.downtime_subtitle: Koke ukuma, ngesikhungo somsebenzi nangesizathu, nokobana kubize imizuzu emingaki
floor.escalations_subtitle: Iimbizo zesizo ezivela ebaleni lomsebenzi. Ezingaphendulwako zikhuphukela ezingeni elilandelako ngemva kwesikhathi esibekwe yifekthri.

trace.title: Ukulandeleka
trace.subtitle: Funa ilothi, bese uyilandelela emuva emithonjeni yayo namkha phambili kikho koke ekungene kikho
trace.recalls_subtitle: Koke ukubuyiswa, okwakuhlanganisa nokuthi kwaphetha njani
trace.open_recall_hint: Kuhlanganisa ilothi le namalothi ali-{n} efikelela kiwo phambili.
trace.backward_hint: Izinto, amalothi nama-oda ilothi le eyenziwe ngawo, ukuya kumarasidi wabathumeli
trace.forward_hint: Amalothi ali-{n} afikelelwe, nalokho okusesitokweni nalokho okuphumileko
trace.untracked: {item} ingene ku-{order} ngaphandle kwelothi ({qty}); ayikwazi ukulandelelwa ngaphezulu.
trace.close_hint: Kwaphela kuphela lokha nakoke okubanjwe ngaphasi kokubuyiswa sekukhululiwe namkha kulahliwe.
trace.affected_hint: Angeniswe ngokuya ngokuthi akude kangangani ngemva kwelothi yomsuka

costing.standards_subtitle: Lokho umkhiqizo ngamunye okufanele ubize ukuwenza, nge-{currency}
costing.calculate_hint: Kusuka ku-BOM evunyiweko ne-routing esebenzako namhlanje; umphumela ngokusesalungiswa bekube kuvunywe
costing.lot_size_hint: Iindleko zokulungiselela nokujikeleza kweqhemu zabelwa inani leli
costing.approved_locked: Kuvunyiwe: iindleko ezijayelekileko lezi zirekhodi. Bala ihlobo elitjha bona uzitjhintjhe; ama-oda asele enziwe agcina lawa.
costing.output_line: Kubalelwe u-{qty}, kulindelwe okuphumako okuhle okungu-{out}; amahora wabasebenzi ali-{labour}, amahora womtjhini ali-{machine}.
costing.variances_subtitle: Ama-oda enziwe kusikhathi lesi ngokuqhathaniswa neendleko zawo ezijayelekileko, nge-{currency}. Okuphozithivu kumbi.
costing.profit_subtitle: Ukuthengisa okufakiweko ngokuqhathaniswa nalokho umkhiqizo okubize ukuwenza, nge-{currency}
costing.margin_not_final: Ezinye iindleko lapha zesikhatjhana namkha ziqagelwe, ngalokho umkhawulo wenzuzo akusiwo wokugcina.
costing.excluded: Ama-invoyisi ali-{n} ngenye imali akafakwanga; kubikwa kuphela i-{currency}:

maint.machines_subtitle: Imitjhini yokukhiqiza erejistarini yeempahla, njengombana ifekthri iyibona
maint.preventive_subtitle: Ama-oda womsebenzi enziwe ngekhalenda, ngamahora umtjhini owasebenza ngawo, namkha ngokuphuka okuphindaphindwako
maint.no_machines: Akunamtjhini onanyathiselwe esikhungweni somsebenzi okwanje. Wunamathisele ngaphasi kwe-Setup → Iinkhungo zomsebenzi.
maint.overdue_n: Ama-oda womsebenzi wokulungisa ali-{n} sekudlule isikhathi sawo
maint.fault_codes_hint: Ukuphuka kutlolwa ngekhowudu bona ukuphuka okuphindaphindwako kubalwe
maint.held_since: Ubanjiwe kusukela {at}: {reason}. Ibala lomsebenzi alikwazi ukuthoma umsebenzi esikhungweni esinemitjhini yoke ebanjiweko.
maint.rules_hint: Ngamunye wenza i-oda lomsebenzi lepahla nalifika isikhathi, kodwana angekhe enze elesibili nakusavulekile elinye
maint.hold_hint: Umtjhini obanjiweko angekhe usetjenziswe libala lomsebenzi bekube ubuyiselwe emsebenzini.
maint.release_hint: Qinisekisa ukuhlola okwenziweko ngaphambi kobana umtjhini usebenze godu. Ukulungiswa okuvulekileko kufanele kuqedwe kokuthoma.
maint.breakdown_hint: Imisa isikhungo somsebenzi ngebanga lokuphuka bese yenza i-oda lomsebenzi lokulungisa.
maint.tasks_hint: Umsebenzi owodwa elayinini ngayinye; aba yimisebenzi ye-oda lomsebenzi
maint.oee_subtitle: Ukutholakala × ukusebenza × ubunjalo, ngesikhungo somsebenzi. Nanyana yini engakwazi ukubalwa itjengiswa njengengekho, ingasi njenge-0% namkha i-100%.
maint.oee_inputs: {planned} min ehleliweko, {run} min isebenza, {stops} min yokuma okungakahlelwa; {good} okuhle ku-{total}.
maint.ideal_from_routing: Sebenzisa isikhathi sokusebenza se-routing somkhiqizo ngamunye njengesikhathi esifaneleko sokujikeleza
maint.exclude_planned: Ukuma okuhleliweko kususwa esikhathini sokukhiqiza esihleliweko

plan.mrp_subtitle: Sebenzisa ihlelo, ubuyekeze lokho elikutjengisako, uvume okufanele kwenzeke. Akukho okuthengwako ngaphambi kobana ukuvume.
plan.old_run: Lokhu kusetjenziswa kwakade. Iinqunto zenziwa kokwanje.
plan.recommendations_hint: Ukuvuma kwenza ama-oda wokukhiqiza nezicelo zokuthenga ezisesalungiswa zendlela evamileko yokuvuma.
plan.nothing_needed: Akukho okufanele kuthengwe namkha kwenziwe esikhathini lesi.
plan.items_hint: Qhwarhaza into bona ubone ukuqagelwa kwayo ngeviki nalokho okwenza ityebiso yayo.
plan.approve_hint: Ama-oda wokwenza aba ngokusesalungiswa efekthrini oyikhethileko; iincomo zokuthenga ziba zizicelo zokuthenga ezisesalungiswa, sinye somthumeli ngamunye.
plan.demand_subtitle: Ukuqagela eceleni kwama-oda aqinisekisiweko, ukukhiqiza ngobujamo, okuqakathekileko nomthwalo esikhungweni somsebenzi ngasinye
plan.products_legend: F ukuqagela, O ama-oda aqinisekisiweko, P ukukhiqiza okulindelekileko. Isitoko esiqagelweko sihlelela okukhulu phakathi kokuqagela nama-oda inyanga ngayinye; ukuqagela akhe kwengeze kuma-oda aqinisekisiweko.
plan.forecast_note: Kuhlelwa kuphela ngokuqagela okuvunyiweko, nalapho ama-oda aqinisekisiweko angakakuhlanganisi. Ukuqagela akhe kwenze i-oda lokuthengisa.
plan.suppliers_subtitle: Ukuthembeka kokuletha, ukwehluleka kobunjalo neentengo, kusuka kuma-oda wokuthenga, amarasidi nokuhlolwa
plan.prices_hint: Lokho umthumeli ngamunye akubizileko, ukutjhintjha ngokuqhathaniswa nomnyaka wabo odlulileko, nesikhathi sokulinda abasifikeleleko
plan.no_purchases: Akunama-oda wokuthenga abiza into le okwanje.
plan.params_subtitle: Indlela i-MRP ephatha ngayo into ngayinye
plan.params_legend: * kuthathwe kuphrofayili yento yendawo yokugcina. Kuzenzakalela: kuyenziwa nakune-BOM evunyiweko, ngaphandle kwalokho kuyathengwa.
plan.schedule_subtitle: Isikhathi sangaphambili esinomthamo onomkhawulo ngelanga: iimphande, ukulandelana kwe-routing, izinto, ukulungisa nokutjhintjhwako
plan.adherence_detail: Imisebenzi ili-{n} iqediwe; ukudlula okujayelekileko kumalanga ali-{slip}
plan.gantt_hint: Iimbha ezibomvu ziqeda ngemva kwelanga lazo lokugcina; ⇄ itjengisa isikhungo somsebenzi esitjhintjhwako.
plan.what_if_hint: Tjhintjha ilanga elithi-hayi-ngaphambili namkha okuqakathekileko, ubone umthelela, bese ukusebenzisa.

labour.roster_subtitle: Abasebenzi abahleliweko: abantu abaseemphandeni eenkhungweni zomsebenzi
labour.gaps_n: Amalanga ali-{n} lapho isikhathi sidinga abasebenzi abanengi kunabafakwe kurosta
labour.qual_subtitle: Lokho imisebenzi ekudingako kubasebenzisi bemitjhini, kufundwe emakghonweni we-HR, eenkghonakalisweni zokufunda nakumakghono we-SHEQ
labour.training_hint: Abantu abafakwe kurosta lapho lokhu kudingeka khona, abangakunawo namkha okuphelelwa sikhathi ngaphakathi kwamalanga ama-30
labour.source_note: Kugcinwe ku-HR, kusistimu yokufunda namkha ku-SHEQ; akukho okukopishwako. Imfuneko ebophako engekho namkha ephelelwe sikhathi ivimba ukwabelwa nokuthoma umsebenzi.
labour.labour_subtitle: Amahora ahleliweko ngokuqhathaniswa nawamambala, ngubani owasebenza okuthi, nabasebenzi isikhathi esisabadingako
labour.gaps_hint: Abasebenzi isikhathi esigciniweko esibadingako ngokuqhathaniswa nabafakwe kurosta
labour.no_gaps: Akukho okuhleliweko namkha okufakwe kurosta okwanje.

fulfilment.customer_subtitle: Amalayini we-oda lokuthengisa womkhiqizo owenziwa lapha: isitoko esibanjelwe wona, ukukhiqiza okwenzelwe wona, nokuthi isithembiso siyabambeka na. I-oda lokuthengisa ngokwalo lihlala ku-Finance.
fulfilment.eligible_hint: Amalayini we-oda lokuthengisa avulekileko wemikhiqizo eyenziweko. Ukuzibophelela kubamba isitoko esikhululekileko, kwemikhiqizo eyenziwa ngokwe-oda, kwenze i-oda lokukhiqiza elisesalungiswa lokhu okuseleko.
fulfilment.no_eligible: Akunamalayini we-oda lokuthengisa avulekileko wemikhiqizo eyenziwa lapha.

fulfilment.subcontract_subtitle: Umsebenzi othunyelwe kubathumeli: umsebenzi onikelwe abanye, namkha i-oda loke elenziwe ngezinto esizithumelako. Lokho okubuyako kuhlolwa ngaphambi kobana kusetjenziswe.
fulfilment.new_subcontract_hint: Khetha umsebenzi i-routing ewunikela abanye, namkha uwutjhiye ungenalutho bona umthumeli enze i-oda loke.
fulfilment.materials_hint: Kukhutjhelwe i-oda lokukhiqiza; izinto ezingasetjenziswanga zibuyela esitokweni.
fulfilment.receipts_hint: Irasidi ngayinye iyahlolwa ngaphambi kwegadango elilandelako namkha ngaphambi kobana isitoko sisetjenziswe.
fulfilment.receive_operation_hint: Umsebenzi ubuya kanye: nanyana yini engabuyiswanga itlolwa njengelahlekele kumthumeli.

loss.title: Okutholakeleko kokulahlekelwa
loss.subtitle: Okufunyenweko mahluko obonakeleko. Kuba kulahlekelwa kwaphela lokha umphenyi nakakuqinisekisa ngobufakazi, begodu ukonga kubalwa kwaphela lokha ubufakazi bakho nabuvunyiwe.
loss.subject: Okuthintekileko
loss.no_findings: Akukho okufunyenweko. Sebenzisa iimtholi, namkha wandise ihlungelo.
loss.evidence_hint: Amarekhodi umtholi awafundileko; wahlole emthonjeni wawo.
loss.needs_approval: Kudinga ukuvunywa ziinphathi ngaphambi kobana kuvalwe.
loss.rules_subtitle: Umtholi ngamunye uzwela kangangani. Okufunyenweko kwenziwa kwaphela lokha umkhawulo nawudlulwa nomthelela oqagelweko ufikelela kokuncani.

about.executive: Okuphumako, iindleko nomkhawulo wenzuzo, ukumoshwa, ukudlula isikhathi nokonga kwesikhathi lesi.
about.planning: Ihlelo liyalandelwa na, lithwele kangangani kuphi, begodu yini esilelako namkha edlulileko.
about.inventory: Okukhona nokusetjenziswako, okubanjelwe umuntu, nalokho okusengozini.
about.costs: Okujayelekileko ngokuqhathaniswa nokwamambala, nalapho umahluko uvela khona.
about.quality: Iimphoso nokulandelelwa kwazo, nokuthi imitjhini itholakala kangangani.

reports.nothing_visible: Iimvumo zakho azihlanganisi nanyana ngiyiphi inomboro kudeshibhodi le.

alerts.rules_subtitle: Ngohlobo ngalunye lwesehlakalo: ngubani otjelwako, kanjani, kusesenesikhathi kangangani, nokuthi ngubani ozwako nakungenzeki litho. Ifekthri ingaba nomthetho wayo; ngaphandle kwalokho kusebenza umthetho wekhampani yoke.
alerts.log_subtitle: Ilayini linye ngomuntu ngamunye ngesixwayiso ngasinye. Ukuphindwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi sokuthula kuyabalwa, akuthunyelwa; isixwayiso siyazisusa lokha imbangela yaso nayiphelako.

assistant.title: Umsizi wokukhiqiza
assistant.subtitle: Yoke inomboro ibalwa emarekhodini wekhampani yakho, kunesikhathi nemithombo yayo. I-AI ibeka ipendulo ngamagama kwaphela; ayikhe inikele inomboro.
assistant.placeholder: Buza ngomahluko, ama-oda adlulileko, ukuma, izinto, abathumeli, okulahlwako, imikhawulo yenzuzo namkha iindleko…
assistant.worded_by_ai: Kubekwe ngamagama yi-AI kusuka eenomborweni ezingezansi; kuhlolwe bona akunazinye iinomboro.
assistant.start: Khetha umbuzo ongehla namkha utlole owakho.
assistant.needs_approval: Lokhu kutjhintjha ukuthenga namkha ukukhiqiza. Kuphakanyiswa lapha kwaphela, begodu omunye umuntu onemvumo efaneleko kufanele akuvume.
assistant.recommendations_subtitle: Koke umsizi akunconileko, okwalungiswa kusuka kikho, ngubani owakuvuma, nokuthi isilinganiso sanyakaza njani ngemva kwalokho.

accounting.rules_subtitle: Isehlakalo sokukhiqiza ngasinye nalokho esikwenzako emabhukwini. Akukho okufakwa ngokuzenzakalela ngaphasi kwendlela engakavunywa; indlela emisiweko iyamisa isehlakalo.
accounting.change_hint: Ukutjhintjha kubuyela kokusesalungiswa bekube omunye umuntu akuvume.
accounting.tx_subtitle: Isehlakalo sokukhiqiza ngasinye esiqakathekileko ezokubalabala, ukunyakaza kwaso kwesitoko nejenali yaso. Ukubuyiselwa emuva malayini amatjha; akukho okulungiswako.
accounting.reverse_hint: Ukunyakaza okuphikisako nejenali kuyafakwa; kokuthoma kuhlala kurekhodi. Ama-oda avaliweko alungiswa ngokulungisa esikhundleni salokho.

audit.title: Umkhondo wokuhlola
audit.subtitle: Koke ukutjhintjha kurekhodi lokukhiqiza: ngubani namkha yiyiphi indlela yesistimu eyakwenzako, nini, namanani ngaphambili nangemva. Kwekhampani le kwaphela, nefekthri ovumelekileko ukuzibona kwaphela.

multi.transfers_subtitle: Isitoko esinyakaza phakathi kwamafekthri wekhampani le. Nasisendleleni sibanjelwa lapho siya khona, ngalokho akakho osebenzisa lokho okungakafiki. Ukunyakazisa isitoko phakathi kweendawo zokugcina akufaki ijenali.
multi.suggestions_hint: Izinto ifekthri eyodwa ezidingako kuthi enye inazo ngaphezu kwalokho eyikudingako.
multi.balances_hint: Izinto ezisalindelweko kuma-oda avulekileko ngokuqhathaniswa nesitoko esisetjenziswako eendaweni zokugcina zefekthri ngayinye.
multi.in_transit: Sisendleleni: sibanjelwe endaweni yokugcina eyamukelako bekube samukelwe.
multi.network_subtitle: Ziindawo zokugcina ezikiphi zefekthri ekuphi, nokuthi yimiphi imikhiqizo engenziwa kuphi. Umkhiqizo wabelwana ngawo ngawo woke amafekthri ngaphandle kobana ubalwe kwamanye.
multi.product_scope_hint: Imikhiqizo engakabalwa lapha ingenziwa kuyo yoke ifekthri.
multi.all_shared: Yoke imikhiqizo yabelwana ngayo ngawo woke amafekthri.

integrations.title: Ukuhlanganisa
integrations.subtitle: Amanye amasistimu ahlanganiswe nge-API yawo, ukutjhintjhana kwamafayili namkha ama-webhook asayiniweko -- ingasi ngokutlola emadatabheyisini wawo. Umlayezo ngamunye wenziwa kanye; okwehlulekako kuyazama godu bese kulinda lapha.
integrations.name: Ibizo
integrations.failures_hint: Imilayezo engakwazanga ukwenziwa. Lungisa imbangela (kanengi ukumepha), bese uzama godu.
integrations.no_db_writes: Ukuhlanganisa kusebenzisa i-API yenye isistimu, amafayili namkha ama-webhook. Ukutlola ngqo kudatabheyisi yenye isistimu akunikelwa.
integrations.connection_hint: Iimfihlo zigcinwa zifihliwe begodu azisatjengiswa godu; tjhiya isikhala singenalutho bona usigcine.
integrations.webhook_hint: Isisetjenziswa sisayina umzimba wesibawo ngasinye nge-HMAC-SHA256 sisebenzisa imfihlo yokuhlanganisa, ku-header ye-X-Mkhaya-Signature.
integrations.settings_hint: Iimphetho zehlobo lekhasimende le: health_path, pull_path, push_paths, export. Akunamfihlo lapha.
integrations.validation_hint: Tlola lokho okuhlolwe ngokuqhathaniswa nehlobo lekhasimende, ilayisensi nokungena okuvumelekileko ngaphambi kokuyivula.
integrations.mappings_hint: Irekhodi lethu nesikhombo senye isistimu sento efanako.
integrations.files_hint: Ngenisa i-CSV ekhutjhwe yenye isistimu (idinga ikholamu ethi "id"), namkha ulayishe lokho okulindele ukuya kiyo.
integrations.receipts_exported: Amarasidi wokuphumako ali-{done} ku-{total} kusukela ekuthomeni ukusebenza sekathunyelwe.
