dashboard.unbinned: {qty} wamayunithi asencwadini angenabhini. Amukelwa ngaphambi kobana iindawo zibe khona namkha ngaphandle kwayo; wasuse uwafake emabhinini bona atholakale.

critical.findings: {n} okutholakeleko kwelahleko okuphuthumako namkha okuqakathekileko kuvuliwe
critical.expired: {n} iindawo zeqhemu eziphelelwe ezisatholakala bona zikhethwe
critical.integration_failures: {n} imilayezo eya namkha evela esistimini exhumeneko ihlulekile

warehouses.title: Iindawo zokubulunga
warehouses.subtitle: Indawo yokugcina ngayinye yirekhodi elifanako ezeMali elinganisa ngalo isitoko — ihlelwe lapha ngesitezi.
warehouses.none: Azikabi khona iindawo zokugcina. Engeza yokuthoma bona uthome ukuhlela iindawo.
warehouses.site_hint: Kuyazikhethela. Xhumanisa nendawo ye-SHEQ bona isikhathi sendawo sifane nayo; indawo yokugcina ihlala iyirekhodi layo.
warehouses.categories_hint: Tjhiya kungelutho bona uvumele yoke imihlobo.
warehouses.is_wms_managed_hint: Nakuvuliwe, isitoko siphuma ngesikhathi sokuthunyelwa kunokobana kube ngesikhathi i-invoyisi yenziwa.
warehouses.retire_confirm: Khupha u-{name} emsebenzini? Akukafaneli kube nesitoko. Umlando uyagcinwa.
warehouses.no_people: Akakabelwa muntu — nanyana ngubani onokufikelela endaweni yokugcina angasebenza lapha.
warehouses.activities_hint: Nakwabelwe othileko, abantu ababelweko kwaphela abangenza imisebenzi yendawo yokugcina lapha.

locations.title: Iindawo
locations.subtitle: Ibalazwe lesitezi njengesihlahla. Amabhini kwaphela aphatha isitoko; ukuvimba ikhundla kuvimba woke amabhini akilo.
locations.generate_hint: Amakhowudi aragela phambili kusukela enomborweni ephezulu ekhona, ngalokho ukuphinda lokhu kwelula umugqa.
locations.prefix_hint: Tjhiya kungelutho bona usebenzise ikhowudi yomzali ilandelwa yidetjhi.
locations.search: Thola indawo ngekhowudi, ngebizo namkha ngebhakhodi
locations.unbinned: {qty} wamayunithi endaweni yokugcina le akekho ebhinini.
locations.barcode_hint: Tjhiya kungelutho bona usebenzise ikhowudi yendawo yokugcina nekhowudi yendawo.
locations.retire_confirm: Khupha u-{code} emsebenzini? Kufanele ibe ngelutho begodu ingabi neendawo ezisebenzako.
locations.cascades: Yoke indawo engaphakathi kwale nayo izokwala isitoko.
locations.until_hint: Tjhiya kungelutho bona ukhawulele bekube kulapho othileko ayivula khona godu.

labels.title: Amalebula weendawo
labels.subtitle: Amalebula we-QR aphethe ibhakhodi yendawo ngayinye, nekhowudi ephrindwe ngamaledere amakhulu.
labels.capped: Kutjengiswa amalebula wokuthoma ama-500. Hlungela ngezinga bona uphrinde asaleleko.

history.title: Umlando wendawo
history.subtitle: Yoke itjhuguluko endaweni yokugcina namkha endaweni. Okutloliweko angekhe kulungiswe namkha kusulwe.

item_status_rule.DISCONTINUED: Akukho sitoko esitjha esingamukelwa. Esele sisangathengiswa, sikhitjhwe begodu sisuswe.
item_status_rule.BLOCKED: Akukho okungamukelwa, okungakhitjhwa namkha okungasuswa. Ukubala nokulungisa kusavunyelwe.
item_status_rule.RECALLED: Akukho okungamukelwa, okungakhitjhwa namkha okungasuswa, begodu isitoko esibanjiweko angekhe sikhululwe bekube kuphela ukubuyiswa.
item_status_rule.QUARANTINED: Akukho okungamukelwa, okungakhitjhwa namkha okungasuswa, begodu isitoko esibanjiweko angekhe sikhululwe bekube into le iyakhululwa.
item_status_rule.OBSOLETE: Akukho okungamukelwa, okungakhitjhwa namkha okungasuswa. Isitoko sisangalahlwa.

products.title: Iintwana
products.subtitle: Iintwo ezifanako ezeMali ezilinganisa nezakhiwa nguKukhiqiza — zichazwe lapha ngendawo yokugcina.
products.add_hint: Yenza into yesitoko kanye, ye-zeMali, yokuKhiqiza neyendawo yokugcina ngokufanako.
products.base_unit_locked: Isitoko sinyakazile ngeyunithi le, ngalokho angekhe isatjhuguluka.
products.search: Sesa nge-SKU, ngebizo, ngebhakhodi namkha ngekhowudi yomhlinzeki
products.quarantine_stock: Godu susa soke isitoko esitholakalako usise endaweni yokuhlukaniswa nje
products.costing: Iindleko: {method}, iindleko ezijayelekileko {cost}. Ukulinganiswa kwenani kuphathwa ezeMali.
products.packaging_hint: Izinga ngalinye litjho bona liphethe ama-{base} angangani. Lokhu kuguqulwa okusetjenziswa kikho koke ukwamukela, ukukhetha nokulungisa.
products.no_packaging: Awakabi khona amazinga wokupakisha — into le iphathwa ngeyunithi yayo eyisisekelo kwaphela.
products.no_barcodes: Awakabi khona amabhakhodi. Engeza ibhakhodi yomhlinzeki namkha wenze yangaphakathi.
products.barcode_scan_hint: Liskene namkha ulithayiphe ngokunembako njengombana liphrindiwe.
products.duplicate_reason: Kubayini ibhakhodi le ingaba ngeyezinto ezimbili?
products.codes_hint: Amakhowudi asetjenziswa babahlinzeki namakhasimende entweni le. Ikhowudi eskeniweko namkha ethayiphiweko nayo ifaniswa nalawa.
products.bundle_hint: Into ethengiswa namkha ekhitjhwa njengeqoqo lezinye iintwo. Tjhiya kungelutho nange akusiliqoqo.
products.substitutes_hint: Iintwo ezingasetjenziswa esikhundleni sale. Imigqa ye-oda igcina into ebeyi-odiwe.
products.owner_hint: Tjhiya kungelutho esitokweni sekampani. Iimpahla zekhasimende ziyabalwa kodwana azilinganiswa ngenani.
products.owner_locked: Isitoko sinyakazile, ngalokho umnikazi angekhe asatjhuguluka.

scan.title: Isihloli sokuskena
scan.subtitle: Skena namkha uthayiphe nanyana yiliphi ibhakhodi ubone ngokunembako ukuthi indawo yokugcina izokulizwisisa njani.
scan.hint: Amakhowudi we-GS1 azwisiswa neqhemu, inomboro yelandelano namalanga wawo. Nawuthayipha ngesandla, tlola isihlukanisi seqembu njenge-[GS].

product_labels.title: Amalebula wemikhiqizo
product_labels.subtitle: Amalebula weshalofu, wekhatoni newephalethi aphethe ibhakhodi yento ngayinye.
product_labels.none: Khetha iintwo erhelweni leentwo, bese uphrinda amalebula wazo.

stock.title: Isitoko nokutholakala
stock.subtitle: Inani ngalinye linencazelo yinye, esetjenziswa kizo zoke iindawo. Vula into ubone ukuthi isitoko sayo sikuphi nokuthi sifike njani lapho.
stock.reconcile_hint: Ibhalansi iqhathaniswa nesamba sakho koke ukunyakaza. Kufanele zivumelane.
stock.atp_rule: Kuyatholakala bona kuthenjiswe = okutholakalako esandleni − okubekelweko. Isitoko esabelweko kodwana singakakhethwa siyingcenye yokubekelweko begodu asikhutjhwa kabili.

movements.title: Umlando wesitoko
movements.subtitle: Koke ukunyakaza okufakiweko. Akukho okungalungiswa lapha; iphutha lilungiswa ngokubuyisela emuva, okuvela eceleni kwalo.

states.title: Ubujamo besitoko
states.subtitle: Ukuthi bujamo ngabunye bubalelwa kimaphi amanani. Lonke inani kizo zoke iinkrini zendawo yokugcina libalwa kusukela etafuleni le.

meaning_of.DAMAGED: Konakele; kulindele ukulahlwa, ukulungiswa namkha ukubuyiselwa.
meaning_of.REJECTED: Kwehlulekile ekuhlolweni; kulindele ukubuyiselwa namkha ukulahlwa.
meaning_of.RECALLED: Kungaphasi kokubuyiswa; angekhe kusetjenziswe namkha kukhululwe.
meaning_of.IN_TRANSIT: Isitoko esisendaweni yokusendleleni, phakathi kweendawo ezimbili.
meaning_of.EXPIRED: Isitoko esitholakalako eqhemeni elidlule ilanga lalo lokuphelelwa.

adjustments.title: Ukulungiswa kwesitoko
adjustments.subtitle: Koke ukulungisa kuphethe ikhowudi yesizathu. Lokho okungaphezu kwemikhawulo yesizathu, namkha okunelanga elikude khulu emuva, kulinda omunye umuntu bona akuvume.
adjustments.pick_position: Isitoko sento le lapha — khetha esinye bona usilungise:
adjustments.negative: Faka inomboro enegadi: isizathu lesi sisusa isitoko.
adjustments.positive: Faka inomboro ehle: isizathu lesi sengeza isitoko.
adjustments.occurred_hint: Tjhiya kungelutho bona kube nje. Ilanga elisesikhathini esivalwe ngu-ezeMali liyaliwa.
adjustments.evidence_hint: Kuyazikhethela: iithombe zomonakalo, umbiko, incwadi yesimangalo.

reasons.title: Amakhowudi wesizathu
reasons.subtitle: Kubayini isitoko sitjhuguluka. Ikhowudi ngayinye itjho bona yengeza namkha isusa isitoko, nokuthi umuntu wesibili kufanele ayivume nini.
reasons.approve_high_risk: Iintwo ezineengozi ezikhulu zitlhoga umuntu wesibili

clients.title: Ukufikelela kwamakhasimende
clients.subtitle: Amakhasimende wabantu besithathu iimpahla zabo ezigcinwe lapha, nabantu abavunyelwe ukuzibona.
clients.how: Isitoko sekhasimende sitjengiswa kwaphela abantu abanikelwe ikhasimende elo, namkha abanemvumo yokubona woke amakhasimende. Isitoko sekampani uqobo asithinteki.
clients.none: Azikabi khona iintwo eziphethwe likhasimende. Beka umnikazi wento ethebhini yayo yeSihlolo.

expected.title: Okulindelwe ukwamukelwa
expected.subtitle: Imigqa yama-oda wokuthenga evuliweko esazokufika. Umugqa kufanele ubize into yesitoko yawo ngaphambi kobana iimpahla zawo zibekwe eshalofini.
expected.link_hint: Ixhumanisa umugqa we-oda lo nento ewuthengako, ngalokho ukuwamukela kufaka into leyo esitokweni.

receive.title: Amukela u-{po}
receive.no_stock_item: akukho into yesitoko — ukuyamukela akunyakazisi sitoko
receive.serials_hint: Yinye emugqeni ngamunye namkha zihlukaniswe ngamakhoma — yinye ngeyunithi ngayinye.
receive.allow_duplicate: Lokhu kulethwa kwesibili kwamambala encwadini efanako

nonpo.title: Amukela ngaphandle kwe-oda
nonpo.subtitle: Kweempahla ezifike ngaphandle kwe-oda lokuthenga. Akukho okufakwako bekube kulapho omunye umuntu ongasuwe akuvuma.

receipts.title: Okwamukelweko
receipts.subtitle: Iincwadi zokwamukela iimpahla — ezifanako ezibonwa nguKuthenga — nalokho indawo yokugcina ekwenzileko ngomugqa ngamunye.
receipts.pending_explain: Kwamukelwe ngaphandle kwe-oda: {reason}. Akukho okufakwe esitokweni.
receipts.not_yours: Omunye umuntu kufanele avume okwamukelweko okwenzileko.
receipts.inspection_pending: Esinye isitoko sibanjelwe ukuhlolwa kokungenako. Sizokufumana umsebenzi wokubekwa endaweni nakuhlolwa kusamukela.

appointments.title: Iinkhathi zedokhu
appointments.subtitle: Iinkhathi zokuletha ngedokhu. Idokhu yindawo yokwamukela; iinkoloyi ezimbili angekhe ziyibambe ngesikhathi sinye.
appointments.no_docks: Indawo yokugcina le ayinamadokhu wokwamukela. Engeza indawo yohlobo lweDokhu yokwamukela bona ubhukhe iinkhathi kiyo.

scorecards.title: Ukusebenza kwabaphakeli
scorecards.subtitle: Kulinganiswa ngokwamukelweko, ingasi ngemibono. Umhlinzeki onokulethwa okungaphasi kwe-{min} emalangeni ama-90 ngaphasi kwe-{on_time}% ngesikhathi, namkha ngaphezu kwe-{defects}% okonakeleko namkha okwaliweko, uyaphawulwa kuKuphathwa Kwabahlinzeki.

returns.title: Okubuyiselwa kubahlinzeki
returns.subtitle: Isitoko siyaphuma nakuthunyelwa okubuyiselweko, nanyana sibanjwe kubujamo obunjani. Incwadi yesikweledu yomhlinzeki itlolwa ezeMali.
returns.dispatch_hint: Ukuthumela kukhupha isitoko endaweni yokugcina nje.

putaway.title: Ukubeka endaweni
putaway.subtitle: Umsebenzi ngamunye utjho lapho isitoko sikhona, lapho kufanele siye khona nokuthi kubayini. Imiraro iya emgqeni wokwahlukileko.
putaway.directed_hint: Indawo yokugcina le iqondisa ukubeka endaweni ebhinini eliphakanyisiweko.

policy.SUGGESTED: Kuphakanyisiwe: nanyana yiliphi ibhini elidlula imithetho lingasetjenziswa.
policy.DIRECTED: Kuqondisiwe: ibhini eliphakanyisiweko kwaphela, ngaphandle kobana umphathi alidlule.
policy.FREE: Ngokukhululeka: nanyana yiliphi ibhini elidlula imithetho.

capacity_page.title: Umthamo
capacity_page.subtitle: Imikhawulo ehleliweko iqhathaniswa nalokho okubanjiweko. Amabhini angenamikhawulo ayabalwa kodwana awalinganiswa.
capacity_page.restricted_hint: Iintwo ezidisi, eziyingozi namkha ezilawulwa ngethempritjha, nokuthi mangaki amabhini avuliweko angazithatha.

binmove.title: Susa isitoko
binmove.subtitle: Ibhini ukuya ebhinini ngaphakathi kwendawo yokugcina. Amaqhemu neenomboro zelandelano zinyakaza nesitoko.
binmove.scan_from: Skena namkha uthayiphe ibhini okususwa kilo

transfers.title: Ukudlulisela
transfers.subtitle: Isitoko phakathi kweendawo zokugcina. Nasithunyelwako sihlala endaweni yokusendleleni yendawo okuyiwa kiyo, lapho kungekho muntu ongasithembisa namkha asikhethe.
transfers.dispatch_hint: Ukuthumela kukhupha isitoko esikhethiweko endaweni yokugcina esithunyelwa kiyo nje.

replenishment.title: Ukugcwalisa
replenishment.subtitle: Iindawo zokukhetha neendawo zokugcina zigcinwa phakathi kobuncani nobukhulu bazo, okuphuthumako kuqala; nalokho umthengi okufanele akuthenge.
replenishment.reorder_hint: Ubujamo = okutholakalako bona kuthenjiswe + okuyi-odiweko − okulindelwe esitokweni. Izinga lokuphinda i-oda = elikhulu phakathi kwezinga lokuphinda i-oda nesitoko sokuphepha kuhlanganiswe nesidingo ngesikhathi sokulinda.
replenishment.source_bulk: Kusukela ekugcineni okunqwabelanako ukuya ebhinini lokukhetha

strategy_hint.DISCRETE: Irhelo linye lokukhetha nge-oda ngalinye: kulula khulu, kuhle khulu kuma-oda amakhulu.
strategy_hint.BATCH: Ukukhamba kunye kwawo woke ama-oda akhethiweko, ngokulandelana kwamabhini; ahlukaniswa abe ma-oda ekupakisheni.
strategy_hint.ZONE: Irhelo lokukhetha ngenzombe ngayinye, ngalokho umkhethi ngamunye uhlala endaweni yinye.
strategy_hint.WAVE: Khulula ama-oda akhethiweko ndawonye -- ekulandweni ngumthwali namkha esikhathini sokugcina.
strategy_hint.CLUSTER: Umkhethi munye, ama-oda amanengi ngesikhathi sinye, ngalinye endaweni yalo yesitja.

outbound.title: Ama-oda wokuphothula
outbound.subtitle: Woke ama-oda indawo yokugcina ewathumelako, nanyana avelaphi. I-oda elifanako alamukelwa kabili.
outbound.cancel_hint: Isitoko esibanjiweko siyakhululwa begodu nanyana yini esele ikhethiwe ifumana umsebenzi wokubekwa endaweni ibuyele ekugcineni.
outbound.override_hint: Khetha lapho kuvela khona. Isitoko esiphelelweko, esivinjiweko nesibanjiweko sisengekhe sikhethwe, begodu isizathu sigcinwa ekwabeni.

picking.title: Ukukhetha
picking.subtitle: Khetha ama-oda, khetha ukuthi uzowakhetha njani, begodu usebenze irhelo ngokulandelana kwendlela yokukhamba. Ukukhetha ngakunye kukususa okuskeniweko ukuya ekupakisheni.

sla.title: Amazinga esevisi
sla.subtitle: Kulinganiswa ngalokho okwenzeke kwamambala ku-oda ngalinye phakathi kokukhululwa nokuthunyelwa.

counts.title: Ukubalwa kwesitoko
counts.subtitle: Bala okuseshalofini, ukuqhathanise neencwadi ngesikhathi sokubala, begodu ulungise kwaphela lokho okuvunyiweko.
counts.none: Akukabi khona ukubala. Vula okukodwa, namkha uhlele ihlelo lokukwenza ngehlelo.
counts.no_plans: Awakho amahlelo wokubala. Ihlelo livula ukubala ngehlelo: yoke into ye-A qobe veke, yoke ibhini kanye ngomnyaka.
counts.why_hint: Kutjengiswa ababali, isib. "Ukuphela kwenyanga" namkha "Umonakalo obikiweko ekhundleni 4".
counts.max_lines_hint: Tjhiya kungelutho kokoke. Nanyana kunomkhawulo, iindawo ezabalwa kudala khulu ziza kuqala.
counts.thresholds_hint: Umahluko odlula nanyana yini kilokhu uya kumbali wesibili. Tjhiya koke kungelutho bona uphinde ubale yoke imihluko.
counts.found_hint: Isitoko esisebhinini esingakhenge sirhelwe ekubaleni. Sengezwa njengomugqa ongakalindeleki begodu sibalwa nje.
counts.accept_hint: Ukulungiswa okunesizathu esithi Umahluko wokubala kuyenziwa nakufakwa ukubala. Ngaphezu kwemikhawulo yokulungisa kulinda ukuvunywa.
counts.dismiss_hint: Tjho ukuthi yini ewuhlathululako. Akukho okulungiswako, begodu ihlathululo ihlala ekubaleni.

count_scope_hint.ABC: Iintwana zesigaba se-ABC esisinye. Hlukanisa kuqala ukusetha iinzigaba.
count_scope_hint.VALUE: Iindawo eziphethe inani elingangalelo olisethako namkha ngaphezulu.
count_scope_hint.RISK: Iintwana ezinomahluko, ukukhetha okusilekako namkha ilahlekelo emalangeni ama-90 adlulileko.

accuracy.title: Ukunemba kokubala
accuracy.subtitle: Kangangani ukubala kokuthoma kuvumelana namarekhodi, nenani lalokho okungakavumelani.

returns_page.title: Okubuyiswa ngamakhasimende
returns_page.subtitle: Iimpahla zibuya ngokwe-oda, i-invoyisi namkha ireferensi evunyiweko, begodu ziyahlolwa ngaphambi kokuthi zibe sitoko godu.
returns_page.reference_hint: Irekhodi lomrhala, i-imeyili namkha inomboro yekesi, lapho kungekho i-oda namkha i-invoyisi.
returns_page.receive_hint: Iimpahla ezivuliweko, ezilimeleko namkha ezibuyiselwe emuva zigcinwa ekuhlukaniselweni begodu ziyahlolwa.
returns_page.credit_hint: Inothi yesikolodo ku-invoyisi {invoice} (esalako {outstanding}). Iimpahla zibuye ngeendleko ezingu-{cost}; lokhu kunikela ikhasimende isikolodo kwaphela.

quality.title: Ukubuyekezwa
quality.subtitle: Isitoko esihlolwe ebhinini laso, okubuyisiweko, nama-oda ngaphambi kokobana aphume, emarekhodini wokuhlola afanako nawokukhiqiza.
quality.hold_hint: Isitoko sihlala lapho sikhona, simisiwe, bekube kuqunywa ngokuhlolwa.
quality.setup_subtitle: Okufanele kuhlolwe, iinsampula ezingaki, namagama wokuchaza okungahambi kuhle.
quality.no_plans: Akukho mahlelo wokuhlola endaweni yokugcina okwanje. Ngaphandle kwehlelo, ukuhlola kukuhlola kokudlula namkha kokwehluleka kwaphela.
quality.product_hint: Tjhiya kungenalitho ukuthi kusebenze kiyo yoke imikhiqizo esigabeni lesi.

disposition_hint.CONDITIONAL_ACCEPT: Kubuyela esitokweni nanyana kwehlulekile; tjho isizathu.
disposition_hint.REWORK: Kuhlala kumisiwe begodu kuhlolwa godu ngemva kokulungiswa.

losses.title: Ilahlekelo
losses.subtitle: Okucinyiweko okuqinisekisiweko nelahlekelo elisolwako akukaze kuhlanganiswe.
losses.confirmed_hint: Okucinyiweko okuvunyiweko nesitoko esilahlwe ngokuhlolwa, ngokubuyiswa nangokubuyiselwa emuva.
losses.suspected_hint: Akukabi lilahlekelo: kulindele ukuvunywa, ukubuyekezwa kokubala namkha ukubala godu.
losses.claims_hint: Iimfuno zivulwa elahlekelweni elifakiweko esikrinini sokulungiswa.

loss_risk.HIGH: Kuphezulu: ilahlekelo lihlala lidinga umuntu wesibili

recalls.title: Ukubuyiswa
recalls.subtitle: Ukubuyiswa kufumana yoke iyunithi ethintekako, kuyimise, begodu kurekhode okwenziweko bekube kuvalwa.
recalls.close_hint: Ukubuyiswa kuvalwa kwaphela nakungasekho okumisiweko ngakho okungakaqunywa.
recalls.no_lots: Akukho maqhema: umkhiqizo woke uyabuyiswa, begodu ubujamo bawo buyawuvimba ukuthi ususwe.

recall_scope_hint.SERIALS: Yoke inomboro yelandelwano phakathi kwezimbili, kuhlanganise nazo.
recall_scope_hint.ITEM: Woke amaqhema womkhiqizo; umkhiqizo uvinjelwe bekube ukubuyiswa kuyavalwa.

batches.title: Amaqhema neenomboro zelandelwano
batches.subtitle: Bona ukuthi iqhemu ngalinye liyini, lapho yoke iyunithi yalo ikhona, nakho koke okwenzeke kilo.

expiry.title: Ubungozi bokuphelelwa sikhathi
expiry.subtitle: Amaqhema ngelanga lokuphelelwa sikhathi, ubudingo obulindelekileko ngaphambi kwalo, nenani elingahle lilahleke.
expiry.method: Ukusetjenziswa okulindelekileko kumalanga ama-90 adlulileko wokukhitjhwa nokuthunyelwa ngelanga, kusetjenziswa kuthoma okuphelelwa sikhathi kusesenesi. Imikhiqizo engenamlando itjengiswa njengengaziwako, ingasi njengengenabungozi.

accounting.title: Ukubalwa kwemali yendawo yokugcina
accounting.subtitle: Yoke into eyenzeka esitokweni inomnikazi munye nendlela yokuyiphatha eyodwa, evunywe ngezemali; ukuvumelanisa kufumana okungavumelaniko.
accounting.no_issues: Akukho okungavumelaniko. Ukuvumelanisa kwenzeka qobe busuku nangesikhathi ofuna ngaso.
accounting.rules_hint: Izehlakalo ezifakwa yenye imojuli ziyatjengiswa ukuze kungabi nokufakwa kabili. Iindlela ezitjha zokuphatha zilindela ukuvunywa ngaphambi kokuthi kufakwe litho.
accounting.landed_hint: Hlukanisa iindleko zokuthutha, umthelo nezinye iindleko phezu kweempahla ezilethwe ngazo. Okuthengisiweko sekuthatha isabelo saso kuya eendlekweni zokuthengisa.
accounting.reval_hint: Ukulinganiswa kabutjha kutjhugulula inani lesitoko esikhona. Umuntu wesibili uyakuvuma, begodu kufakwa kanye.
accounting.grn_hint: Namkha tjhiya kungenalitho bese ufaka iintwana.

costs.title: Iindleko zesitoko
costs.subtitle: Ukuthi isitoko sinani elingakanani nokuthi sibiza malini, nalapho inani libotjhelwe khona namkha liphuma khona. Iinlinganiso zitjengiswa njengeenlinganiso.

protection.title: Ukuvikela inzuzo
protection.subtitle: Iinhloli ziveza iinkhombo; abaphenyi baziqinisekisa namkha bazilahle ngobufakazi; isenzo sokulungisa siyalinganiswa.
protection.lead_not_proof: Okufunyenweko kukhombo lokuphenya, akusibo ubufakazi bokwebiwa namkha bokuziphatha kumbi. Okufunyenweko kubiza ikambiso, intwana namkha indawo, ingasi umuntu.
protection.not_summed: Inani ngalinye livela emthonjeni walo begodu alikaze lihlanganiswe nelinye, ngalokho isehlakalo sinye asikaze sibalwe kabili.
protection.rule_then: Umthetho ngesikhathi sokuvezwa: umkhawulo {threshold}, okungenani {count}, emalangeni angu-{days}
protection.rules_hint: Koke okufunyenweko kugcina umthetho njengoba bewunjalo ngesikhathi sokuvezwa, ngalokho ukutjhugulula umkhawulo akutjhugululi litho.

forecast.title: Isibikezelo sobudingo
forecast.subtitle: Kusukela kilokho okuphume ngamambala endaweni yokugcina. Umlando omncani awuniki inani kunokuqagela.
forecast.none: Akukho sibikezelo okwanje. Sisebenzise ukubona ubudingo ngentwana.
forecast.reason_hint: Iphromoshini, ikhasimende elilahlekileko, i-oda elaziwako -- kuhlala nenani.

buying.title: Iinkhuthazo zokuthenga
buying.subtitle: Ama-oda aphakanyiswako ngokobudingo obubikezelweko, isikhathi sokulinda, isitoko sokuphepha nalokho okuzako.
buying.approvals: Iinkhuthazo ziba sibawo sokuthenga esiyidrafti. Ukuvunywa kwezokuthenga, amabhajethi nemithetho yabahlinzeki kusebenza njengasesibaweni nanyana ngisiphi.
buying.compare_hint: Iintengo zitjhugululelwe ku-{uom} munye; iindleko zokufika zengezwe lapho zifakwe khona. Okutjipileko ukufika lapha kuthoma.
buying.no_suppliers: Akukho kuthenga namkha imibandela erekhodiweko yentwana le.

excess.title: Isitoko esiyeqileko nesiphelelwe sisebenzi
excess.subtitle: Imikhawulo ngeyakho; amanani ngeendleko. Soke isenzo esiphakanyiswako sidlula ekuvunyweni kwaso.
excess.none: Akukho okuhamba kancani, okungasetjenziswako namkha okuphelelwe sisebenzi ngokwemikhawulo le.
excess.line: {qty} {uom} kugcinwe, akusetjenziswanga amalanga angu-{days}; {excess} ngaphezu kobudingo ({value})

work.board_subtitle: Kufundwa emamukelweni, ekubekweni endaweni, ekuzaliseni kabutjha, emagagasini, kuma-oda nekubaleni okuphethe umsebenzi.
work.labour_subtitle: Amahora womsebenzi ngokuqhathaniswa nabantu abahlelelwe ngekghono ngalinye, ngokweenkhathi zemisebenzi ezilinganisiweko namkha ezisethiweko.
work.travel: Ukuhamba i-oda ngalinye lilodwa kuthatha iindawo ezingu-{now}; ngokweseluleko, {advised} ({pct}% ngaphasi).
work.slotting_subtitle: Iimphakamiso zisondeza imikhiqizo ekhethwa khulu esiqalweni sendlela yokukhetha. Ukususwa okungaphezu kwa-{n} kufanele kulingiswe ngaphambi kokuvunywa.
work.sim_result: Ukuhamba okujayelekileko nge-oda: {now} m nje, {then} m ngemva ({pct}% kufitjhani).
work.sim_range: Ngemva kokutjhugulula, ama-80% wama-oda ahamba phakathi kwa-{lo} no-{hi} m.
work.fairness: Akukho kulandelanisa kwabantu lapha: ubudisi bomsebenzi, isisetjenziswa, ukuphepha nobuleli bedatha kuyahluka, begodu amanani angakunaki lokho akakalungi.
work.sim_subtitle: Ngamunye usebenza amakhulu wamahlandla kusukela emlandweni wendawo yokugcina le begodu utjengisa ibanga elingenzeka, neenqiniseko zalo nembewu.
work.repl_result: {item}: {chance}% ithuba lokuphelelwa okungenani kanye; amalanga wokuphelelwa {days}; isitoko esiphakathi {stock}; ama-oda enziweko {orders}.

assistant.title: Umsizi wendawo yokugcina
assistant.subtitle: Iimpendulo zibalwa emarekhodini wekhamphani yakho, kuphela kilokho okuvumelekileko ukukubona. I-AI itlola amagama kwaphela begodu ayikghoni ukwengeza inani.
assistant.ask: Buza ngama-oda, isitoko, ukuphelelwa sikhathi, abahlinzeki, umahluko namkha ilahlekelo
assistant.quality_subtitle: Kangangani iimpendulo zilungile begodu ziyasiza, izixwayiso ezingasizo neziphuthiweko, ubulelo neendleko.

floor.title: Isiza somsebenzi
floor.offline_scope: Ukukhetha, ukubala nokubeka endaweni kusebenza ngaphandle kwesiginali. Imisebenzi yakho kwaphela egcinwa kilesi sisetjenziswa, ifihliwe, begodu akukaze kube mabhalansi wesitoko.
floor.recorded_offline: Kugcinwe kilesi sisetjenziswa; kuzokuthunyelwa nasibuya isiginali.
floor.camera_denied: Ikhamera ayivunyelwanga. Yivumele kubrawuza, namkha utlole ikhowudi.
floor.conflicts_subtitle: Umsebenzi orekhodwe ngaphandle kwesiginali obewungasavumelani nawufika. Wusebenzise njengobujamo bunje, namkha uwulahle.

labels_setup.title: Amalebula namaphrinta
labels_setup.subtitle: Okutjengiswa lilebula ngalinye, ubukhulu balo nebhakhowudi, namaphrinta wamalebula enethiwekhini yendawo yokugcina.
labels_setup.private_only: Amaphrinta afikelelwa enethiwekhini yangasese yendawo yokugcina kwaphela.
labels_setup.browser_note: Nakugadangiswa kubrawuza, inani liyikhowudi ye-QR; amaphrinta wamalebula agadangisa uhlobo lwebhakhowudi olusethwe yithemplethi.

production.title: Iinsetjenziswa zokukhiqiza
production.subtitle: Iingcenye ezisadingwa yi-oda lokukhiqiza ngalinye, ngokuqhathaniswa nalokho okubekelwe eqadi nokukhululekileko. Ukusetjenziswa okuhluka ngaphezu kwa-{pct}% ku-BOM kuyakhonjwa.
production.none: Awakho ama-oda wokukhiqiza avunyiweko namkha aqhubekako.

carriers.title: Abathwali
carriers.subtitle: Umthwali ngamunye usebenza ngomtjhayeli. Abathwali bangesandla bathatha iintengo zabo ekhadini lapha; ukulandelela nobufakazi bokulethwa kurekhodwa babantu.
carriers.none: Akukho bathwali okwanje. Engeza munye ukuze unikele iintengo bewubhuke ukuthunyelwa.
carriers.name: Ibizo
carriers.tracking_url_hint: Sebenzisa {'{'}tracking{'}'} lapho inomboro yokulandelela ifakwa khona.

events.title: Izehlakalo nama-webhook
events.subtitle: Ukwamukela, ukususwa, ukubekelwa eqadi, ukuthunyelwa, ukubuyiswa nokuhlukileko, kurhatjhwa ku-API feed nakuma-endpoint abhalisiweko.
events.secret_once: Kopisha ifihlo lokusayina nje. Ngeze litjengiswe godu:
events.api_text: Amasistimu afunda i-feed yezehlakalo begodu abiza i-API ngethokheni yomsebenzisi wekhamphani le. Isivumelwano esingezansi sichaza yoke i-endpoint, imikhawulo yesikalo ne-idempotency.
events.subject: Rekhoda
events.only_warehouses_hint: Tjhiya kungenalitho kiyo yoke indawo yokugcina.

systems.title: Amasistimu axhumeneko
systems.subtitle: Amasistimu we-ERP newezokuthengisa, ngokuxhumana, ukufanisa, ukulinga godu nomugqa weemphoso okufanako okusetjenziswa kuKukhiqiza.
systems.none: Ayikho isistimu ye-ERP namkha yezokuthengisa exhunyiweko.
systems.messages_in: Imilayezo engenako: WMS_ORDER (i-oda okufanele lifezwe) ne-WMS_STOCK_LEVELS (isitoko sabo, esivumelaniswe nelejara).
systems.validation_hint: Ihlobo nelayisensi yekhasimende, nokuthi indlela le yokufikelela iyavunyelwa (okungenani iinhlamvu ezingu-20).
systems.no_mappings: Akukho okufanisiweko. Ngaphandle kokufanisa, ama-SKU neenkhowudi zeendawo zokugcina zifaniswa njengoba zinjalo.
systems.add_hint: Imininingwana yokungena nekheli kusethwa ekuxhumaneni kuKukhiqiza; isikrini lesi siphatha lokho indawo yokugcina ekutjhintjhanako.

standards.title: Ukufanisa kwe-GS1 ne-EPCIS
standards.subtitle: Ukususwa, ukukhiqiza nokupakisha kutjengiswa njengezehlakalo ze-EPCIS 2.0 ezineenkhombo ze-GS1, ukuze kutjhintjhwane nabalingani bezokuthengisa.
standards.no_gaps: Woke umkhiqizo nendawo yokugcina kilesi sikhathi kunekhiye yayo ye-GS1.

inventory.title: Ideshibhodi yesitoko
inventory.subtitle: Isitoko eendaweni zokugcina eziphathwa yimojuli, ngobujamo, indawo yokugcina, umkhiqizo, ubudala nokuphelelwa sikhathi.

suppliers.title: Ideshibhodi yabahlinzeki
suppliers.subtitle: Indlela abahlinzeki abaletha ngayo, okuphuzileko, okuhlala kungahambi kuhle nalokho okufanele kuodwe.

protection.title: Ideshibhodi yokuvikela inzuzo
protection.subtitle: Okungalahleka, okulahlekileko, ukuthi ukuphenya kuthatha isikhathi esingangani nokuthi izenzo zisebenzile na.

executive.title: Ideshibhodi yabaphathi abaphezulu
executive.subtitle: Indawo yokugcina itjho ukuthini ngemali: isitoko esikhona, okweqileko, ilahlekelo, isevisi nobungozi.

insights.no_values: Amanani atjengiswa abantu abanemvumo yokubalwa kwemali yendawo yokugcina.
insights.expiring_90: Amaqhema aphelelwa sikhathi ngaphakathi kwamalanga ama-90
insights.stockout_top: Lapho isitoko siphela khona ngaphambi kokulethwa okulandelako

reports.title: Imibiko nokukhupha
reports.subtitle: Koke okukhutjhwako kugcina iinhluzo zakho nesikhathi sokwenziwa. Okukhutjhwako okungaphezu kwemigca engu-{n} kwenziwa ngemva begodu uyaziswa.
reports.sensitive: Okukhutjhwako lokhu kuhlanganisa amanani wesitoko namkha idatha yokuphenya; ukudawuniloda kuyarekhodwa.

alerts.title: Iimxwayiso
alerts.subtitle: Ikinga elifanako elingakararululwa liyabalwa, alikaphindwa; liyakhunjuzwa ngemva kwesikhathi sokuthula begodu lidluliselwa phezulu nalihlala lingakararululwa.
alerts.tell_responsible: Bese wazisa nalowo onomthwalo (owukhulumileko, owuphetheko, osebenza lapho)
alerts.quiet_hint: Isixwayiso esifanako esingakararululwa asiphindwa kumuntu ngaphakathi kwesikhathi lesi.

threshold.days_short: Amalanga asilela esikhathini sokulinda ngaphambi kokwazisa

approvals.title: Iimvumo
approvals.subtitle: Iimbawo zidlula emazingeni afunwa linani lazo, ngalinye liqunywa mumuntu ohlukileko, akukaze kube mbawi.
approvals.levels_hint: Izinga 1 lihlala lisebenza; izinga ngalinye elilandelako lisebenza kusukela enanini lalo. Iimbawo esezenziwe zigcina amazinga wazo.

governance.title: Ukuhlolwa kwamarekhodi nokubusa
governance.subtitle: Okwenzekileko nokuthi ngubani okwenzileko, kugcinwe elejarini etjengisa nanyana ngikuphi ukuphazamiswa; ukweqiwa kwesiphuthumako nokuthi idatha igcinwa isikhathi esingangani.
governance.break_glass_text: Ikuvumela bona uzinqumele izibawo zakho amahora ambalwa nakungekho omunye ongakwenza. Koke ukusetjenziswa kuyatlolwa, abaphathi bayaziswa msinyana, begodu omunye umuntu kufuze akubuyekeze.
governance.retention_text: Bona indawo yokugcina igcina izinto isikhathi esingangani. Imininingwana yomuntu itjhintjhwa ngetjhwayo nasekuphele isikhathi sayo; umlando wesitoko nezemali akuthintwa. Akukho okungabekwa ngaphasi kobuncani bakho.
governance.roles_text: Iimfanekiso zokunikela njengoba zinjalo namkha ukuzikopisha. Imikhawulo yokuvuma ibekwa ngaphasi kwe-Ukuvuma; iindawo zokugcina umuntu angasebenza kizo zibekwa lirhelo labasebenzi lendawo ngayinye nomthetho wayo wokuthi "abasebenzi bakhona kwaphela".

policies.title: Imithetho ye-{code}
policies.subtitle: Hlola itjhuguluko ingakasebenzi, uyigcine njengokusesalungiswa, bese uyisebenzisa. Yoke iinguqulo iyagcinwa begodu ingabuyiselwa; imisebenzi ethunyelweko igcina umphumela womthetho obewusebenza ngesikhathi yenzeka.
policies.no_history: Azikho iinguqulo okwanje; itjhuguluko yokuthoma itlola isiqalo.

health.title: Ipilo
health.subtitle: Bona imitjhini yendawo yokugcina iyasebenza na, nokuthi lokho okutjengiswa ziskrini kuyavumelana nerejista yesitoko na.
health.ledger_ok: Yoke ibhalansi, indawo nokubekelela kuyavumelana nerejista (kuhlolwe iinbhalansi zezinto-ezindaweni ezi-{n}).
health.ledger_bad: Umehluko oyi-{n} phakathi kwerejista nalokho okuthathwe kiyo:

kpis.title: Ama-KPI wendawo yokugcina
kpis.subtitle: Inani ngalinye lihlathululwe ngokunembileko -- okubalwako, ngokuqhathaniswa nani, nokukhutjhwako -- ngalokho alingeze labangcono ngokutjhugulula idinominetha. Ihlathululo inguqulo {v}.
kpis.no_baseline: Khetha inyanga yesiqalo ozokulinganisa ngayo ukuthuthuka. Tlola inyanga kokuthoma, nasele iphelile.

requests.title: Iimbawo
requests.subtitle: Thoma isibawo, landela lokho okubawileko, bese ubeka ozokusebenzela nawungekho.

design.title: Ukuhlela
design.subtitle: Akha, hlola bese ushicilela ama-workflow namafomu wawo, namkha uthome ngesifanekiso esijayelekileko.

operations.title: Iimsebenzi
operations.subtitle: Ukusebenza, koke okuqhubekako, nomsebenzi otlhoga ukunakwa ngomuntu.

admin.title: Ukuphatha
admin.subtitle: Umthetho we-workflow wekhampani le, iinkhalenda zebhizinisi nomkhondo wokuhlolwa.

my_requests.title: Izibawo zami
my_requests.subtitle: Lokho okubawileko, bona ngasinye sikuphi nokuthi silindele bani.

delegations.title: Ukunikelwa
delegations.subtitle: Vumela umsebenzi-kanye nawe bona enze imisebenzi yakho isikhathi esithile, ngaphandle kwemvumo ebanzi.

definitions.title: Ama-workflow
definitions.subtitle: Hlela ekhanvasini, qinisekisa, buyekeza bese ushicilela iinguqulo.

forms.title: Amafomu
forms.subtitle: Amafomu wezibawo newemisebenzi aneenguqulo, aneenkambu ezinemibandela nemigca yezinto.

templates.title: Amathempulethi
templates.subtitle: Iindlela ezi-31 ezilungileko kuFinance, HR, Procurement, IT, Governance, SHEQ ne-Operations.

form_library.title: Umtapo wamafomu
form_library.subtitle: Amafomu ama-46 enziwe ngaphambili (HR, Finance, Procurement, IT, Legal, SHEQ namanye) wokungeza nokuwatjhugulula.

dashboard.title: Ukusebenza
dashboard.subtitle: Ukuphuma komsebenzi, ukuthobela i-SLA, iimvimbo nobunengi bomsebenzi.

instances.title: Izibawo ezisesistimini
instances.subtitle: Zoke izibawo ongazibona, zihlungwe ngobujamo, nge-workflow nange-SLA.

exceptions.title: Okuhlukileko
exceptions.subtitle: Amagadango azenzakalelako ahlulekileko, umsebenzi ongakwazi ukunikelwa umuntu neenzehlakalo ezingathunyelwanga.

settings.title: Ukuphatha i-workflow
settings.subtitle: Umthetho wokuvuma, amamojula ase-injini, iinzenzo ezivumelekileko nepilo ye-injini.

calendars.title: Iinkhalenda zebhizinisi
calendars.subtitle: Amahora wokusebenza, iimpelaveki namalanga wokuvalwa kwama-SLA wamahora webhizinisi.

audit.title: Umkhondo wokuhlola
audit.subtitle: Yoke itjhuguluko, isiqunto, ukwala nokungenela, kuhlanganiswe nge-hash.

setup.title: Ukuhlela intela
setup.subtitle: Bona ibhizinisi ngalinye libhalisele ziphi iintela, nemithetho eneenguqulo ezibalwa ngayo.

work.title: Umsebenzi wentela
work.subtitle: Lungiselela isikhathi ngasinye: akha irejista, rarulula okuhlukileko bese ubuyisana nerejista yezemali.

compliance.title: Ukuthobela
compliance.subtitle: Amalanga wokugcina, iinkhumbuzo nomkhondo wokuhlolwa kwaso soke isiqunto sentela.

registrations.title: Ukubhaliselwa intela
registrations.subtitle: Ngebhizinisi: isikhomba, kangangani kuthunyelwa, olungiselela nobuyekezako abanomthwalo, nomlando wetjhuguluko.

rules.title: Imithetho yentela
rules.subtitle: Amazinga nokuphathwa okunamalanga wokuthoma ngekhowudi yentela ngayinye, kuhlolwe begodu kwavunywa ngaphambi kokusetjenziswa.

admin.title: Ukuphatha intela
admin.subtitle: Amasetingi wentela wekhampani le, ophethe imvumo yentela ethile, nokuhlelwa okulawulwako.

import.title: Ngenisa idatha yangaphambili
import.subtitle: Ukubhalisa, amabhalansi wokuvula, amarhubhu adlulileko nokulahlekelwa — kubonwe kuqala, bese kuvunywa mumuntu wesibili.

periods.title: Iinkhathi zentela
periods.subtitle: Isikhathi ngasinye kusukela ekuvulweni ukuya ekukhiyweni, nalokho okusavimbela ukuvunywa kwaso.

transactions.title: Irejista ye-VAT
transactions.subtitle: Yoke imigca ye-VAT ilandelelwe ku-invoyisi, enothini yesikweletu namkha endlekweni yayo, nokuhlukileko okufuze kurarululwe.

reconciliations.title: Ukubuyisana
reconciliations.subtitle: Irejista ye-VAT iqhathaniswa nama-akhawundi wokulawula i-VAT, kuhlathululwe begodu kwavunywa.

calendar.title: Ikhalenda yokuthobela
calendar.subtitle: Amalanga wokugcina wokuthumela nokubhadela, abanikazi bawo, nalokho osekudlule isikhathi.

returns.title: Amarhubhu wentela
returns.subtitle: I-VAT201 ne-EMP201 zilungiselelwe kusukela erejisteni, zabuyekezwa, zavunywa begodu zathunyelwa nobufakazi.

income_tax.title: Intela yengeniso
income_tax.subtitle: Kusukela enzuzweni yezemali ukuya kungeniso etheleleko, iinlinganiso zentela yesikhatjhana nokulahlekelwa okudluliselwa phambili.

liabilities.title: Iinkweletu neenkhokhelo
liabilities.subtitle: Lokho okukweletwa i-SARS, iinkhokhelo zeFinance ezikubhadelako, nalokho osekudlule isikhathi.

reports.title: Imibiko yentela
reports.subtitle: Imibiko ejayelekileko eli-18 — amarejista, amahlelo, ukubuyisana, iinkweletu nobufakazi — kunye nokukhipha.

audit.title: Umkhondo wokuhlolwa kwentela
audit.subtitle: Ngubani owenze ini, nini begodu kubayini — amarhelo, iintjhuguluko, ukuvuma nokwala.

field_map.title: Amamephu wamasimu neenzowni
field_map.subtitle: Dweba, ngenisa bese ulungisa imikhawulo emephini yomoya; iinzowni zokuphatha namasampuli wehlabathi eceleni kwazo.
field_map.no_farm: Awukabi nepulazi lokulenzela imephu. Bhalisa ipulazi, namkha ubawe ukunikelwa imvumo yokungena kilo.
field_map.read_only: Ungayibona imephu le. Ukuyitjhugulula kutlhoga imvumo yokuphatha amasimu nemvumo yokutlola epulazini leli.
field_map.load_failed: Imephu ayikwazanga ukulayitjha. Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho bese ulayitjha ikhasi kabutjha.
field_map.editing_new_field: Qhwarhaza ikona ngekona bona udwebe isimu elitjha, bese uqhwarhaza ikona yokuthoma bona ulivale.
field_map.editing_field: Donsa amakona bona utjhugulule umkhawulo; qhwarhaza iphakathi bona wengeze ikona, qhwarhaza ngesinene ekoneni bona uyisuse.
field_map.editing_zone: Donsa amakona wezowni; kufuze ihlale ngaphakathi kwesimu.
field_map.soil_at_field_point: Akukho iphoyinti elitlolelwe isampuli le; itjengiswa ephoyintini lesimu.
field_map.confirm_remove_boundary: Ususa umkhawulo we-{code}? Isimo samanje sigcinwa emlandweni waso.
field_map.confirm_remove_farm_boundary: Ususa umkhawulo wepulazi? Isimo samanje sigcinwa emlandweni waso.
field_map.zones_need_boundary: Yenza imephu yomkhawulo wesimu ngaphambi kokudweba iinzowni kilo.
field_map.drag_to_move: Donsa iphoyinti uliyise lapho lifaneleko khona.
field_map.name: Ibizo
field_map.no_fields: Awakabi khona amasimu epulazini leli. Dweba elinye emephini.
field_map.recorded_area_hint: Tjhiya kungenalitho bona kusetjenziswe ubukhulu bemephu

production.title: Amapulazi nokuKhiqiza
production.subtitle: Amapulazi namasimu, imephu yepulazi, izilimo nomsebenzi wesimu, iinfuyo, nesimo sezulu.

operations.title: Iimsebenzi
operations.subtitle: Umsebenzi welanga nebhizinisi lepulazi: imisebenzi, ama-oda womsebenzi, imisebenzi emincani, imitjhini, iindawo zokugcina, i-packhouse, izexwayiso, ezemali, ukuthengisa, abalimi abancani, umsizi, ukuhlanganiswa namasetingi.

satellite.no_provider: Akukabi nomhlinzeki wesathelayidi ohleliweko, ngalokho akukho okulethwako.
satellite.no_farm: Awukabi nepulazi. Bhalisa ipulazi, namkha ubawe ukunikelwa imvumo yokungena kilo.
satellite.health_subtitle: I-NDVI yamva nje netjhuguluko yayo kusukela esithombeni sangaphambilini; ukwehla okukhulu kuqala.
satellite.series_subtitle: I-NDVI elinganiselweko nebhande layo lobuncani–nobukhulu; imigca enamachatha ziinzowni zokuphatha.
satellite.pick_field: Khetha isimu bona ubone i-NDVI yalo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
satellite.settings_subtitle: Khetha umhlinzeki osetjenziswa kukuletha kwelanga bese ufaka imininingwana yokungena yehlangano yakho. Iimfihlo zigcinwa zibethelwe begodu azisatjengiswa godu.
satellite.about_copernicus: I-Sentinel-2 L2A evela ku-Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem: isabelo samahhala senyanga, amanani ngesimu nangezowni ngokufihla amafu, i-NDVI, i-NDRE ne-NDWI.
satellite.about_agromonitoring: I-Agro API ye-OpenWeather: isimu ngalinye libhaliswa njenge-polygon, bese amanani we-NDVI neemfanekiso kuza ngesithombe ngasinye. Kulula; ihlelo lamahhala likhawula ubukhulu bendawo.
satellite.kept_blank: Tjhiya kungenalitho bona kugcinwe inani elikhona.
satellite.secret_set: Inani ligciniwe; tjhiya kungenalitho bona uligcine.
satellite.daily_budget_hint: Izibawo eziya kumhlinzeki ngelanga, zehlangano yoke.
satellite.require_plan: Amasimu anehlelo lesilimo elivunyiweko namkha elikhulako kwaphela

water.schedule_subtitle: Lapho izowni ngayinye ifika ekupheleni kwamanzi okuvumelekileko, kusukela ku-ET₀ × Kc nesibikezelweni.
water.no_schedule: Ayikho izowni efika emkhawulweni wayo emalangeni alikhomba alandelako.
water.balance_subtitle: Ukuphela kwamanzi endaweni yeempande kuqhathaniswa nomkhawulo wokunisela: amalanga ama-30 adlulileko neveke elizako.
water.no_balance: Ayikho izowni enisela enesilimo ehlabathini nedatha yesimo sezulu okwanje.
water.method: Ibhalansi yelanga ye-FAO-56: ETc = ET₀ × Kc; izulu elisebenzako li-80% wezulu elingaphezu kwe-2 mm; ukunisela kubalwa kususwe ukulahleka kwesistimu; ukufundwa kobumanzi behlabathi kubuyisela ibhalansi phasi. I-ET₀ ivela kumhlinzeki wesimo sezulu, namkha i-Hargreaves kusukela emazingeni wokufudumala welanga. Kuliseluleko kwaphela — akukho okuvula iphompo.
water.coefficients_subtitle: Amanani wokuthoma we-FAO-56 ngesilimo; beka wakho kusukela emanani we-agronomist yakho.
water.coefficient_intro: I-Kc yegadango ngalinye, amagadango njengeengcenye zesizini (ahlanganiswa abe ngu-100), ubude obupheleleko beempande, nengcenye yamanzi akhona engasetjenziswa ngaphambi kokuthi isilimo sigandeleleke.

drop_rules.title: Ukwehla kwe-NDVI okulindelekileko
drop_rules.subtitle: Ukusika, ukugunda namkha ukuvuna kwehlisa i-index; ukwehla ngaphakathi kwamalanga la akuveli isexwayiso, begodu isithombe sitjho bona kubayini.
drop_rules.using_defaults: Imithetho le eyakhelwe ngaphakathi iyasebenza bekube ubhala eyakho; nawungeza owodwa, kusebenza eyakho kwaphela.

benchmarks.title: Ukuqhathanisa nabanye
benchmarks.subtitle: Isilimo ngasinye siqhathaniswa namapulazi afanako — isilimo, isizini nesifunda esifanako — ezihlanganweni ezinye ezihlanganyelako.
benchmarks.privacy: Kwabelwana ngamabhande angaziwako kwaphela: ibhande livela kwaphela nakunamapulazi okungenani ali-{farms} avela ezihlanganweni okungenani ezi-{orgs}, begodu akukho pulazi, hlangano namkha inani elilodwa elingabonwa. Ukuhlanganyela kuyatlhogeka kokubili ukufaka nokubona amabhande.
benchmarks.ask_admin: Bawa loyo ophatha amasetingi wepulazi bona akuvule.
benchmarks.no_band: Akukabi namapulazi anele afana neli ahlanganyelako.
benchmarks.no_own: Akukabi nesivuno ngamathani, ngalokho isilimo lesi asinamanani waso.
benchmarks.no_rows: Azikho izilimo ezitjaliweko namkha ezivuniweko zokuqhathanisa.

carbon.title: Irejista yekhabhoni
carbon.subtitle: Amaphrojekthi wekhabhoni anerejista: ukufakwa erhelweni, iinkhathi zokuqapha nedatha, ukukhitjhwa, i-buffer, ukusulwa nokudluliselwa.
carbon.no_api: Amarejista afana ne-Verra ne-Gold Standard amukela izithunyelwa ngamaphothali wawo nangesiko elivunyiweko lokuqinisekisa/lokuhlola — ayikho i-API yokuthumela, ngalokho akukho okuthunyelwa erejisteni ukusuka lapha. Gcina irekhodi leli livumelana nerejista, bese usebenzisa iphakheji yokukhipha yokuthumela neyomhloli.
carbon.buffer_hint: Ingcenye yokukhitjhwa ngakunye irejista eyigodla ku-buffer pool yokungahlali isikhathi eside.
carbon.export_hint: I-zip enesifinyezo sephrojekthi (PDF), idatha yokuqapha ngesikhathi (CSV), irejista yokukhitjhwa nawo woke amatlolwa.
carbon.no_projects: Awekho amaphrojekthi wekhabhoni atloliweko. Tlola elinye ngaphasi kwe-Isimo sezulu nebhoduluko kuqala.

residues.title: Iinsalela nama-MRL
residues.subtitle: Iqhemu ngalinye liqhathaniswa nemikhawulo ephezulu yeensalela yeemakethe elenzelwe zona. Iqhemu elidlula i-MRL yemakethe, elifafazwe ngekhemikhali evinjelweko lapho, namkha (lapho imakethe ikubawa khona) elingakahlolwa, alithunyelwa lapho ngaphandle kokweqa okuvunyiweko.
residues.default_limit_note: * umkhawulo ozenzakalelako wemakethe (ayikho i-MRL ethileko yekhemikhali nesilimo lesi).
residues.risks_subtitle: Iinkhemikhali ezisetjenziswe esizinini le isikhathi sazo sokulinda siphela eduze (namkha ngemva) kwesivuno esihleliweko, namkha ezivinjelweko emakethe enqotjhwako: thatha amasampuli wamabhlogo la ngaphambi kokukha.
residues.starter_warning: Imigca etjhwayelwe "starter" iyisiqalo sokukhombisa kwaphela. Qinisekisa yoke imikhawulo ngamadathabheyisi asemthethweni (EU Pesticides Database, UK MRL database, irhelo le-Act 36 leSewula Afrika, China GB 2763, US 40 CFR 180, Codex) namkha ungenise amarhelo asemthethweni.
residues.import_subtitle: Amakholomu: active_ingredient, crop_code, market_code, mrl_mg_kg, source, effective_from. Umugca ofana nomkhawulo okhona (ikhemikhali, isilimo, imakethe nelanga elifanako) uyawutjhintjha.
residues.source_hint: Idathabheyisi namkha umthetho umkhawulo ovela kiwo
residues.no_limits: Akukabi nama-MRL: faka isethi yesiqalo namkha ungenise amarhelo asemthethweni.
residues.restrictions_subtitle: Ikhemikhali evinjelweko esetjenziswe esilimweni seqhemu iyalivimbela ukuthunyelwa emakethe leyo begodu kuyaxwayiswa nayifafazwa; ekhawulelweko iyisexwayiso kwaphela.
residues.markets_subtitle: Lapho umkhiqizo uthengiswa khona, amazwe imakethe ngayinye ewafakako (umthwalo uya emakethe yelizwe lapho uya khona), nemithetho yayo.

certification.paraphrase_note: Amaphoyinti wokulawula zizifinyezo ezimfitjhani ngamezwi wethu ngaphasi kweenombolo zesikhombo zehlelo, ukuhlela ubufakazi; irhelo lokuhlola elisemthethweni neenkhombisi zalo yikho umhloli akusebenzisako. Hlola iinombolo ngokuqhathanisa nekhuphi ohlolwa ngalo.

exports.authorities_note: Iimtifikethi ezisemthethweni ze-phytosanitary neemtifikethi zemvelaphi zikhitjhwa ziinhlangano zombuso (DALRRD ePhyto, i-chamber of commerce). I-Mkhaya ilungiselela idatha yezicelo zazo namatlolwa womrhwebi.

exports.consignment_intro: Kuthoma ngomthwalo: ikhasimende njengothunyelelwako, isivalo samaphalethi, nomugca ngeqhemu ngalinye. Itjhuguluko yenza kabutjha amatlolwa asele enziwe, njengeenguqulo ezitjha.
exports.country_hint: Ikhowudi yeenhlamvu ezimbili (NL, GB, CN); begodu ikhetha nemakethe yeensalela
exports.code_store_hint: Tjhiya kungenalitho kwiyunithi yokukhiqiza yepulazi uqobo

grain.subtitle: Yoke iloli kusukela esimini (namkha e-silo) ukuya ebhinini namkha kumthengi: isikali sihlanganisa ukukala kwayo, izinga libeka okudonswako, begodu isitatimende somthengi siqhathaniswa namathikithi wethu.

f.destination_hint: Lapho kulethwa khona, isib. i-silo ye-VKB Reitz.
f.load_ref_hint: Inombolo yomthwalo we-combine namkha we-bin-cart, nakwenzeka isimu linayo.
f.grade_hint: Tjhiya kungenalitho bona izinga libekwe ngokufundwako.
f.csv_hint: Umugca wesihloko: ticket, vehicle, date, net, moisture, grade, settled (namkha payable), price, amount.

grain.secret_once: Beka imfihlo le ku-software yesikali nje. Itjengiswa kanye kwaphela; etjha ingakhitjhwa ku-Integrations.
grain.open_weighings_hint: Ukukala kokuthoma okulindele okwesibili, nemithwalo ekaliweko elindele ukubekwa izinga.
grain.devices_hint: I-tare ehluka ngaphezu kwe-{pct}% ku-tare ejayelekileko yeloli, namkha i-gross engaphezu kwe-{max} kg, iyatjhwayelwa.
grain.no_devices: Asikho isikali esibhalisiweko: kala ngesandla, namkha ubhalise isikali.
grain.no_bins: Ipulazi leli alikabi ne-silo namkha indawo yokugcina iinthoro: engeza enye ngaphasi kwe-Isitoko.
grain.recon_hint: Imithwalo ethunyelwe esimini engakhange ikalwe, ukuletha okungekho esitatimendeni somthengi, umthwalo ofanako kabili, nemigca yesitatimende engenamthwalo wethu.
grain.post_hint: Ithumela lokho umthengi akubhadelako njengokuthengiswa komkhiqizo wepulazi (abakweletako), ngesilimo.
grain.contracts_hint: Iinkontraka zeenthoro ngomthwalo: okulethiweko kilokho umthengi akubhadeleko, namkha ubudisi bethu obubhadelweko bekube bayabhadela.
grain.log_load_intro: Umthwalo uthoma ithikithi lawo nawusuka. Isikali siwufumana ngekoloyi; umthwalo ongakhange ufike utjengiswa njengolahlekileko.
grain.capture_intro: Kokubili ukukala kusukela esilibhwini sesikali. Izinga nokudonswako kulandela ukufundwa nezinga lokubeka amazinga.
grain.assess_intro: Kokubili ukukala sekungenile: engeza ukufundwa kombeki wamazinga nalapho umthwalo uye khona, begodu uyaphela.
grain.weigh_intro: Ukudlula kanye phezu kwesikali. Ukukala kwesibili kweloli efanako kuhlanganiswa nokokuthoma.
grain.register_intro: Isikali sithumela ukukala ngakunye ekhelini laso ngemfihlo, etjengiswa kanye.
grain.import_intro: Isitatimende se-elevator njenge-CSV. Umugca ngamunye uqhathaniswa namathikithi wethu ngenombolo yethikithi, ngaphandle kwalokho ngeloli, ilanga nobudisi.

markets.feeds_intro: I-JSE/SAFEX ayina-API yamahhala. Khombisa ifidi ku-CSV namkha ku-JSON ekhitjhwa mthengisi wedatha, umrhwebi namkha i-co-op yakho bese ufanisa amakholomu; itholwa qobe ntambama ngemva kokuvalwa, begodu ukwehluleka kuyalingwa godu kutjengiswe ngaphasi kwe-Integrations.
markets.records_only: Lerejista igcina iimphathiso zakho bese iziveza ngefidi yemakethe. Akukho okuthunyelwa kumrhwebi namkha e-exchange; isitatimende somrhwebi wakho siso esinegunya.
markets.no_marks: Akukalinganiswa: ayikho intengo ye-futures yenyanga yayo.
markets.valuation_note: Ama-futures ngentengo yamva yenyanga yawo; ama-option ngobulelo bawo bangaphakathi (ubulelo besikhathi abubalwa).
markets.over_hedged: Okuthengisiweko namkha okuvikelweko kunengi kunalokho isilimo okulindeleke bona sikunikele.
markets.no_position: Azikho izilimo zeenhlamvu, iinvumelwano namkha iinvikelo.
markets.columns_hint: Isihloko sekholomu (CSV), indawo yayo ukusukela ku-0, namkha indlela emugqeni ngamunye we-JSON. Yintengo kwaphela edingekako.
markets.guard: Lokho ifidi ekuthumelako yidatha, akusiwo amalayelo: umbhalo uyahlwengwa, begodu umugqa ofundeka njengelayelo uyagcinwa bewuphawulwe.

accounting.title: Iinxhumanisi zokubalwa kweemali
accounting.subtitle: Gcina amabhuku wepulazi ku-Xero, QuickBooks Online namkha Sage Business Cloud Accounting esikhundleni sebhuku lethu lemali.
accounting.registration: Ukuxhumana okuphilako kudinga bona le phulathifomu ibhaliswe njenge-app kumhlinzeki ngamunye (i-client id nefihlo, ne-redirect URI engaphasi). Kuze kube kwenzeka lokho, umhlinzeki utjengisa "kudingeka ukubhaliswa kwe-app" begodu akukho okuthunyelwako.

book.title: Ibhuku lerekhodi
book.intro: Khetha lapho amabhuku agcinwa khona. Ibhuku lethu lemali liragela phambili lisebenza nanyana kunjani: ngesistimu yangaphandle liba libhuku elingaphasi lepulazi, begodu ama-invoyisi, iimbili namajenali wepulazi alindiswa bona athunyelwe lapho; iinhlawulo ezitlolwe lapho ziyabuya bezitjengise ezethu njengezihlawulweko.

accounting.disconnect_confirm: Khipha ukuxhumana no-{name}? Ukufanisa nerekhodi lokuvumelanisa kuyagcinwa; nange libhuku lerekhodi, amabhuku abuyela ebhukwini lethu lemali.
accounting.region_unsupported: Akutholakali: i-Sage kileli lizwe isebenzisa i-API le nxhumanisi engayizwisisiko.

sage_za.title: Ngena ku-Sage South Africa
sage_za.intro: I-Sage Business Cloud Accounting eSewula Afrika (ebekuyi-Sage One) ine-API yayo begodu ayikuthumeli ekhasini lokungena le-Sage. Faka ibizo lomsebenzisi nephasiwedi oyisebenzisa ku-Sage, hlola ukuxhumana, bese ukhetha ikampani. Iphasiwedi igcinwa ifihliwe begodu angekhe iboniswe godu.
sage_za.password_hint: Iyatlolwa kwaphela: ihlolwa ku-Sage bese igcinwa ifihliwe.
sage_za.api_key_kept: Ikhiya yehlangano le igciniwe: tjhiya kungenalutho bona igcinwe
sage_za.api_key_hint_platform: Tjhiya kungenalutho bona kusetjenziswe ikhiya ye-Sage API yephulathifomu.
sage_za.api_key_hint_none: Iphulathifomu ayikabi nekhiya ye-Sage South Africa API: faka leyo i-Sage ekunikele yona.
sage_za.tracking_note: Amapulazi, amasimu namabhizinisi aya eenhlobeni zokuhlaziya ze-Sage lapho uzifanise khona, begodu atlolwa nehlathululweni lomugqa ngamunye. Amajenali aya njengamajenali we-Sage, ngamunye ane-akhawundi yesikweletu ne-contra.

settings.title: Yini evumelaniswako
settings.default_item_hint: I-QuickBooks idinga into emugqeni ngamunye we-invoyisi; le isetjenziswa lapho i-akhawundi ingafaniswanga nenye.
settings.sync_from_hint: Kungenalutho: koke okutlolwe kusukela amabhuku athuthelwa lapho.

mapping.intro: Sitjele bona i-akhawundi ngayinye yethu, iinkhowudi zomthelo, izilinganiso zepulazi nabathintanwa babizwa ngokuthini ngakelinye ihlangothi. Ama-akhawundi anekhowudi efanako ayazifanisa lokha nufunda ihlelo lawo.
mapping.pull_first: Funda ihlelo labo nabathintanwa kuqala (ithebhu ye-Connections), bese ufanisa lapha.
mapping.contacts_note: Ikhasimende namkha umhlinzeki ongafaniswanga wenziwa ngakelinye ihlangothi kokuthoma lokha idokhumenti yakhe nayithunyelwako.

log.intro: Irekhodi ngalinye elithunyelweko namkha elifundwe emuva, ne-id yalo ngakelinye ihlangothi. Elehlulekileko litjengisa umlayezo womhlinzeki; lungisa isizathu (kanengi kukufanisa) bese uyalinga godu. Ukulinga godu angekhe kwenze ikopi yesibili.

machine_data.title: Idatha yemitjhini
machine_data.subtitle: I-John Deere Operations Center ne-CNH FieldOps (Case IH, New Holland): imikhawulo yamasimu, imitjhini, amahora wenjini nemisebenzi yemasimini kuyangena; imikhawulo neenqunto ezivunyiweko kuya emitjhinini.
machine_data.approval: Ukuxhumana okuphilako kudinga bona i-app yonjiniyela yephulathifomu le ivunywe yi-John Deere (developer.deere.com, bese ihlangano ngayinye iyinikela ilungelo ku-Operations Center) ne-CNH (iphorthali yayo yonjiniyela, ekhipha nekhiya yokubhalisela). Kuze kube kwenzeka lokho, iphulathifomu itjengisa "kudingeka ukuvunywa ngunjiniyela" begodu akukho okubizwako.

registration.deere: I-John Deere ayikayivumi i-app yephulathifomu le (namkha i-client id nefihlo kanazange kuhlelwe). Faka isibawo ku-developer.deere.com, bhalisa i-redirect URI engaphasi bese ubawa ilungelo le-production.
registration.cnh: I-CNH ayikayivumi i-app yephulathifomu le (namkha i-client id nefihlo kanazange kuhlelwe). Faka isibawo ephorthalini yonjiniyela ye-CNH Industrial yelungelo le-FieldOps, bhalisa i-redirect URI engaphasi bese uhlela ikhiya yokubhalisela.

settings.push_boundaries: Thumela umkhawulo wethu nange kutjhentjhe owethu kwaphela
settings.complete_imported: Qedela msinyana ukusetjenziswa okungenisiweko (kukhipha izinto esitolo sepulazi)

fields.intro: Amasimu wabo afaniswa newethu ngekhowudi namkha ngebizo; fanisa aseleko ngesandla, namkha wenze isimu ngelabo. Umkhawulo otjhentjhe ngakubo kwaphela uba yinguqulo etjha yowethu, kutloliwe bona uvela kibo. Nange utjhentjhe ngeenhlangothi zombili, ulinda ngaphasi kwe-Conflicts.
fields.send_intro: Amasimu wethu angakabi ngakubo: ukuthumela linye kulenza lapho nomkhawulo walo.

machines.intro: Imitjhini yabo ifaniswa nemitjhini yethu ye-Fleet ngenomboro yesiriyeli namkha nge-VIN. Amahora wenjini womtjhini ofanisiweko angena njenge-telematics, ngalokho imitha yamahora, ukusetjenziswa nesevisi efanele kulandela umtjhini ngokwawo.

operations.intro: Umsebenzi ngamunye ofundwe emitjhinini, ugcinwe nedatha yawo yokuthoma. Ukusetjenziswa namkha ukuhlwanyela kuba (namkha kugcwalisa) umsebenzi wesimu nezinto zawo; ukuwungenisa godu kuyawubuyekeza, angekhe kuwuphinde kabili. Ukuvuna kuletha isivuno sakho, esitlolwa njengokuvuna lokha isilimo sesikalwe.
operations.products_intro: Fanisa ibizo lomkhiqizo ngamunye nenye yezinto zethu zesitoko; imisebenzi elindileko iyafundwa godu.

conflicts.intro: Umkhawulo otjhentjhe lapha nakuphulathifomu yemitjhini kusukela bavumelana kokugcina. Akukho okutlolwa ngaphezulu: gcina owethu (bewuwuthumele kibo) namkha uthathe owabo (njengenguqulo etjha yowethu).
conflicts.keep_confirm: Gcina umkhawulo wethu bewuwuthumele kuphulathifomu yemitjhini?
conflicts.take_confirm: Thatha umkhawulo wabo njengenguqulo etjha yesimu?

log.intro: Ukuvumelanisa ngakunye, umsebenzi nefayela elithunyelweko kudlula erekhodini lokuhlanganisa: okwehlulekileko kugcina umlayezo wephulathifomu bese kulingwa godu ngokulinda isikhathi esandako; ukulinga godu angekhe kungenise namkha kuthumele kabili.

prescriptions.title: Iinqunto zezinga elitjhentjhako
prescriptions.subtitle: Bona kungangani komkhiqizo okuya engcenyeni ngayinye yesimu: kusuka eenzowunini zokuphatha zesimu namkha ku-NDVI yaso yamva, kuhlolwe mumuntu wesibili, bese kukhitjhelwa imonitha namkha kuthunyelwe ku-John Deere Operations Center namkha ku-CNH FieldOps.
prescriptions.new_intro: Khetha isimu, umkhiqizo nalapho iinzowuni zivela khona. Izinga lezowuni ngayinye lingatjhentjhwa ngemva kwalokho.

f.per_stock_unit_hint: Bona yunithi yesitoko eyodwa iphethe ama-kg, ama-l namkha iimbewu ezingaki (isib. iimbewu ezi-80000 ngesaka).
f.name: Ibizo
f.preview_note: (iklasi 1 ngelibuthakathaka khulu; iinzowuni ezitjengiswe bona azifakwa azitholi litho)

prescriptions.settings_intro: Ukutjhentjha lokhu kwenza iinzowuni namazinga godu. Isiqunto esivunyiweko sibuyela ekulungisweni njengenguqulo etjha.
prescriptions.four_eyes: Nguwe olungise namkha othumele isiqunto lesi: omunye umuntu kufanele asivume ngaphambi kobana siye emtjhinini.
prescriptions.new_version: Le yinguqulo etjha yesiqunto esivunyiweko: kufanele sivunywe godu ngaphambi kobana sithunyelwe.
prescriptions.flat_vs: Uma kumadaniswa ne-{rate} {unit} elilinganako endaweni elatjhiweko:
prescriptions.rates_note: Ukugcina amazinga kwenza inguqulo etjha nange le bekuvunyiwe.
prescriptions.files_intro: Enzelwe inguqulo le begodu agcinwa nayo. I-shapefile iphethe izinga ku-attribute ye-RATE; i-ISO-XML inezowuni yokulapha eyodwa ngezinga ngalinye.
prescriptions.machines_intro: Isiqunto esivunyiweko siya emafayeleni wehlangano kuphulathifomu, silungele isibonisi.
prescriptions.compare_intro: Kusuka emsebenzini womtjhini: iimpawu zawo zezinga ngaphakathi kwezowuni ngayinye lapho uzitlole khona, ngaphandle kwalokho izinga lawo elijayelekileko.
prescriptions.compare_none: Akukabikho umsebenzi ovela emitjhinini ohlanganiswe nesiqunto lesi.
